title: Senior Business Analyst - SAP Commerce (Hybris)
description:
**Techwave**
, we are always in an exercise to foster a culture of growth, and inclusivity. We ensure whoever is associated with the brand is being challenged at every step and is provided with all the necessary opportunities to excel in life. People are at the core of everything we do.
  
  
**Who are we?**
**Techwave**
is a leading global IT and engineering services and solutions company revolutionizing digital transformations. We believe in enabling clients to maximize the potential and achieve a greater market with a wide array of technology services, including, but not limited to, Enterprise Resource Planning, Application Development, Analytics, Digital, and the Internet of things (IoT).
  
  
Founded in 2004, headquartered in Houston, TX, USA, Techwave leverages its expertise in Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications, and Engineering Services to enable businesses accelerate their growth.
  
  
Plus, we're a team of dreamers and doers who are pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
  
  
And we want
**YOU**
to be a part of it.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) with deep expertise in digital commerce and eCommerce platforms to support SAP Commerce (Hybris) programs across AMS, enhancements, and transformational initiatives. The role will own requirements quality, business-process alignment, cross-functional coordination, and functional readiness from discovery through deployment and hypercare.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess advanced requirements-management skills, strong stakeholder-engagement experience, and a solid understanding of B2B commerce processes. The individual will act as a trusted advisor and liaison among business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and technology teams; challenge assumptions constructively; drive alignment on priorities and scope; and ensure that delivered solutions achieve measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Requirements Management
* Elicit, analyse, document, and validate business requirements from stakeholders.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and requirement-gathering meetings.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify gaps, dependencies, and process improvement opportunities.
* Stakeholder Management
* Establish and maintain business analysis standards, requirement templates, traceability practices, review checkpoints, and quality controls across the engagement.
* Lead requirement reviews, resolve conflicting requirements, and ensure that scope changes are formally assessed, approved, and communicated.
* Collaborate with business users, product owners, IT teams, and external partners.
* Act as the primary point of contact for requirement clarifications.
* Present business process recommendations and solution options.
* Support decision-making by providing impact and feasibility assessments.
* Digital Commerce Support
* Provide functional leadership across delivery teams.
* Review deliverables, promote reusable practices, and support estimation, planning.
* Analyse and document end-to-end commerce processes as per the client needs.
* Support implementation and enhancement initiatives within SAP Commerce environments.
* Facilitate backlog prioritization and release-planning activities and supporting product owners in making transparent prioritization decisions.
* Analyse complex B2B business models and processes, and customer journeys as per the client needs.
* Agile Delivery Support
* Define and validate functional requirements for integrations among SAP Commerce, ERP, CRM, PIM, payment, tax, logistics, identity, and other enterprise systems.
* Document data flows, mappings, business rules, interface dependencies, exception handling, reconciliation requirements, and ownership of master and transactional data.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews.
* Coordinate with development and QA teams to ensure requirements are implemented correctly.
* Define business outcomes, success measures, and acceptance thresholds for major initiatives.
* Track whether delivered capabilities achieve the intended customer, operational, and commercial benefits, and recommend corrective actions where expected value is not realized.
* Testing & Validation
* Support AMS operations by analysing incidents, service requests, recurring defects, and business-impact trends.
* Clarify functional behaviour, contribute to root-cause analysis, identify permanent corrective actions, and help prioritize fixes and service improvements against agreed service levels.
* Elicit and document non-functional requirements covering performance, scalability, availability, security, privacy, accessibility, auditability, localization, supportability, and regulatory compliance.
* Support cutover and data-migration planning by defining business validation rules, reconciliation criteria, mock-cutover scenarios, readiness checkpoints, rollback considerations, and business sign-off requirements.
* Develop test scenarios and business validation criteria.
* Validate delivered functionality against business requirements.
* Plan and coordinate User Acceptance Testing by defining the UAT scope, entry and exit criteria, scenarios, test data needs, participant responsibilities, defect-severity rules, progress reporting, and business sign-off requirements.
* Lead business readiness activities for deployment and hypercare, including process and training impact assessments, operational handover, release communications, support documentation, adoption tracking, issue escalation, and confirmation that business teams are prepared to use and support the delivered capabilities.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Functional Skills
* 12+ years of Business Analysis experience, including demonstrated ownership of complex digital commerce initiatives and leadership of business analysis activities across multiple workstreams or releases.
* Hands-on experience in SAP Commerce (Hybris) implementations, upgrades, enhancements, or AMS engagements, with the ability to analyse platform capabilities, constraints, integrations, and fit-gap decisions.
* Experience working on eCommerce or Digital Commerce platforms.
* Strong understanding of software delivery lifecycle (SDLC).
* Experience creating and governing BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, functional specifications, use cases, decision logs, traceability matrices, and business impact assessments.
* Commerce Domain Knowledge
* Experience contributing to solution estimates, release planning, scope definition, dependency assessment, risk analysis, and business-case development for digital commerce initiatives.
* Experience in one or more of the following areas:
* B2B Commerce (Mandatory)
* Distribution & Channel Sales
* Wholesale Commerce
* Manufacturing
* Technology Distribution
* Order-to-Cash Processes
* Customer Experience (CX)
* Platform Knowledge
* SAP Commerce (Hybris)
* SAP S/4HANA
* SAP ECC
* SAP Customer Experience Solutions
* CRM Platforms
* Product Information Management (PIM) Systems
* Tools & Technologies
* JIRA/Confluence or equivalent
* Visio / Lucidchart / Draw.io or equivalent
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience supporting B2B commerce platforms.
* Exposure to system integration projects involving ERP platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Experience working with distributed global teams.
* Certification in CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, Scrum, or Agile methodologies is a plus.
* Soft Skills
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to facilitate workshops and business discussions.
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
* Self-driven and proactive approach to work.

title: Business Analyst, Digital Products
description:
**Description**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Digital & Innovation group at USP is seeking a Business Analyst who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Business Analyst Has The Following Responsibilities**

* Lead large-scale technology programs including scope definition, project planning, prioritization, execution tracking, and successful delivery.
* Create, maintain, and manage detailed project schedules, resource allocations, dependency maps, and technical documentation.
* Conduct readiness assessments across people, processes, systems, and technology components to ensure delivery alignment.
* Develop program baselines, perform gap analyses, drive reviews, and implement updates to ensure strong execution governance.
* Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies; implement effective mitigation strategies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather functional and technical requirements, align deliverables, and ensure milestone readiness.
* Prepare comprehensive project artifacts including dashboards, status reports, timelines, risk registers, and delivery plans.
* Facilitate cross-functional meetings, document key decisions, capture action items, and drive closure on follow-ups.
* Monitor project performance, proactively escalate blockers, and ensure timely issue resolution to maintain delivery cadence.
* Partner with engineering, product, operations, and geographically distributed teams to achieve program objectives.
* Provide clear and consistent reporting on KPIs, milestones, risks, and deliverables to leadership and stakeholders.
* Define program scope, develop feature specifications and user stories, and work closely with engineering teams for implementation.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
  
  

* 3–7 years of experience in Business Analysis ,Technical Program Management or Product Management, delivering scalable software services and platform features.
* Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to design optimal, scalable, and forward-thinking solutions.
* Demonstrated experience delivering cloud-scale systems and driving deep technical conversations when needed.
* Lead effective program ceremonies and working sessions, assign and track action items, and ensure project visibility.
* Drive software engineering and data initiatives with a strong understanding of the technical and business ecosystem.
* Influence stakeholders across multiple teams and levels to drive alignment and program success.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity with strong ownership, adaptability, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Experience in scientific nomenclature or hands-on experience in life sciences, chemistry, pharmaceuticals, or related STEM fields; science-related degree preferred.
* Proven track record of taking ownership and driving technical projects to successful completion.
* Excellent organizational skills; strong attention to detail and ability to lead by example and display growth mindset.
* Industry standard certifications such as ITIL, PMP etc. would be a plus

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
None, this is an individual contributor role.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
**Job Category**
Information Technology
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

title: Technical Business Analyst III
description:
Are you a seasoned Technical Business Analyst with a passion for transforming complex financial systems into streamlined, high-performing solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and finance, turning business challenges into smart, scalable IT innovations? If so, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in a globally connected, SAP-driven financial closing environment — and leave a lasting mark on how the world's (re)insurance industry reports its financials.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Technical Business Analyst**
, you will sit at the heart of our global financial closing ecosystem, acting as the critical bridge between business stakeholders and our SAP-based platform. You will not only maintain and enhance a sophisticated financial subledger solution, but you will also champion simplicity, standardization, and innovation. From shaping new functionality to validating, it through rigorous testing and live production runs, your fingerprints will be on every improvement we make. You'll engage continuously with a global user community — educating, aligning, and supporting teams across time zones and disciplines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with global stakeholders to capture business objectives and requirements, translating them into pragmatic, effective IT solutions
* Challenge complexity — act as a champion for standard components and push back on unnecessarily complicated solutions in favor of elegant, maintainable designs
* Establish yourself as a subject matter expert on SAP systems and financial closing processes, providing trusted guidance and mentorship to stakeholders and team members alike
* Drive end-to-end system changes and customizations through the full lifecycle — from solutioning and implementation through to testing and go-live
* Support quarterly close operations including incident handling, process documentation, and continuous improvement of E2E system workflows
* Engage and educate the global user community on an ongoing basis, ensuring alignment, adoption, and confidence in the platform
* Validate new and enhanced functionality during both testing phases and productive runs, ensuring quality and reliability at every step

**About The Team**
The
**FPSL Subledger Liability**
team is an international product team made up of experienced professionals with diverse and complementary backgrounds. We provide the platform that enables global and local financial closings under IFRS for (re)insurance contracts. At the core of this platform is a robust SAP solution, embedded within an evolving technology landscape that enriches our data and ultimately produces financial statements for the quarterly finance closing process. We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values expertise, curiosity, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  
  
**About You**
You are a strategic and creative problem solver who thrives on turning complexity into clarity. Your strong interpersonal skills allow you to build trusted relationships across diverse, global teams, and your natural curiosity keeps you constantly learning and improving. You bring an ownership mindset to everything you do — self-driven, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. You are as comfortable diving into technical detail as you are facilitating a conversation with senior business stakeholders, and you bring both rigor and enthusiasm to every challenge.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* University degree in a technical, financial, or business discipline (or comparable qualification/experience)
* 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst working with IT systems in complex, enterprise environments
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with FPSL systems, including solid knowledge of IFRS 17 and its application in (re)insurance financial reporting
* Good working knowledge of SQL and the MS Office suite, including advanced Excel skills
* Proven experience delivering product changes and operations with end-to-end ownership, including requirements analysis, testing, process standardization, optimization, and documentation

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Basic knowledge of accounting and financial reporting principles, enabling effective communication with finance stakeholders
* Willingness and ability to learn a scripting language for formulating and automating test cases
* Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies, including experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for backlog management and sprint planning
* Experience working in global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones and cultures
* A continuous improvement mindset with the drive to proactively identify and implement enhancements to both processes and systems

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
  
  
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: Business Analyst – AI Use Cases & QA Validation
description:
Business Analyst – AI Use Cases & QA Validation

**Experience:**
4+ Years

**Job Role:**
Business Analyst

**Focus Areas:**
Business Analysis, AI Use Case Development, QA & Testing, UAT

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong business analysis capabilities, hands-on QA/testing exposure, and experience in defining and validating AI-driven use cases. The ideal candidate will bridge business requirements, AI solution design, and quality assurance to ensure that AI and automation solutions meet business objectives and functional expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* **Business Requirements & Analysis:**
  Gather, analyze, and document business requirements; translate them into functional specifications, user stories, use cases, and clearly defined acceptance criteria.
* **AI Use Case Definition:**
  Identify business opportunities for AI and automation, develop relevant AI use cases, define expected outcomes, and establish validation criteria aligned with business requirements.
* **QA & Functional Testing:**
  Leverage QA experience to prepare test scenarios and test cases, perform functional and integration testing, identify defects, and validate solution behavior against business expectations.
* **AI Solution Validation:**
  Evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance, consistency, completeness, and alignment with defined business requirements and expected outcomes.
* **User Acceptance Testing (UAT):**
  Coordinate UAT activities with business stakeholders, validate end-to-end workflows, track issues, and support defect resolution and business sign-off.
* **Documentation & Governance:**
  Maintain business requirements documents, functional specifications, test documentation, and validation reports while ensuring adherence to platform governance standards.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Work closely with business teams, developers, QA engineers, and AI/automation teams to ensure successful implementation and adoption of solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5–8+ years of experience in Business Analysis, with exposure to QA, functional testing, or software quality assurance.
* Experience writing business use cases, user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of AI-driven solutions and the ability to define, assess, and validate AI use cases.
* Hands-on experience in functional testing, integration testing, test case preparation, defect tracking, and UAT coordination.
* Ability to assess AI outputs against business rules, expected results, and defined acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments is preferred.

Key Competencies

Business Analysis | AI Use Case Development | QA & Functional Testing | AI Response Validation | Requirements Management | User Stories & Acceptance Criteria | UAT | Test Documentation | Stakeholder Management

title: Spclst , Salesforce Technical Business Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Spclst , Salesforce Technical Business Analyst**
**Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech CenteThe Lab Integration Platform is a critical enabler of digital transformation strategy, supporting secure, compliant, and efficient data exchange across laboratory systems.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team deliver global CRM transformation with a goal to create a single, connected CRM experience across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service.
  
  
We're building from the ground up — collaborating on global processes, integrating enterprise systems, and laying the foundation for continuous improvement, AI-driven insights, and scalable growth.
  
  
It's an exciting time to join. You'll be part of a collaborative, cross-functional team working at the intersection of business and technology, with real influence over what gets built and how it works.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Salesforce Technical Business Analyst**
you will act as the critical bridge between business stakeholders and our technical delivery teams in our Subscription Services Product Line. You'll work closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners and commercial business users to ensure that what we build is grounded in real business need, clearly documented, and delivered to a high standard.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on turning complex business problems into clear, actionable requirements — and who cares about getting the detail right. You'll be embedded in the delivery cycle from requirements through to release, with ownership of the quality and clarity of what goes into each sprint.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Requirements & Documentation**

* Collaborate with commercial business teams and other business analysts to document and validate requirements, ensuring they are clear, complete, and testable.
* Work with Solution Architects to translate high-level solution designs into actionable, sprint-ready tickets for the development team.
* Supports the Solution Architect with maintenance of technical process flows, data mappings, and supporting solution design documentation to clearly articulate the needs and resulting technical solution.
* Where necessary, write well-structured user stories with robust acceptance criteria using best-practice formats (e.g., As a… I need… so that… and Given-When-Then).

**Delivery & Quality**

* This role with act as a ‘quality gate’ ensuring that the requirements which reach our technical team meet our Definition of Ready & will support the solution architect in reviewing user stories ahead of refinement & build, ensuring stories meet a clear definition of ready before entering a sprint.
* Partner with QA to develop test scenarios and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring delivered functionality meets documented acceptance criteria.
* Own the SDLC, GxP and release management processes, ensuring all necessary documentation, approvals, and traceability are in place for each release.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support the Technical Product Owner & Solution Architects with day-to-day liaison between commercial business teams and the technical delivery team, ensuring alignment and managing expectations.
* Build strong relationships with Solution Architects, developers, and QA to ensure a shared understanding of what is being built and why.

**Run & Operate and Continuous Improvement**

* Support our run and operate teams to document FAQs, SOPs and guidance for completing service requests
* Support the run and operate teams with L2 support on bugs and user issues – collaborating with the wider technical product team to identify the root cause and resolution
* Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities and releases, proactively identifying features that could benefit the business.

**Specialisms (each role will include one of the below)**
**Role 1 – Subscription & Aftersales**
You will act as a
**subject-matter expert**
within the Subscription & Aftersales products.
  
  
You'll need to be comfortable operating across
**diverse commercial sales models**
— from traditional transactional sales through to
**recurring/subscription-based models**
— and understand how these translate into different CRM process, data, and reporting requirements.
  
  
**This includes**

* Opportunity & Pipeline Management
* CPQ / Quote-to-Cash processes — including product selection, pricing, quoting, approvals, orders, billing, and renewals
* Account and Contact Management

**You'll bring**

* Demonstrable experience working with Salesforce Sales Cloud and CPQ solutions in a BA, functional consultant, or product role
* Strong understanding of end-to-end sales processes, including those involving subscription based business models

**Role 2 Service Cloud**
You will be part of our Service Cloud and Pharmacovigilance product line, bringing deep knowledge of customer service operations and Salesforce Service Cloud capabilities.
  
  
**Domain focus includes**

* Case Management (creation, routing, assignment, resolution)
* Omnichannel support (email-to-case, web-to-case, CTI)
* Queues, escalation rules, and entitlements
* Service automation and agent productivity
* Service reporting and customer satisfaction metrics
* Knowledge

**You'll bring**

* Demonstrable experience working with Salesforce Service Cloud in a BA, functional consultant, or product role
* Strong understanding of customer service operations (case lifecycle, SLA management, service team workflows)
* Experience with Life Science specific service operations, including Pharmacovigilance would be beneficial.

**Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

* 2+ years' experience working on Salesforce projects in a Business Analyst, Technical BA, or Functional Consultant capacity
* At least 1 relevant Salesforce certification (e.g., Salesforce Certified Business Analyst, Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Platform App Builder, or Life Sciences Cloud equivalent)
* Strong ability to write clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Experience with process mapping, data mapping, and requirements documentation
* Solid understanding of the Salesforce platform — data model, security model, declarative automation (Flows), and standard objects
* Hands-on experience with Jira for backlog management and sprint delivery
* Proven experience working within Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum or SAFe)
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — you can translate between business and technical language with confidence
* Understanding of GxP requirements in validatd systems.

**Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Experience with Confluence, Mural, or similar collaboration and documentation tools
* Understanding of integration patterns (APIs, middleware, data sync) and how they impact requirements
* Experience supporting UAT planning and execution, including test scenario design
* Familiarity with release management processes and SDLC governance
* Animal Health, Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences industry experience
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Scaled Abuse Analyst, Trust and Safety, YouTube
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 2 years of experience in data analytics, Trust and Safety, policy, risk/fraud analytics, or a related field.

**About The Job**
Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust & Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.
  
  
As a Scaled Abuse Analyst, you will have experience with analyzing large-scale data and scaled systems of review. You will thrive in a fast, dynamic, demanding environment where no two days are ever the same. You will be a key contributor to the strategy for reducing network badness on YouTube. You will be an independent, critical thinker with sound metrics judgment who has a passion for coaching others, solving technological challenges and setting scalable standards. You will balance the short term requirements we face while demonstrating the ability to see the big picture and make quantitatively based long-term recommendations accordingly. You will be exposed to graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content during team escalations in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform fraud and spam investigations using various data sources, identify product vulnerabilities and drive anti-abuse experiments to prevent abuse. Work with engineers and interact cross-functionally with stakeholders to improve workflows via process improvements, automation and anti-abuse system creation.

title: Planning & Reporting CoE Senior Officer
description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About The Finance Planning & Reporting CoE**
Driving efficiency and standardization across our renowned consumer brands that enhance everyday lives—from nourishing meals to trusted household essentials—is the pivotal force of the Finance Planning & Reporting Center of Excellence (CoE). Fuelled by a culture of collaboration and innovation, the CoE is integral to our organization, championing financial excellence and strategic insight across our global landscape. We are a dynamic, agile team, relentlessly focused on enhancing our financial processes, harnessing advanced analytics, and delivering unparalleled value to every facet of our business.
  
  
We transcend traditional finance roles; we are a strategic partner where diverse talents converge to tackle intricate financial challenges, foster sustainable growth, and empower our mission to create a healthier, more sustainable world for all. By ensuring a clear line of sight between strategic goals and day-to-day financial activities, we enable efficient performance management and better business results through the collaboration of our people, processes, and systems.
  
  
Our CoE transforms finance from a traditional back-office function into a strategic powerhouse that drives business value, as talented individuals come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Officer in the Finance CoE, you will report into a Finance Manager and be part of a team of analysts supporting a portfolio of markets. In this role, you will play a key part in executing financial planning and reporting activities across these markets. You will support the creation of standardized reports, development of initial forecasts/budgets, and analysis of financial performance to enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to multiple markets while contributing to the centralization and improvement of Reckitt’s FP&A processes. If you are passionate about finance, data analysis, and continuous improvement, this role will allow you to grow and make a real impact on our global business.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Produce and consolidate financial reports for monthly and quarterly results, ensuring key performance metrics (sales, profitability, costs, etc.) are accurately reported and delivered on time to global and regional stakeholders.
* Conduct variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) and clearly explain drivers behind the numbers, highlighting trends and insights that inform business decisions.
* Support the planning and forecasting cycles, including annual budgets and periodic forecasts: coordinate data collection from different markets, validate submissions, and align assumptions with global guidelines to create a cohesive financial outlook.
* Manage and enhance financial dashboards and reports (e.g. in Power BI or similar tools) to provide users with intuitive, up-to-date views of financial performance. Ensure that dashboards capture the right KPIs and that data is consistent across all reporting outputs.
* Participate in finance transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline and improve existing FP&A processes. You’ll contribute to standardizing report templates, automating manual tasks, and sharing best practices that elevate our CoE’s efficiency and impact.
* Collaborate closely with market finance teams and other CoE members to ensure data integrity and one-source-of-truth in our financial systems. You will act as a liaison, helping local teams understand CoE processes and troubleshooting data or reporting issues to maintain accuracy.
* Assist with ad-hoc analysis and projects as needed, such as deep-dives into specific expenses or trends, scenario modeling for strategic projects, or financial deck preparation for senior leadership meetings. Your ability to turn data into actionable insights will be key in these projects.
* Adapt and excel in a dynamic environment – our CoE is continually evolving. You’ll be expected to handle last-minute changes or requests, work under tight deadlines especially during key reporting periods, and maintain a high standard of quality. In doing so, you’ll demonstrate agility, teamwork, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 2-3years of experience in finance, analytics, or a related field, ideally within the CPG sector.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

The skills for success
  
  

* Financial Analysis & Reporting
* Strategic Planning
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Data Visualization Skills
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

.

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Job summary**
  
We are looking for an individual in the portfolio analytics role that would support product ideation and selection process. The role involves detailed quantitative and qualitative evaluation of pipeline attributes such as disease area, epidemiology, competitive intelligence, asset valuation. The role also involves custom database development and utilization of visualization tools for senior leadership interaction to drive decision making.
  
  
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Product and Market Analytics

Conduct qualitative and quantitative market analysis for biologics across geographies to assess therapy, pricing, patient populations, unmet needs, and competitive dynamics. Leverage internal and external data sources (e.g., IQVIA, GlobalData, ASP, DRG, IPD) to generate insights on price erosion, biosimilar penetration, and competition impact. Support the analytics through design and maintenance of customized databases to enable senior leadership level visualization.

2. Financial Modeling & Valuation

Develop and maintain financial models incorporating key assumptions such as market share, price erosion, competition, and biosimilar uptake. Build long‑term forecasts using both bottom‑up (patient‑based) and top‑down approaches, accounting for regulatory, market, and geopolitical factors. Evaluate product viability through NPV, IRR, and scenario analysis to support make‑vs‑buy and investment decisions. Work with frontend markets to develop consolidated business case for the products.

3. Integrated Product Strategy

Define the objectives of a program to towards definition of the Product Requirement Document, a product development road map through considerations technical aspects of product development and life cycle management such as - CMC, Clinical etc.

4. Stakeholder Management

Collaborate closely with Business Development, Finance, Strategy, Product Management, R&D, IP, and Market teams to integrate inputs and enable informed decision‑making.

**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification:**
Masters in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotech, or similar fields, with an MBA with specialization in any of Finance, Operations, Strategy, Analytics
  
  
  
  
**Minimum work experience**
: 4 to 7 years of experience in portfolio management, product management or business development
  
  
  
  
**Skills & attributes:
  
  
  
  
Technical Skills**
  
• Hands-on work experience in designing and developing financial models, including expertise in financial modelling related to licensing, cost analysis, and evaluation of financial accounts.
  
  
• Strong proficiency in MS Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  
  
• General understanding of Portfolio Management principles.
  
  
• Solid understanding of drug product development processes, including the various stages involved in bringing a pharmaceutical product to market.
  
  
• Knowledge of healthcare databases, routine financial reporting, and a strong ability to handle analytical data within the healthcare context.
  
  
• Expertise in financial analysis, including the use of visualization tools for data interpretation.
  
  
• Understanding of the global regulatory framework in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries.
  
  
• Knowledge and experience in conducting program and stage gate reviews, with a focus on evaluating business cases.
  
  
• Fundamental knowledge of Quality principles, Formulation Development, Manufacturing processes, and Supply Chain management within the pharmaceutical industry.
  
  
  
  
**Behavioural skills**
  
• Demonstrates proficiency in negotiations and sensitivity to cross-cultural dynamics.
  
  
• Maintains objectivity and effectively works in ambiguous situations.
  
  
• Possesses a strong blend of strategic thinking and execution skills, aligning cross-functional teams for successful outcomes.
  
  
• Exhibits self-initiative and resilience, proactively addressing challenges.
  
  
• Communicates effectively and engages with senior leaders, showcasing strong communication skills.

**Additional Information**

**About the Department
  
  
Biologics**
  
Currently operates in the Global Biosimilars business - a segment that is poised for attractive and sustained growth over the next 10–15-year time horizon.
  
  
With a robust portfolio of biosimilar products across key therapeutic areas, covering ~US$80+ Bn in innovator sales – future business pipeline covers a variety of product classes and therapy areas, and new modalities. Fully integrated organization with over two decades of experience in developing, manufacturing and commercializing multiple biosimilar products.
  
  
With a Product Development engine that has end-to-end capabilities – in-house clone development, upstream and downstream process development, bioanalytical development and proprietary formulation.
  
  
Supported by a Clinical and Regulatory team with experience in executing complex biosimilar programs with innovative global trial designs.
  
  
We have a proven experience in commercial-scale manufacturing across a variety of technology platforms with global quality standards and a highly competitive cost structure
  
  
Rich experience of commercializing high-quality biosimilars in multiple markets with over 900,000 patients having benefited from our products till date.
  
  
  
  
**Benefits Offered**
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
  
  
**Our Work Culture**
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
  
  
For more details, please visit our career website at
**https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

title: Order To Cash Data & Business Analytics Expert
description:
**Job title: Order to Cash Data & Business Analytics Expert**

* Location: Hyderabad

**About The Job**
Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability & interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health.
  
  
Our Order to Cash (O2C) team aims for excellence, equipping Sanofi with a robust core model, seconded with best of breed digital solutions embedding artificial intelligence and machine learning functionalities. Our international presence, our ambition to become a global reference player for all order to cash related processes mean that our team works on a variety of projects with opportunities for a rich mix of work. This leads to a challenging and stimulating professional experience full of growth and learning. Business Operations is a Global organization of Sanofi providing end to end services to all geographies in Europe, North America, China, JPAC & International regions and covering Global Procurement services, Operations and transition management, medical activities hub, People services, and Global Finance services. Global Finance services homedical following service lines O2C, A2R, Financial sanctions compliance.
  
  
Over the past two years, Global Finance Services has doubled in size and increased its scope. As one department within Business Operations, we’re also part of something much bigger. This provides opportunities for learning, growing, job moves and a diversified, fulfilling career. Order To Cash (O2C) service line, one of the pillars of Business Operations Finance services, is currently covering the following areas
  
  

* Master data Management
* Sales orders Management
* Requests and Disputes Management
* Credit Risk and Credit Data Management
* Collections and Customer Contact Management
* Cash Application and Receivables Management
* AR related Month-end Closing, Reporting and Non-trade Invoice Management

These operations are critical for customers & patients’ products fulfillment, accurate accounting, generating cash flow, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As Order to Cash Data & Business Analytics Expert within our Global Finance Services Order to Cash team, you'll turn data into insights that improve how we serve customers, collect cash, and run our processes. Ready to get started?
  
  
Join the team that powers Sanofi from within, streamlining how we work, scaling bold ideas, and accelerating impact across the business. In our Business Operations Hubs, you'll help shape smarter, data-driven Order to Cash processes (from sales orders to cash application) that support customers and help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. You'll work with colleagues across the globe, using analytics, automation, and AI to drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Build and improve dashboards, KPIs, and reports that help teams monitor efficiency, spot deviations, and follow process adherence.
* Analyze Order to Cash data and share clear, actionable insights with Global Process Leads, Business System Owners, and Hub teams.
* Translate business needs into Power BI visualizations and turn them into user stories and tasks for developers.
* Train and support colleagues so that data is understood, trusted, and used in everyday decisions.
* Put our data governance approach into practice, keeping data accurate, high quality, secure, and compliant.
* Resolve data quality issues at the source and work with other teams to align data definitions and data sharing across processes.
* Keep master and reference data consistent across systems and applications and check the accuracy of data from internal and external sources.

**About You**

* Experience: Proven experience in analytics and a strong understanding of Order to Cash activities, with good business sense.
* Technical skills: Hands-on experience with Power BI and RPA, and solid SAP knowledge. Experience with Agile ways of working, Jira/Confluence, Microsoft Lists, or Python is a plus.
* Soft skills: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, strong problem-solving and analytical thinking, and the ability to train others and present ideas clearly.
* A self-starter who takes initiative, works independently under pressure, and delivers excellent service to customers.
* Languages: Excellent English (written and spoken). Other European languages are an advantage.

**Why choose us?**

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention, and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

title: Client Analytics Business Partner
description:
**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation**

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary and performance base bonus opportunity, discussed in the hiring manager conversation

**Benefits**

* Work directly with Managing Directors and senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO's office
* Join a new team at the start, and help shape how it works
* Fast-track, transparent promotional structure, with a path to Senior Business Partner and team leadership
* Opportunity to attend Marcus Evans events
* International travel opportunities
* A friendly, dynamic and vibrant work environment

**Marcus Evans**
is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

Matrix Consulting is a contemporary financial consulting firm focused on comprehensive fundraising support for businesses across multiple industries, including Retail, Energy, Pharma, Agro, Shipping, Media, Entertainment, Automobile, Manufacturing, Trading, Hospital, IT, and Real Estate. The firm primarily serves Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) and large corporate institutions that drive economic growth and employment. Matrix Consulting works with a diverse range of promoters, from startups to second-generation entrepreneurs, helping them address challenges in expansion and organizational structuring. Day-to-day activities include building and maintaining financial models, performing variance and trend analysis, preparing data-driven reports and dashboards, and supporting due diligence for debt and equity transactions. The analyst will collaborate with consultants, finance professionals, and the internal CA team to interpret data, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable insights. The role also involves presenting findings to internal stakeholders, contributing to client presentations, and continuously improving data processes and methodologies.

Hyderabad

Full-Time

title: Senior Specialist, Business Analyst – MLR Review Capability (Veeva PromoMats)
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Specialist, Business Analyst – MLR Review Capability (Veeva PromoMats)**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**About Digital Human Health (DHH)**
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
  
  
Within DHH, Digital Content & Customer Experience (DCCE) supports the Content Accelerator by modernizing the end-to-end content operating model. The Content & Promotional Lifecycle Automation portfolio owns the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review capability, centered on Veeva Vault PromoMats and its integrations across the content ecosystem, so that promotional content is reviewed and approved compliantly, efficiently, and at scale.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Serve as the India hub’s senior, hands-on business and technical anchor for the MLR review capability—combining Veeva Vault PromoMats administration and configuration expertise with strong business analysis to translate MLR needs into scalable, standardized, and supportable solutions across markets.
  
  
Scope of Ownership & Adjacent Responsibilities
  
  
Own requirements, impact analysis, and configuration recommendations for PromoMats enhancements from intake through design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
  
  
Act as the go-to expert on the current Vault setup, driving configuration clean-up, rationalization, reuse, and standardization across markets and business processes.
  
  
Partner with the Product Owner/Product Manager on backlog maturity, prioritization, and release planning across configuration, integration, validation, and business readiness.
  
  
Collaborate with architecture and integration teams on PromoMats touchpoints with enterprise DAM, MedComms, content platforms, and identity/access services.
  
  
Flex into adjacent MLR priorities as the capability evolves, including automation and AI-assisted review opportunities, in partnership with the wider DCCE team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
PromoMats Administration & Technical Analysis
  
  
Analyze and support Veeva Vault PromoMats configuration, including document types, fields, lifecycles, workflows, states, roles, permissions, security profiles, sharing settings, objects, picklists, notifications, renditions, and document relationships.
  
  
Assess enhancement requests and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements, solution options, configuration specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Perform impact analysis across configuration, metadata, security, workflows, integrations, reporting, and downstream processes before changes are approved.
  
  
Review the existing Vault setup and identify opportunities for clean-up, rationalization, reuse, and standardization.
  
  
Product & Backlog Management
  
  
Mature, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog with the Product Owner/Product Manager based on business value, compliance needs, technical dependencies, and platform strategy.
  
  
Write high-quality user stories covering business intent, existing configuration, proposed behavior, technical considerations, and expected outcomes.
  
  
Ensure stories meet Definition of Ready with clear acceptance criteria, process flows, data/metadata requirements, security considerations, dependencies, and validation approach.
  
  
Facilitate refinement, solution design, sprint planning, release readiness, and post-deployment reviews with the global cross-functional team.
  
  
MLR Process & Integration Collaboration
  
  
Apply strong understanding of promotional content management and MLR review to ensure system changes support compliant and efficient ways of working.
  
  
Partner with business, architecture, and technical teams on integrations with enterprise DAM, MedComms, content ecosystems, identity/access services, and other connected platforms.
  
  
Document current- and future-state processes, data flows, integration touchpoints, decision rules, and exception scenarios.
  
  
Quality, Validation & Testing
  
  
Develop and review test scenarios, test cases, and traceability to confirm configured solutions meet approved requirements.
  
  
Coordinate system, regression, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment validation, and hypercare.
  
  
Ensure acceptance criteria address quality, compliance, and MLR risk considerations.
  
  
Documentation, Governance & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Maintain current documentation in JIRA, Confluence, and SharePoint, including requirements, configuration decisions, process maps, test evidence, and release artifacts.
  
  
Support end-to-end traceability across requirements, design decisions, configuration, testing, approvals, and deployment.
  
  
Proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience in MLR review solutions and processes.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
PromoMats changes are delivered with clear impact analysis, fewer defects, and minimal rework or production issues.
  
  
A cleaner, more standardized Vault configuration that is easier to support and scale across markets.

title: Specialist, Business Analyst – AI Content Creation (Content Creation & Storage)
description:
**Job Description**
**Specialist, Business Analyst – AI Content Creation (Content Creation & Storage)**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**About Digital Human Health (DHH)**
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
  
  
Within DHH, the Content Creation & Storage pillar of Digital Content & Customer Experience (DCCE) builds the platforms and capabilities that help Human Health create compliant, on-brand content faster. As part of the Content Accelerator, the pillar is moving content creation from manual production to AI-generated content that is built to brand and compliance standards from the start, combining agentic content creation platform, Adobe capabilities (including Adobe Brand Intelligence and Adobe Firefly), design system, and AEM/DAM foundations.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Act as hands-on business and product partner for AI-enabled content creation, working closely with business users and vendor teams to shape, test, and evolve GenAI and agentic capabilities, and building the internal knowledge needed to confidently own custom components as the platform landscape evolves.
  
  
**Scope Of Ownership & Adjacent Responsibilities**

* Support the AI Content creation workstream experiment design, requirements, testing, and assessment of where Adobe capabilities can replace or complement custom-built components.
* Build working ownership of custom agentic components. Understand how they work, maintain requirements and backlog, and guide their evolution with engineering and vendor teams.
* Support the Adobe Firefly rollout across Human Health access and onboarding inputs, playbook and enablement content, usage reporting, and user feedback loops.
* Work closely with content creators, brand teams, and reviewers to capture real feedback, prioritize the most important items, and turn them into fast, practical iterations.
* Flex across adjacent workstreams in the pillar (e.g., design system, guardrails/rules, AEM/DAM) as priorities shift.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Analysis & Product Ownership Support**

* Translate business and workflow needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI-enabled content creation capabilities.
* Maintain and prioritize backlogs in partnership with the Product Owner; support sprint planning, refinement, and release readiness.
* Map current-state and future-state content creation workflows, identifying where AI and agents add value and where human review remains essential.
* Facilitate UAT with business, brand, and compliance stakeholders; track defects, gaps, and fixes through to closure.

**Hands-on GenAI & Agentic Delivery (Embedded with the Business)**

* Work hands-on with GenAI and agentic tools to test, configure, and validate capabilities (e.g., prompts, agent inputs/outputs, brand rules, assembly and validation steps).
* Sit close to business users during pilots and early rollout observe real usage, unblock issues quickly, and feed priority learnings back into the backlog.
* Design and run structured experiments with clear scope, success criteria, test assets, and results (e.g., accuracy, false-flag rate, turnaround time, rework).
* Build a working understanding of component architecture, integrations, and APIs to have informed discussions with engineering and vendors.

**Platform & Vendor Collaboration (Adobe and Partners)**

* Serve as a day-to-day contact for Adobe and implementation partners on ABI and Firefly align on scope, prerequisites, dependencies, and timelines.
* Assess build vs. buy trade-offs for components (custom vs. platform capability) and document recommendations with risks and dependencies.
* Review vendor deliverables (playbooks, guides, configurations) to confirm fit needs and governance.

**Documentation, Governance & Communication**

* Maintain a clear source of truth (e.g., Confluence, JIRA) covering requirements, decisions, test results, and component documentation.
* Embed compliance-by-design human-in-the-loop controls, AI labeling, auditability, and alignment with AI and content policies.
* Prepare crisp updates, MoMs, and decision summaries for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

**What Success Looks Like**

* We have internal capability to understand, maintain, and evolve custom content creation components with reduced dependence on vendors.
* ABI experiments run to plan with clear results that support evidence-based platform decisions.
* Firefly adoption grows across Human Health with users onboarded, enabled, and supported within guardrails.
* Business feedback turns into prioritized improvements quickly, with visible gains in turnaround time, rework, and first-time-right content.
* Requirements, decisions, and component documentation are current, traceable, and reusable.

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred.
  
  
**Experience**

* 4–5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Product Manager/Owner, or similar role in digital products or technology delivery.
* Hands-on experience with GenAI tools or solutions, e.g., building, configuring, or testing prompts, AI workflows, agents, or LLM-based applications—beyond awareness level.
* Exposure to agentic AI concepts (agents, orchestration, tool use, human-in-the-loop) and practical experience in pilots, proofs of concept, or early rollouts.
* Experience working directly with business users in a delivery-embedded or customer-facing role, turning feedback into rapid iterations.
* Strong requirements, user story, and process mapping skills; experience in Agile/Scrum with tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Working technical literacy APIs, integrations, data inputs/outputs, and the ability to engage credibly with engineers and vendors.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to work across a geographically distributed team (India, Europe, US).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with Adobe content ecosystem (Firefly, GenStudio, Express, AEM Assets, Workfront) or similar marketing/content technology.
* Familiarity with design systems or Figma-based creative workflows.
* Experience in pharma or other regulated environments; awareness of MLR/content review and AI governance considerations.
* Experience with prompt engineering, basic scripting (e.g., Python), or low-code/AI agent builders.

**Key Competencies**

* Business-first problem solving with a bias for hands-on delivery
* Ownership and learning agility in fast-changing AI platforms
* Clear, concise communication and decision-ready documentation
* Collaboration across business, engineering, and vendor partners
