title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.

 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.

 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

 

**About the role**

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The
**Senior Business Analyst**
(BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge.

* Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold.

* Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval.

* Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity.

* Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall.

* Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency.

* Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability.

* Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each.

* Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins.

* Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release.

* Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

 

**Deliverables Owned by This Role**

 

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams.

* Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD).

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

* Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report.

* Exception handling and business continuity procedure.

* End-user training material, SOPs and user guides.

* Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover.

* Post-implementation benefit realisation report.

 

**Must Have Qualifications:**

 

* 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on
  **Intelligent Automation, RPA (e.g., UiPath)**
  , or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity.

* Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing.

* Demonstrable expertise in authoring rigorous PDDs and collaborating on SDDs with strict traceability.

* Strong track record operating within Agile frameworks, serving as the definitive translation layer between executive business stakeholders and technical engineering pods.

* Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath and/or Blue Prism.

* Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase.

 

**Strong Plus:**

 

* UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA).

* Domain depth in Banking and Financial Services, particularly regulated processes with audit and control requirements.

**What We Offer**

 

* **A truly international environment,**

  collaborating on global automation projects.

* **The opportunity to experiment and innovate**

  with Agentic 
  **AI solutions**

  as we pioneer and rebrand our offering in the consultancy space

* Work at the 
  **core of the automation and AI wave**

   — we’re a 
  **pure-play automation company**

   fully focused on innovation and future-ready solutions.
* A 
  **growth-focused environment**

   where you’re empowered to 
  **develop**

  , 
  **excel**

  , and 
  **contribute meaningfully**

   — no corporate silos, no red tape.
* This is 
  **not your standard corporate job**

   — we value initiative over hierarchy, and you’ll have room to make a real impact from day one.
* A 
  **vibrant team culture**

  , collaborative spirit and culture you can’t experience anywhere else!

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Business Analyst- Government Projects
description:
**About Niti Aide**

Niti Aide builds AI and digital solutions for government: dashboards for senior officers, citizen-facing WhatsApp and web assistants, and monitoring platforms for departments and public bodies. We are empanelled with NISG and work with bodies such as HMWSSB, GHMC, SERP and TGMSIDC across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. We’re a small, founder-led team, and the work you bring in is the work we build.

**The role**

This is not a desk BA job. You’ll spend 3–4 days a week inside government offices, meeting officers, understanding how departments actually run, and finding problems worth solving. Then you’ll work with our product and tech team to turn those problems into solutions, and follow through until the work order is signed.

You’ll own a set of departments end to end, from first meeting to signed work order, and you’ll be measured on it.

**What you’ll do**

* Visit government offices regularly and build working relationships with officers and their teams
* Run discovery conversations: how the department works, what data it has, which reviews it faces, and where it struggles
* Turn those conversations into clear one-page problem statements
* Co-design solutions with the founders and tech team
* Present concept notes, proposals and demos to officers
* Track tenders, RFPs, empanelments and nomination opportunities
* Follow up persistently on meetings, file movement and approvals until the work order comes through
* Maintain a clean pipeline of departments, stakeholders and next steps

**Who we’re looking for**

* MBA (2024–26 batch), or 1–3 years in B2B, institutional or field sales, or consulting
* Confident, well-presented and mature in conversation. You should be able to hold your own with senior officers, and we’ll coach you on the rest.
* A structured thinker who can turn a messy one-hour meeting into a crisp problem statement
* Fluent in Telugu, with strong spoken and written English
* Comfortable with Docs, Sheets and slides, and curious about AI. No coding needed.
* Willing to travel within Hyderabad and occasionally to districts and Amaravati. A two-wheeler or car is preferred.

**Strong advantages**

* Internship or work experience with a governance consulting firm, govtech company, PMU, or an industry body (CII, FICCI, NASSCOM)
* Any prior exposure to government departments or tenders

**This role is not for you if**

* You want a 10-to-6 desk job
* You’d rather document problems than chase them to a signed work order
* You’re uncomfortable following up five times to get one meeting

**What you get**

* ₹4–8 LPA, depending on experience and how you perform in the interview, plus conveyance and incentives on every work order you help bring in
* A clear path to Senior Business Analyst / Manager within 12–18 months, based on accounts you convert
* Direct work with the founders and real ownership from month one
* A first-hand view of how the state actually runs

**How to apply: walk in**

📅 Wednesday, 21 October (10 AM – 8 PM), or Thursday, 22 October and Friday, 23 October (9 AM – 12 PM)

📍 Niti Aide, 4th Floor, Mr Prime, Kondapur, Hyderabad

Come dressed the way you’d walk into a government office, and bring one idea:

*El Niño has hit this year. Which Telangana government department would you pitch a technology solution to, and what would you pitch?*

One page, your own thinking. That’s your first interview.

A

specializes in building complete enterprise web applications using Microsoft's .NET ecosystem for the backend and React for the frontend. Also, you're expected to architect solutions, mentor junior developers, and own entire features from design through production.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Frontend Development: Building responsive, performant user interfaces with React, managing state, and implementing complex UI interactions
* Backend Development: Designing and implementing APIs using .NET (C# with ASP.NET Core or Framework), managing business logic, and ensuring system reliability
* Database Design: Creating efficient SQL Server schemas, optimizing queries, and ensuring data integrity
* System Architecture: Contributing to decisions about application structure, scalability, and integration patterns

* Code Quality: Writing clean, maintainable code following SOLID principles and conducting code reviews
* Testing: Implementing unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests across both layers
* Deployment & DevOps: Managing CI/CD pipelines, deploying to Azure or on-premises servers, and monitoring applications
* Problem-Solving: Debugging issues that span React frontend, .NET backend, and SQL Server database
* Collaboration: Working with designers, product managers, QA, and other developers

title: Senior Data Analytics
description:
**Senior Data Analyst – Analytics**

**About AssetMark**

AssetMark is a leading wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial advisors. AssetMark's mission is to enable financial advisors to make a profound difference in the lives of their clients. Over 10,000 advisors partner with AssetMark for our investment offerings, innovative technology, advanced services, and expertise, which they use to delight their clients and grow their businesses. We are an integrated team of technologists, investment professionals, and operations experts working to help our clients stay at the pioneering front of wealth management.

Join our Analytics team and drive data-driven decision-making across the wealth management business. Using advanced SQL, financial services expertise, and stakeholder management skills, you'll lead analytical projects, uncover actionable insights, develop reporting solutions, and provide strategic recommendations. You'll collaborate with teams across India and the US, mentor junior analysts, and help build a strong analytics capability within the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Advanced Data Analysis & Business Insights:**
  Lead complex analytical initiatives using advanced SQL and structured analytical techniques to identify business trends, uncover performance drivers, investigate anomalies, and deliver actionable insights that influence business decisions.
* **Financial Services & Wealth Management Analytics:**
  Apply strong financial services domain knowledge, including wealth management, investment products, portfolio services, advisor operations, and client accounts, to analyze business performance and recommend improvements aligned with organizational objectives.
* **Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership:**
  Independently engage with business leaders, product owners, operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand business priorities, challenge assumptions, gather requirements, manage expectations, and translate complex business questions into analytical solutions.
* **Advanced SQL & Data Investigation:**
  Design, develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries to extract, integrate, transform, and analyze large datasets across multiple data sources while ensuring analytical accuracy, performance, and consistency.
* **Reporting, KPIs & Performance Analytics:**
  Own the development and enhancement of business reporting, dashboards, KPIs, and analytical frameworks to measure business performance, identify opportunities, and support operational and strategic decision-making.
* **Complex Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis:**
  Independently investigate ambiguous business problems, formulate hypotheses, perform detailed root cause analysis, evaluate potential solutions, and provide evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders.
* **Data Quality & Analytical Governance:**
  Partner with data engineering, data governance, and business teams to ensure the reliability, accuracy, consistency, and appropriate interpretation of data used for business reporting and analysis.
* **Business Communication & Data Storytelling:**
  Synthesize complex analytical findings into clear, compelling business narratives and present insights, recommendations, and potential business impacts to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* **AI-Enabled Analytics & Automation:**
  Responsibly leverage AI-assisted tools and analytical automation to improve SQL development, data exploration, reporting efficiency, documentation, and analytical problem-solving while maintaining appropriate quality and data protection standards.
* **Analytical Leadership & Mentorship:**
  Provide technical and analytical guidance to junior analysts, review analytical outputs, share domain knowledge, and promote consistent analytical methodologies and best practices across the team.
* **Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Identify opportunities to streamline reporting, automate recurring analyses, standardize business metrics, and improve analytical processes while contributing to agile ceremonies and globally distributed team initiatives.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **5–8 years of experience**
  in data analytics, business analytics, financial services analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical role.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Extensive hands-on experience using SQL for complex business analysis, data investigation, reporting, and insight generation.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing analytical initiatives, engaging business stakeholders, defining analytical requirements, and delivering actionable business recommendations.
* Prior experience in financial services, wealth management, investment management, fintech, or related industries is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with cross-functional and globally distributed teams, including direct collaboration with business stakeholders and leadership.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring junior analysts, reviewing analytical deliverables, or contributing to analytical standards and best practices is preferred.

title: Operations Consultant
description:
**Role: Operations Consultant**

**Who We Are:**

Streamliners is a management consulting firm specialized in rapid efficiency improvements, operational excellence, and fast turnaround. We help manufacturers and private equity owned portfolio companies in North America and Europe solve complex operational challenges to maximize profit margins and gain competitive advantage. At our core, we are doers. We work closely with clients in various industries to execute the steps required to achieve performance improvements.

**Who You Are:**

A experienced and self-directed problem solver. A change management champion. You not only work well with others, but also can operate autonomously with little direction. You go the extra mile, and your entrepreneurial drive and intellectual curiosity have helped you garner a track-record of achievement.

You should feel second nature conducting & leading the following analysis:

* Process Capacity & Utilization Modeling
* Bottleneck Analysis
* Waste Reduction
* Warehouse Restructuring
* KPI Creation
* Root Cause Analysis
* Workforce Analysis

**The Role:**

You will work alongside other consultants and clients, typically on site, to deliver transformation objectives. You will have ownership of workstreams and be responsible for executing effective improvement plans within operations, ranging from shop floor improvements to fundamental changes in work processes and information and material flows. You’ll also serve clients in a project manager capacity for turnarounds, transformations, and expansions.

**Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Serve as project leader for project workstreams, transformations, and turnarounds
* Problem-solve technical manufacturing issues using structured methodologies
* Use facts and data to prioritize improvement opportunities
* You will adopt a process-oriented approach to solving problems and will break a large complex problem into a series of smaller, more manageable modules.
* Drive change and improvements to the overall execution of client operations
* Transform manufacturing processes for better productivity and efficiency
* Conduct due diligence, benchmarking, best practice, and other assessment studies
* Recommend actions and help clients implement them
* Manage and deliver the highest quality client work

**Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience in a high-performance manufacturing environment
* 3+ years leadership and management experience
* Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics), Operations, or Business
* Strong functional knowledge in one or more of the following: discrete manufacturing, project management, process automation, continuous improvement
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with people at all levels in an organization
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* **Willingness to travel to US and Europe 2 or 3 months in year**

**Preferred:**

* Background in Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt is a plus) and methodologies including but not limited to Kaizen methods, JIT, Kanban, SMED, 5S, Poka Yoke, Visual Workplace, and VSM
* Experience in management consulting, large-scale change management, or turnaround and restructurings
* Direct operating experience with P&L accountability
* International work experience

title: Specialist Deputy Manager, Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) - Transformation and Optimization - Data Strategist - Hyderabad
description:

**Position Summary**
The incumbent will work with Enterprise Operations Xcellence Transformation and Optimization (ETO) team’s Data & Analytics function, helping build and run a central data & analytics platform that serves all EOX teams with trusted data, models, and reporting. The role frames problems, builds and runs scenario and trade-off analyses, designs data models and reporting frameworks, and develops clear, well-supported recommendations for stakeholders and leadership — while also stewarding the underlying data (architecture, cataloging, standards, and quality) so the platform remains a reliable, reusable asset rather than a one-off deliverable.

title: Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst
description:
**Aliases:**
Senior EHR Data Implementation Analyst (Epic/Cerner), Lead, Healthcare Data Exchange and Interoperability, Senior Clinical Data Mapping and Integration Analyst, Healthcare Data Ingestion and Interoperability Engineer, Senior Clinical Informatics Analyst - Data Integration, Healthcare Implementation Consultant - Data.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we're building a world-class team to help us scale this mission, and high-quality, well-integrated health data is at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
*This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad, India.*
**Who We Need**
Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.
  
  
**This Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst to lead and support the onboarding of member data into the Truveta platform. This role is central to ensuring high-quality, well-integrated data that meets clinical, research, and operational needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about working with complex healthcare datasets, uncovering patterns in disparate source systems, and building scalable processes that make downstream analytics efficient and reliable. You will work closely with external member teams and internal engineering stakeholders to profile, map, validate, and automate data ingestion workflows, bringing hands-on experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts and with healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, and CCDA.
  
  
Working from the Truveta India Development Center, you will partner every day with engineering, product, and member teams in the United States, so regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) business hours is part of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead onboarding of data from member source systems and third-party sources into the Truveta platform.
* Partner with external technical and clinical teams to understand source data structures, workflows, and business context.
* Perform comprehensive data profiling to assess completeness, quality, conformance, and integrity.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mappings aligned to platform data models and standards.
* Define, implement, and validate business and data transformation rules.
* Design and support test automation strategies for onboarding workflows, including validation and regression testing.
* Document onboarding methodologies, transformation logic, data quality findings, and validation processes to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Provide clear, timely communication to stakeholders, from customer-facing discussions to deep technical design sessions.
* Continuously improve onboarding processes to increase scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

**Experience**

* Subject matter expertise in clinical applications and an understanding of how healthcare data supports clinicians, researchers, and patients.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare industry terminology and concepts.
* Hands-on experience with data profiling tools, data quality analysis, and visualization technologies.
* Deep understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and translate business workflows into technical specifications.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and external partners.
* A track record of producing comprehensive documentation of methodologies, processes, and findings that supports reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Self-starter with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or related analytical field.
* 6+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or healthcare data implementation roles.
* 3+ years of implementation experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts.
* 3+ years of experience analyzing large datasets, with strong proficiency in SQL and Python or R.
* Demonstrated experience with data profiling, source-to-target mapping, and validation testing.
* Experience supporting customer or partner engagement during technical implementations.
* Experience translating clinical workflows into informatics or analytics applications.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange standards (HL7, FHIR, CCDA) and clinical ontologies (ICD, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, CPT, NDC).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with both customer-facing and highly technical audiences.
* Ability to collaborate across time zones in a distributed team, with regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a health system or healthcare technology company.
* Experience with modern cloud-native platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Hands-on experience with healthcare integration engines such as Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, or Cloverleaf.
* Experience delivering data implementations for US health system clients from a global delivery or offshore engineering center.

title: PE-T&S Payments Specialist

title: EYP-VME-EA-Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Analyst – Economic Advisory**
As part of our EY-Valuations team, you will help clients understand the value of their business, securities, intellectual property, capital equipment, intangibles and other assets. The group is comprised of several key areas, including business valuation, business modelling, capital equipment, economics and complex securities
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for Senior Analyst with expertise in Economic Advisory to join EY-VME (Valuation, Modelling and Economics). This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a prominent firm and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct economic analyses, including market trends, policy impacts, and cost-benefit assessments, to support client projects.
* Develop and maintain economic and financial models to evaluate the implications of strategic initiatives and policy proposals.
* Analyse macroeconomic, microeconomic, and industry-specific data to generate actionable insights for decision-making.
* Prepare detailed reports, presentations, and visualizations that communicate findings to clients and stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement economic research and advisory projects.
* Monitor and interpret economic indicators, trends, and global developments to inform client strategies.
* Support policy and program evaluations for government agencies, non-profits, and private organizations.
* Mentor junior analysts, providing guidance on research techniques, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Participate in business development activities, including client proposals, thought leadership, and networking events.
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives and tailor valuation solutions accordingly.
* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Identify issues and propose strategies related to the procedures executed.
* Assume a steering role in report generation and detailed financial modelling.
* Maintain and develop positive, productive, and professional relationships with EY offices globally.
* Demonstrate teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members.
* Use current technology and tools to enhance the effectiveness of services provided.
* Identify business development opportunities and assist Partners and Senior Managers on proposals and new business opportunities.
* Stay abreast of current business and economic developments relevant to our as well as the client's business.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Excellent thoughtfulness, project management, communication, interpersonal and teaming skills
* Experience in Research and impact analysis
* Experience in financial modelling, quantitative techniques, MS Excel and related software preferred
* Advanced knowledge and experience in any of the following sectors will be added advantage – Financial Services, Oil and Gas, Technology, Consumer Products, Power and Utilities and Life Science
* Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary
* Exposure to databases such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg etc.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A post graduate degree in Finance, Economics or Business with 3 to 4 years of related work experience
* A minimum of 3 to 4 years direct experience in performing economic impact analysis studies, econometric analysis, sustainability and macro and micro economic studies and their forecasted impact on economies and companies.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of a market-prominent, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: FY27 | USI | Audit and Assurance | Associate Senior Assistant, Product Strategy & Management
description:

**Position Summary**
**Associate Senior Assistant, Product Strategy & Management, Audit and Assurance**

The Customer Success Product Analyst helps customers and stakeholders realize greater value from business products by resolving complex issues, analyzing product and support data, and identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes. Working across several product teams and service providers, this experienced individual contributor translates customer insights into practical product, process, and support improvements while contributing to product strategy and prioritization.
  
  
This role is designed for someone who can operate with limited supervision, exercise sound judgment, and demonstrate critical thinking skills and agility.

* Investigate tickets that cannot be resolved by first-level support resources.
* Demonstrate an ability to look beyond published guidance, when needed, to resolve issues.
* Analyze ticket trends, recurring issues, root causes, and resolution patterns to identify opportunities for short-term resolution workarounds and long-term improvement.
* Identify trends, patterns, trouble areas, forecasts, and opportunities for product, process, and customer-experience improvement.

Customer Success and Stakeholder Engagement-
  
  

* Collaborate with Customer Success and product team members to understand and communicate customer needs, pain points, and satisfaction drivers.
* Serve as a bridge between technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring that customer requirements and business needs are clearly understood.
* Support customer and stakeholder conversations through evidence-based insights, clear issue framing, and practical recommendations.

Process Improvement, Knowledge Management, and Training -
  
  

* Research and propose process-improvement initiatives.

title: Apprentice
description:
**Grow your career at State Street**
From technology and product innovation to corporate responsibility and community development, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. We’re a global company with diverse people and varied experiences with a network of over 35,000 employees spanning more than 100 markets. For us, success comes from the impact our employees have – on our clients, our communities and each other.
  
  
We’re committed to provide an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued and supported. Join us and make your mark at State Street.
  
  
**Open Positions for Finance Graduates**
The global financial services industry is undergoing rapid change. Now more than ever the industry is looking for the talent and vision of the next generation of business leaders. State Street sits at the very center of the global financial system. Our role is to provide the financial infrastructure and services that make it possible for the world’s largest investors to make the most efficient use of the world’s capital.
  
  
Seeking exceptional Graduates! Are you looking to start your career with an internationally recognized brand? Do you have the drive and ambition to achieve the very best? Then our Graduate Opportunity jobs are just what you are looking for.
  
  
Our graduate jobs are designed to develop graduates both technically and professionally towards becoming our future leaders and Finance experts. You’ll learn from some of the most respected highly-qualified people in the industry and be supported by individual mentors and development programs.
  
  
We recruit graduates on a year-round basis into the following areas:
  
  

* Fund Accountant
* Financial Reporting Specialist
* Derivatives Specialist
* Financial Accountant
* Treasury Accountant
* Transfer Agency Administrator
* Middle Office Administrator
* Pricing Administrator
* Risk Analyst
* Compliance Analyst
* Data Management Analyst
* Anti-Money Laundering Specialist

These fantastic jobs are ideal for motivated graduates looking to start careers within financial services. The real focus will be on personal and professional development with structured career progression. If you are a graduate or already have some professional experience and would like to start a career in financial services you are welcome.
  
  
Please find below some of the popular jobs.
  
  
**Fund Accountant**
The Fund Accountant is responsible for calculating the net asset values of funds by processing daily accounting related functions to ensure funds prices are accurate and delivered to the client in a timely fashion. The Fund Accountant is the central point of contact for all accounting support functions and analyzes the information received thereby ensuring any discrepancy is monitored and resolved professionally.
  
  
**Financial Reporting Specialist**
The Financial Reporting Accountant is responsible for preparing financial statements for annual and interim cycle. They also prepare and complete first draft of audited annual and un-audited interim financial statements from trial balance including Profit and Loss Account Balance Sheet Cash Flow Schedule of Investments notes to financial statements.
  
  
**Derivatives Specialist**
The team deals with the complex futures and options processing for the entire European exchange traded derivatives, Centre of Excellence book of business and supplementary business offshored from other State Street sites. The Derivatives Group is the central point of contact for the clearing banks and client service teams on all sites.
  
  
Other services include some cash instructions and the improvement of processes for recording derivative instruments accurately and efficiently.
  
  
**Financial Accountant**
Financial Accountant performs the accounting processes that may include [but is not limited to]: accounting documents processing, journal processing, payments preparation, account reconciliation preparation and verification of the reports performing other projects as assigned etc.
  
  
**Treasury Accountant**
Treasury Accountant performs the treasury processes that may include [but is not limited to]: treasury transactions processing (money market stock market), prepare/approve payments, collateral management/margins, monitor minimum required reserve in national central bank, reconciliation bank accounts (cash positions balance sheet) reports, performing other projects as assigned etc.
  
  
**Transfer Agency Administrator**
Transfer Agency Administrator is responsible for trade processing, investor account maintenance, issue reporting and resolution. You will be responsible for processing investor transaction: review documentation to ensure anti-money laundering documentation has been received and enter subscription on ISS and save documentation on to DMS.
  
  
**Middle Office Administrator**
Middle Office Administrator is responsible for processing trade file submitted by the Fund daily on trade-date, trade-date confirmation (electronic telephonic or hard copy) based upon the trade file transmitted by the Fund and trade details provided by the Fund’s approved counter parties and monitor trade fails with prime brokers counter parties and the Fund including review of prime broker/custodian fail or mismatch of reports.
  
  
**Pricing Administrator**
Pricing Administrator’s role is to assist in the accurate and efficient pricing of a range of securities held by investment funds. The principal tasks of this role is to price exchange traded securities and validation to sources such as Bloomberg Reuters and FTID.
  
  
**Risk Analyst**
The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) division within State Street Corporation establishes and maintains appropriate risk management policies guidelines and limits and assists executive and business-level management with minimizing operational credit legal regulatory reputation and other risks to the company.
  
  
**Compliance Analyst**
Investment Compliance Analyst will be responsible for monitoring compliance results on client portfolios related to Regulatory and Investment Manager (IM) mandates. Utilizing State Street’s Investment Compliance & Reporting platform the qualified candidate will complete the research analysis and reporting to ensure portfolios are in compliance with their investment restrictions.
  
  
**Data Management Analyst**
The Data Analyst(s) will be responsible to work comprehensively with both IT and the Investment Compliance/Market, Conformity Business Units to procure data necessary for daily compliance and conformity checks. Furthermore the Data Analyst will be responsible for the update and maintenance of market data, static data and holdings data that is not otherwise fed to the core application MIG 21 via automated data feeds.
  
  
**Anti-Money Laundering Specialist**
Anti-Money Laundering Specialist will be involved in reviewing investor Anti Money Laundering documentation in line with the AML policies and liaising with the Transfer Agency team’s in order to request and obtain the required data from the investors and/or clients
  
  
**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* You are a well-rounded student with a combination of academic aptitude, analytical capabilities, and excellent communication skills
* Majoring in Finance, Accounting, or Economics preferred. Any other major is also valid.
* Desire to develop Your career in finance industry
* Involvement with student organizations would be an added advantage
* Good written and spoken English
* Basic experience with MS Office
* Display a culture of individual ownership of tasks to embed a clear individual sense of accountability in performing the role
* Ensure that the highest level of the Code of Conduct is displayed in your behavior
* Provide appropriate management information as required to support business unit decision making
* Support the ‘Risk Excellence’ culture within the business
* Adhere to limits of delegation and escalation procedures required by your manager so that you comply with internal policies and external regulations

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
  
  
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Data Governance Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have in This Role
  
  
The Technology Data Office (TDO) is responsible for improving the quality, consistency, and trustworthiness of technology data across DTCC by providing data governance oversight in a systematic and federated manner.
  
  
As a Senior Associate within the Technology Data Office, you will play a critical role in operationalizing DTCC’s Data Governance Policy, Standards, and Procedures across assigned business and functional domains. This role focuses on executing and supporting day‑to‑day data governance and data stewardship activities that strengthen governance, accountability, compliance, and data quality—ensuring enterprise standards are applied consistently.
  
  
This position operates in a fast‑paced environment with shifting priorities and works closely with agile, cross‑functional delivery teams, data stewards, data owners, project managers, and technology partners to reduce data risk and improve Data Office adoption across the enterprise.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**
Data Governance & Stewardship Execution
  
  

* Develop, implement, and maintain data governance standards, guidelines, procedures, job aids, and best practices.
* Actively review and update governance documentation to reflect emerging industry standards and evolving enterprise needs.
* Partner with stakeholders and end users to enforce governance standards or remediate non‑standard data usage.
* Develop and maintain metadata repositories and enterprise data catalogs.
* Provide guidance to projects and delivery teams on data governance principles and requirements.

Data Quality Management & Reporting
  
  

* Assist in the identification, documentation, onboarding, tracking, and management of Data Quality Exceptions.
* Coordinate remediation efforts with data owners and data stewards, including evidence collection and validation.
* Monitor, analyze, and report on data quality metrics, KPIs, and trends.
* Design and maintain Power BI governance dashboards.
* Implement automated data quality metrics and KPIs to support transparent reporting and measurement of governance program progress.

Collaboration, Enablement & Adoption
  
  

* Collaborate with and support data stewards across the enterprise on governance and data quality best practices.
* Conduct education sessions and working sessions with Data Stewards to align on governance standards, reporting, and expectations.
* Drive awareness and adoption of Technology Data Office standards and practices.

Risk, Issue & Delivery Support
  
  

* Assist in risk and issue management related to data governance and data quality.
* Align risk and control processes into day‑to‑day responsibilities, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Work closely with project managers and Scrum Masters to create and update project plans where governance activities are required.
* Partner within agile, cross‑functional delivery teams to ensure data governance requirements are clearly understood and incorporated into solutions.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in data governance, data quality, data stewardship, metadata management, or data management within an enterprise environment.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience supporting data governance and stewardship activities within a business or functional domain.

Talent Needed for Success
  
  

* Strong understanding of data governance concepts, including: - Data Elements (DEs) and Critical Data Elements (CDEs)
* Metadata and data lineage
* Data quality rules, metrics, and exception management
* Ability to analyze datasets to identify data issues, inconsistencies, and risks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in ambiguity.

Tools, Frameworks & Methodologies
  
  

* DAMA‑DMBOK framework (conceptual understanding required; implementation experience a plus)
* Collibra (data catalog, governance workflows)
* Monte Carlo (data quality / observability)
* Power BI (governance dashboards and reporting)
* Experience working in Agile, cross‑functional delivery environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in regulated or risk‑sensitive environments.
* Background in data stewardship with progression into governance‑focused responsibilities.
* CDMP certification (preferred but not required).

In this role, you will implement data quality, data catalogue, lineage, and access governance activities on the Snowflake platform while collaborating with data owners, data stewards, Analytics, Data Science, and Data Governance teams. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
  
  
**When & Where**
Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Discover Your Role**

* Profile assigned data assets within Snowflake to assess completeness, consistency, accuracy, uniqueness, and timeliness, producing reports that support data quality rule prioritization.
* Implement and monitor data quality rules using Snowflake Data Metric Functions, Dynamic Data Masking, and Row Access Policies, following agreed rule logic and coding standards.
* Generate exception reports and dashboards, track remediation activities, and raise issues or ambiguities to senior team members when needed.
* Maintain the Data Quality Rule Register, ensuring rule logic, thresholds, rationale, and change history documentation remain accurate and current.
* Manage catalogue entries within Horizon and support the documentation and validation of data lineage, classifications, ownership assignments, and provenance records.
* Support Snowflake role-based access control (RBAC) governance activities, access certification reviews, audit evidence preparation, and Data Marketplace catalogue management.
* You actively develop expertise in Snowflake governance and data quality practices while seeking feedback and continuous learning opportunities.
* You collaborate effectively with technical and business partners, sharing progress, supporting team objectives, and helping maintain high governance standards.

**This Role Requires**

* Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of relevant experience; advanced degree may be considered with 2+ years of relevant experience.
* Foundational hands-on experience with Snowflake, or a strong demonstrated ability and eagerness to rapidly develop Snowflake expertise, including SQL, Data Metric Functions, and Row Access Policies.
* Proficiency in SQL with the ability to write and review data quality rule logic and perform basic data transformations.
* Understanding of data quality concepts, including profiling techniques and quality dimensions such as completeness, consistency, accuracy, uniqueness, and timeliness.
* Knowledge of data governance principles, including metadata management, data ownership, and data catalogue practices.
* Ability to create clear, structured documentation, reports, dashboards, and governance records for technical and business audiences.
* Familiarity with Snowflake Horizon catalogue management, lineage documentation, classifications, and ownership assignment processes.
* Understanding of access governance concepts, including role-based access control (RBAC) and access certification activities.
* Exposure to a regulated industry, preferably pharmaceutical, or awareness of data integrity principles in a compliance-focused environment.
* Snowflake SnowPro Core certification or active progress toward certification.
* Familiarity with data catalogue platforms.
* Basic Python or dbt experience supporting data transformation activities.
* Exposure to data lineage concepts or related tooling.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance tools and practices.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and raise blockers appropriately.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage data owners and business partners on routine governance matters.
* Conscientious, diligent, collaborative, reliable, and committed to accuracy in governance and documentation activities.

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
← Back to careers
  
  
Founder's Office
  
  
Founder's Office Intern
  
  
Location Anywhere in India (IST / similar timezone)
  
  
Experience Final-year student or recent graduate; prior internship or project ownership preferred
  
  
Employment Internship (3–6 months)
  
  
Compensation Competitive stipend
  
  
Reporting to Founders
  
  
**About The Role**
Qonfido is building an AI companion for money, helping people organise, understand, and grow their wealth with clarity and confidence.
  
  
As a Founder's Office Intern, you will sit at the centre of the company: close to strategy, product, data, and day-to-day execution. This is not a shadowing internship. You will own real workstreams, present recommendations to founders, and help turn ambiguity into decisions and decisions into shipped outcomes.
  
  
You will move across strategy setting, data analysis, product management support, AI optimisation, and operational follow-through, learning how a modern fintech startup actually runs.
  
  
If you are curious, structured, comfortable with AI tools, and energised by solving messy problems end to end, this role is for you.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
Strategy & Problem Framing
  
  

* Help founders frame weekly and monthly priorities: what matters, why now, and what success looks like.
* Turn open-ended questions into crisp problem statements, options, and recommendation memos.
* Support competitive, market, and customer research that informs product and growth bets.
* Track strategic initiatives from idea → decision → owner → next milestone.

Data Analysis & Insights
  
  

* Pull, clean, and analyse product, growth, and operational data to answer founder questions quickly.
* Build lightweight dashboards, scorecards, and recurring insight notes (what changed, why it matters, what to do).
* Validate hypotheses with evidence (not vibes) and flag risks, anomalies, and opportunities early.
* Translate analysis into clear visuals and one-page briefs founders can act on.

Product Management Support
  
  

* Support discovery: user interviews, feedback synthesis, journey mapping, and opportunity sizing.
* Help write PRDs, specs, acceptance criteria, and release checklists for priority initiatives.
* Coordinate across design, engineering, and go-to-market to keep scope, timelines, and dependencies visible.
* Run QA / dogfooding passes, document bugs/edge cases, and close the loop after launches.

AI Optimisation & Workflow Design
  
  

* Identify repetitive Founder Office and team workflows that AI can compress or improve.
* Design and document prompts, agents, and SOPs for research, writing, analysis, QA, and reporting.
* Experiment with tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Notion AI, spreadsheet copilots) and measure time saved / quality lift.
* Help the team adopt better AI habits: templates, evaluation checklists, and versioned workflows.

Operational Support
  
  

* Own follow-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, and decision logs so nothing important falls through.
* Coordinate cross-functional projects: timelines, owners, blockers, and weekly status updates.
* Support special projects spanning hiring ops, partner outreach, content briefs, or launch readiness as needed.
* Create durable systems (docs, trackers, checklists) that make the company faster after you leave each workstream.

What success looks like
  
  
Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:
  
  

* Deliver founder-ready memos and analyses that lead to clear decisions.
* Own at least one end-to-end workstream from problem framing to measurable outcome.
* Ship useful AI workflows that reduce cycle time for recurring Founder Office tasks.
* Keep priorities, owners, and next actions visible across the initiatives you support.
* Demonstrate strong judgment: escalate early, communicate crisply, and improve with feedback.

Who you are
  
  

* Final-year undergraduate / postgraduate student or recent graduate (any rigorous major; preference for business, economics, CS, design, or quantitative fields).
* Strong analytical and written communication skills. You can turn complexity into clarity.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic data analysis; SQL / Python / BI tools are a plus.
* Hands-on with modern AI tools and eager to invent better ways of working.
* Structured operator: you track details, close loops, and hate dropped balls.
* High ownership and bias to action in ambiguous environments.
* Available full-time (or near full-time) for 3–6 months; based anywhere in India (IST or a similar timezone).

Bonus points
  
  

* Prior internship in startups, consulting, product, analytics, or strategy.
* Personal projects, campus clubs, or research where you owned outcomes, not just tasks.
* Experience writing specs, running user interviews, or shipping a small product/feature.
* Fintech, consumer apps, or personal-finance curiosity.
* Design fluency (Figma/Canva) or light engineering fluency.

Why join us
  
  
You will work directly with founders at an early-stage fintech building AI-native money products: rare exposure for an internship.
  
  
You will learn how strategy, product, data, and operations connect in practice, not in a textbook.
  
  
High performers will leave with a portfolio of real decisions influenced, workflows built, and outcomes shipped, and a strong path to a full-time conversation if there is mutual fit.

title: Senior Consultant- Oracle EPM Data Integrations
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Consultant – Oracle EPM Cloud Data Integrations (Consolidations / Planning)**
A Senior Consultant at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for managing mid-to-large-size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. They provide expert advice, guidance, and solutions related to technology to businesses and organizations. They are indirect mentors in other areas and grades. Their goal is to help clients optimize their technology infrastructure, processes, and strategies to achieve their business objectives more efficiently and effectively. Lead consultants work with security, data management, and crisis management and should demonstrate exceptional knowledge of technology to deliver quality work that will drive customer satisfaction, with excellent communication skills, and the ability to work well within a team.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Lead Data Integration Consultant to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Cloud data integration development. As a Lead Data Integration Consultant, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing data integration solutions to support our clients' EPM Cloud application.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop data integration solutions for Oracle EPM Cloud applications, including Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud (Planning), Oracle Financial Consolidation and Close Cloud (FCC) and Oracle Account Reconciliation (Reconciliation) applications.
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives, challenges, and technology requirements. Conduct thorough assessments to identify areas where technology can drive improvements and efficiencies.
* Implement and configure data integration processes using tools such as Oracle Data Exchange (DE), Oracle Data Management (DM) and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Develop and maintain ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from various source systems into Oracle EPM Cloud applications.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for data integration issues.
* Provide expert advice on technology solutions and tools that can enhance the client's operations. Help clients make informed decisions about adopting and implementing new technologies.
* Perform data mapping, validation, and unit testing to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
* Conduct training sessions and provide documentation to clients to ensure successful adoption of data integration solutions.
* Stay current with industry trends and best practices in data integration and Oracle EPM Cloud technologies.
* Continuously monitor the performance of implemented solutions to identify areas for improvement or optimization. Provide recommendations for updates, upgrades, or modifications, as needed.

**Education**
**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* MBA, relevant master's degree, or PhD, a plus.

**Experience**

* 5 – 10 years of consulting experience or in a related field.
* Experience Leading 8 – 10 different, full-lifecycle Oracle Data Integration implementations.
* Experience leading functional and technical design sessions, with hands-on experience implementing Oracle Data Exchange (DE), Oracle Data Management (DM), and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Experience leading a team of consultants and properly managing deliverables.
* Strong experience in scripting languages such as SQL, PL/SQL, and Python.
* Experience with Data Exchange loading data and metadata, required.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Preferred consulting experience in a similar role in a professional services firm or industry experience at a strategic level is required.
* Previous experience working in IT companies.
* In-depth knowledge of the relevant technologies and systems.

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**

* Oracle Cloud Enterprise Performance Management Data Integration Implementation Certified Professional – preferred
* Other Oracle Cloud Enterprise Performance Management Implementation Specialist Certifications (Planning, Consolidations, Reconciliations, Narrative Reporting) – desired

**Skill Requirements**

* Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communication. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Complex Project Management: Lead Consultants are responsible for leading multiple complex projects, necessitating exceptional project management skills.
* Thought Leadership: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.
* Client Acquisition: They should have strong business development skills to acquire new clients and expand existing relationships.
* Mentorship and Coaching: Indirectly developing and coaching junior and mid-level consultants is a significant responsibility.
* Strategic Vision: Senior Consultants should contribute to the firm's strategic vision and decision-making.
* Executive Presence: The ability to interact effectively with senior client executives is important.

**About Us**
Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
  
  
Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

title: DataOps Engineer IV
description:

We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Data Analytics Engineer to own and operate our Snowflake data platform. This role supports the data pipelines that feed Snowflake, which in turn power data and reporting presented directly to our customers within our products. The role is primarily focused on
**Snowflake platform administration and data engineering**
— account management, performance/cost optimization, data pipelines (dbt, Fivetran), and the overall health of the platform — with security, access governance, and cloud/DevOps responsibilities as a supporting part of the job.

You'll work closely with platform and product engineering teams and cloud operations to ensure the pipelines and Snowflake environment behind our customer-facing product data are scalable, performant, and reliable.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage Snowflake platform changes via infrastructure-as-code where applicable (e.g., Terraform, Snowflake CLI/SQL scripts) and change management processes
* Support and maintain Fivetran connectors for data ingestion from SaaS applications, databases, and APIs

* Troubleshoot pipeline and transformation issues, including those that intersect with platform-level access or performance, to protect the reliability of data presented to customers
* Integrate Snowflake and pipeline health (job failures, data freshness, query performance) into the team's observability stack for centralized monitoring and alerting

  **AWS**

  **OCI**

* Own access certification and periodic access review cycles for Snowflake, producing evidence for

  and
  **SOC 2 Type II**

* Partner with the compliance/security team on control evidence, remediation tracking, and audit responses specific to the data platform

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform administration, with hands-on production experience running 
  **Snowflake**
  (account management, performance tuning, cost management)
* Working knowledge of
  **dbt**
  and
  **Fivetran**
  (or comparable ELT tools) for building and troubleshooting data pipelines
* Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of data warehousing concepts
* Working knowledge of Git-based version control and infrastructure-as-code practices
* Comfort integrating platform/pipeline monitoring into a centralized observability tool
* General cloud SRE/DevOps experience, mainly
  **AWS**
  with some exposure to
  **Azure**
  and
  **OCI**
  , applied to a data platform (IAM, networking, monitoring, automation)
* Practical experience with
  **user access management**
  and SSO configuration for a SaaS/cloud platform (Entra ID/Azure AD experience a plus)
* Familiarity with audit/compliance processes (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2) — access reviews, evidence gathering, control documentation
* Good communication skills — comfortable working with product/platform engineering and security stakeholders

**Nice to Have**
