title: AV Catalogue & Pricing Analyst III
description:
**Role Overview**
Are you detail-oriented, technically proficient with procurement systems, and passionate about managing complex data? We are seeking an AV Catalogue & Pricing Analyst to join our team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our audio-visual (AV) buying catalogues, ensuring that our value-added resellers and integrators have accurate, up-to-date product information and pricing. Audio-visual procurement is a high-value, dynamic space. You will bridge the gap between vendors and our internal systems, maintaining the integrity of our purchase information records and ensuring that our procurement processes remain seamless and error-free.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Catalogue Administration & Vendor Coordination
* Manage the audio-visual and reseller catalogues end to end, keeping product data, specifications and pricing current and correct.
* Work directly with vendors and integrators on stock-keeping-unit additions, changes and retirements, obtaining the data needed to list an item properly.
* Coordinate with the channel team so that every price change is approved before it is published.
* Onboard new products and deprecate outdated items in step with the vendor's own lifecycle.
* Remove redundant and duplicate catalogue entries, and confirm every required attribute is populated before an item goes live.
* Price Change & Purchase Information Record Validation
* Validate price changes against vendor-supplied pricing before they are applied, and reject changes that arrive without approval or supporting evidence.
* Validate catalogue pricing against purchase information records periodically, so the catalogue and the purchasing record do not drift apart.
* Execute timely updates to resolve discrepancies, and escalate any that cannot be reconciled.
* Prepare and execute bulk pricing uploads into the ERP through the approved file-upload route, with pre-upload validation.
* Maintain the evidence trail for each price change so pricing disputes can be settled from the record.
* Data Validation & Master Data Alignment
* Validate material identifiers and supplier assignments on catalogue items, so each entry resolves to the correct material record and the correct supplier.
* Audit the catalogue on a routine cycle for inconsistencies, and rectify discrepancies promptly.
* Raise correction requests with the partner teams that own upstream data, and track them to closure.
* Coordinate with the new product introduction and master data functions where a catalogue change requires a new or amended material record.
* Enforce catalogue data standards consistently across systems.
* Year-End Rebuild, Documentation & Governance
* Run the year-end catalogue creation cycle, rebuilding the catalogue against current vendor pricing and product lines.
* Maintain standard operating procedures and change-management documentation so the process is repeatable and auditable.
* Report on catalogue accuracy, price change volumes and outstanding discrepancies.
* Support buyers and requesters with catalogue queries and item availability questions.
* Identify recurring data faults and drive them to root cause with the upstream owner.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS
  
  
Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per service line.
  
  

* Catalogue Accuracy: sustain ≥99% accuracy across product data, specifications and pricing in the managed catalogues.
* Price Change Control: 100% of published price changes approved by the channel team before publication, with evidence retained.
* Validation Cycle: complete the periodic catalogue and purchase information record validation on schedule, with discrepancies logged and actioned.
* Upload Integrity: bulk uploads validated before submission, with zero uploads that break existing dependencies.
* Year-End Build: annual catalogue rebuild delivered to the agreed date and completeness standard.
* First Meaningful Response: provide a meaningful technical update on 90% of requests within 2 business hours.
* Ticket Quality: sustain ≥95% against the weighted quality scorecard, which is weighted toward technical accuracy, then completeness, timeliness and communication.
* Customer Satisfaction: sustain ≥95% of responses rated Excellent or Good.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS
  
  

* Catalogue and procurement platform: buying catalogue administration, item listing and visibility.
* ERP: SAP for material records, purchase information records, pricing conditions and bulk file uploads.
* Master data: material and supplier master records for identifier and supplier validation.
* Reporting: advanced spreadsheet work and BI tooling for catalogue audits and discrepancy tracking.

**Required Skills & Experience**
Mandatory
  
  

* 3–7+ years in catalogue management, product or pricing master data, or procurement operations, ideally with a technical or audio-visual product range.
* Hands-on catalogue administration including item creation, attribute completeness, retirement and duplicate removal.
* SAP experience with material master, purchase information records and pricing conditions, including bulk upload routines.
* Demonstrated ownership of a recurring price validation cycle against vendor-supplied pricing.
* Direct vendor and reseller communication on product and pricing data.
* High attention to detail on identifier and supplier validation, where an error propagates into ordering and invoicing.
* Willing and able to work a shift-based roster, including night shifts, from the Hyderabad delivery centre.

**Preferred**

* Audio-visual product knowledge — conferencing, displays, control systems and integration services.
* Value-added reseller or integrator commercial models and quote structures.
* Experience running an annual catalogue rebuild.
* Spreadsheet automation or scripting for validation and reconciliation.
* Exposure to new product introduction and material master workflows.

title: Catalogue Analyst III
description:
**Role Overview**
Are you a detail-oriented professional passionate about data integrity and operational excellence? As a Catalogue Analyst, you will be the guardian of our global product catalogue—the critical single source of truth that powers every downstream buying, receiving, and invoicing activity.
  
  
In this pivotal role, you will manage complex product data, pricing, and manufacturer details across hardware, software, and accessories. You'll play a central role in the New Product Introduction (NPI) pipeline, overseeing the full lifecycle of catalogue items from initial setup through to End-of-Sale and retirement. By maintaining a pristine catalogue, you ensure seamless ordering, accurate pricing, and reliable spend reporting across the entire organization.
  
  
You will be responsible for validating supplier pricing, executing master-data updates, and configuring regional storefront visibility to ensure the right products reach the right teams. Partnering closely with cross-functional teams including NPI engineering and Supplier Management, you will drive accuracy and efficiency in a high-impact environment. If you thrive on precision and want to contribute to the backbone of our procurement operations, we invite you to join our team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Catalogue Data Management
* Manage and maintain the accuracy of the global hardware, software and accessories catalogues, ensuring product data, pricing, specifications and manufacturer details are validated and current.
* Perform bulk data updates and uploads (including part numbers, pricing, specifications and regional attributes) using master-data loaders into the ERP system, preserving data integrity across the catalogue.
* Configure regional storefront visibility rules so the correct items appear to the correct buying populations, and resolve catalogue-driven ordering blocks.
* Triage back-end errors reported by buying teams regarding missing supplier-item mapping or incorrect catalogue data, running system checks to push correct records live.
* Pricing & Master-Data Validation
* Review recurring price modifications submitted by VARs. Apply rule-based pricing logic against historical baselines, route threshold exceptions to Regional Channel Managers for approval, and execute automated validation workflows.
* Review monthly supplier pricing changes against historical baselines and flag anomalies before they reach the storefront.
* Execute weekly Purchase Information Record (PIR) validation cycles and upload approved records using bulk data loaders into the ERP system.
* Maintain accurate master-data records so that catalogue, procurement and finance systems stay reconciled.
* Validate manufacturer part numbers (MPNs), unit costs and currency/region mappings to prevent pricing and quantity discrepancies downstream.
* New Product Introduction (NPI) Catalogue Setup
* Manage product lifecycle transitions from New Product Introductions (NPI) to End of Life/End of Purchase (EOL/EOP). Accurately classify hardware tiers (Tier 1 Orderable, Tier 2 EOP, Tier 3 Depleted) and coordinate active/retired status updates with vendors.
* Create part numbers and system IDs needed to transact new products, and track NPI catalogue requests through the pipeline.
* Coordinate with catalog and engineering teams during product launches to set up the correct Base-and-Variant MID hierarchy, establishing regional variant entries under active parent items.
* Coordinate regional catalogue rollouts, ensuring new items are enabled correctly across the applicable regions and buying platforms.
* Support part-compliance steps (New Part Requests, trade classification and customs valuation references) so new items are catalogue-ready ahead of transacting.
* Product Lifecycle & Catalogue Governance
* Administer product lifecycle configurations by transitioning items between standard orderable tiers and End-of-Sale (EOS) or End-of-Purchase (EOP) retired statuses based on regional supplier stock depletion.
* Administer entries in the asset/catalogue administration system — creating, editing and activating or deactivating offerings — so the available catalogue stays current and correct.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation of catalogue changes, approvals and lifecycle transitions.
* Run periodic catalogue health checks and clean-up cycles to remove duplicate, stale or mis-mapped records.
* Run bi-weekly alignment touchpoints with hardware suppliers/VARs to capture catalog changes. Partner with Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM) on Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) mapping and Master Item Data (MID) associations.
* Investigate catalog mismatches, missing IBP supplier combinations, and ad-hoc expedited pricing requests via internal ticketing workflows. Escalate technical tool/script failures to technical integration teams.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS
  
  
Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.
  
  

* Catalogue Data Accuracy: maintain ≥99% accuracy across reviewed catalogue entries, since the catalogue drives correct ordering and pricing across the operation.
* New Product Onboarding Cycle Time: onboard new products/services to the catalogue within ≤5 days for 98% of requests.
* Pricing Validation Timeliness: complete weekly PIR validation cycles and monthly pricing reviews on schedule for 100% of in-scope supplier records.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): sustain a CSAT score of ≥95% (≥4.0–4.5 on a 5-point scale) across surveyed interactions, reflecting accuracy, responsiveness and professionalism on every request handled — measured monthly/quarterly per the cross-functional service levels.
* Ticket Quality: ensure ≥95–97% of completed requests pass quality-assurance checks, with complete and accurate documentation, correct categorization, and full adherence to the approved SOP for the request type.
* Aged Ticket Discipline: perform follow-up actions and update statuses on all open catalogue and pricing tickets every 3 days.
* Response Time: respond to ≥95–97% of tickets within the priority-based target window, routed to the correct owner first time, so no request waits on mis-assignment.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS
  
  

* ERP & Procurement Systems: SAP (specifically Materials Management, master-data uploading consoles and Purchase Information Records) alongside corporate guided buying platforms
* Product & Catalogue Systems: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools and catalogue/asset administration consoles
* Data Management Tools: bulk data loaders, master-data validation utilities and collaborative spreadsheet logs
* Ticketing & Collaboration Tools: advanced ITSM issue-tracking platforms

**Required Skills & Experience**
Mandatory
  
  

* 3–7+ years of experience in catalogue management, product/master-data management or procurement operations.
* Hands-on catalogue and master-data management, including bulk uploads and data-integrity controls.
* Hands-on experience performing weekly/monthly pricing audits, configuring regional storefront visibility rules, and managing PIR master records.
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy, with the discipline to sustain ≥99% catalogue accuracy at volume.
* Strong English communication and stakeholder management, including with internal buying teams and suppliers.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP Materials Management and master-data upload consoles.
* Exposure to NPI processes, Base-and-Variant MID hierarchies and regional catalogue rollouts.
* Familiarity with product lifecycle management (EOS/EOP) and part-compliance/trade-classification concepts.
* Experience triaging supplier-item mapping errors and resolving catalogue-driven ordering blocks.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Darwinbox is Asia’s fastest growing SaaS based HR Technology platform. A brainchild of alumni from the country’s most distinguished institutions (IIT/IIM/XLRI) and organizations (McKinsey, EY, Google), Darwinbox is the preferred technology partner of 1000+ global enterprises with more than 4 million+ employees using the platform.
  
  
Our end-to-end HCM technology suite competes with the best in the business and has won against giants such as SAP, Oracle and Workday several times to acquire iconic enterprise customers ranging from the largest conglomerates to unicorns, such as, Adani, Mahindra, Kotak, TVS, Arvind, Nivea, Puma, Swiggy, Paytm, Bigbasket and Delhivery.
  
  
Backed by Sequoia, Microsoft, KKR and Partners Group, and recognized by global analysts such as Gartner and Forrester, we are scaling rapidly across markets. This is a rocketship, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a GTM Engineer, you will embed across Marketing, SDRs, Sales, and Pre-Sales — mapping how work actually gets done, then engineering better versions of those workflows using AI. You will lead AI and technology implementation across all marketing functions, enabling the team to move faster, produce more, and make smarter decisions.
  
  
This is an AI-first role in the truest sense. You will not just use AI tools — you will build them. You will design systems, automate workflows, prototype internal tooling, and deploy solutions that generate compounding returns for the entire GTM engine.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* AI-Native Workflow Engineering
* Identify high-friction workflows across the GTM org and rebuild them with AI at the core.
* Build and deploy automation pipelines using n8n, Make, Clay, and LLM APIs — replacing manual effort with intelligent, signal-driven systems.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build internal tools, scripts, and dashboards without engineering dependencies. If the tool you need does not exist, build it yourself.
* AI-Powered Content & Demand Generation
* Build a content automation pipeline for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — so Darwinbox surfaces in every relevant AI-driven buyer conversation, at scale.
* Design and deploy AI-powered outbound systems that personalize messaging at the account and persona level, replacing manual sequencing with intelligent, signal-driven outreach.
* Experiment with warm-up sequences, inbox health, deliverability, and multi-channel orchestration across email and LinkedIn.
* MarTech Stack & AI Tool Ownership
* Own the evaluation, onboarding, and integration of AI and MarTech tools: HubSpot, Clay, Apollo.io, Cognism, HeyReach, Instantly, and whatever emerges next.
* Audit tech spend, eliminate redundancy, and optimize for leverage. If a new AI tool could make the team 2x more effective, you are testing it that week — not that quarter.
* Reporting, Analytics & Data Intelligence
* Build real-time dashboards for campaign performance, pipeline contribution, and GTM efficiency.
* Analyze funnel metrics and surface actionable insights using SQL, automation, or whatever tool fits the question.
* Automate CRM hygiene, data enrichment, and reporting workflows, so the team always works with clean, reliable data.
* Process Design & Governance
* Map existing GTM processes, identify inefficiencies, and implement automation for speed and accuracy.
* Document all workflows and maintain a system of record for automation. Ensure compliance with data governance standards.

**Who Should Apply**

* AI builder: You build with AI, not just prompt it.
* You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot to ship real things: tools, automations, dashboards, scripts. Going from a problem statement to a working prototype without filing an engineering ticket is table stakes.
* Hands-on experience with automation and integration tools: n8n, Clay, Make, Zapier, or similar.
* Comfort with SQL and APIs — enough to pull, transform, and load data independently.
* Engineering rigor: you break ambiguous problems into first-principles components and own them end-to-end.
* Obsession with outcomes. You are not done when it is built — you are done when it is measurably working.
* Graduated from a top-tier institution (think IIT, NIT, BITS, or equivalent).

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2-6 years in content marketing for B2B / SaaS (HR tech experience is a plus).
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities.
* Experience with content calendars, editorial planning, and project workflows.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and performance analytics.
* Strong understanding of buyer personas, content funnels, and GTM alignment.

The role will manage supplier catalog onboarding, PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalog implementation, catalog configuration and troubleshooting, UAT and go-live readiness, catalog adoption reporting, and stakeholder coordination with Procurement Operations, Supplier Management, Category Managers, AMS, Digital, IT, and suppliers.**

**Testing, Deployment & Go-Live Support**

* Define and execute catalog test scenarios, UAT plans, transaction validation, supplier connectivity checks, and go-live readiness validation.
* Coordinate test profiles, buyer / requester validation, issue tracking, defect closure, and deployment support.
* Support hypercare during launch and ensure operational handover to support teams after stabilization.
* Ensure catalog changes align with procurement channels, preferred supplier strategy, and business controls.

**Catalog Adoption, Reporting & Governance**

* Drive catalog utilization, preferred supplier adoption, and spend reallocation toward approved catalog suppliers.
* Track and report catalog adoption KPIs, productivity metrics, supplier performance, catalog utilization, and spend analytics.
* Support contract expiration tracking, supplier contract alignment, and coordination with category managers.
* Create user training materials, quick reference guides, supplier communications, and adoption campaigns.

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, IT, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* 4+ years of experience in procurement operations, SAP Ariba catalog enablement, supplier enablement, P2P, eProcurement, or catalog administration.
* Practical understanding of SAP Ariba catalog processes, PunchOut, CIF / hosted catalogs, supplier onboarding, UAT, and catalog troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master-data stakeholders.
* Strong Excel / reporting, issue-resolution, stakeholder management, documentation, and project-tracking skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a global procurement CoE or shared-services model supporting multi-region catalog deployment.
* Knowledge of supplier master data, contract data, Ariba Network, Guided Buying, buying channels, and preferred supplier governance.
* Exposure to catalog analytics, spend leakage reduction, compliance monitoring, and adoption dashboards.
* Lean Six Sigma, SAP Ariba certification, project management, or Agile exposure preferred.
* Ability to translate catalog gaps into process fixes, training interventions, and adoption improvement plans.

* Increased catalog utilization and preferred supplier adoption.
* On-time catalog implementations with effective testing, go-live readiness, and hypercare completion.
* Reduced catalog errors, escalations, non-catalog buying, and supplier transaction defects.
* Improved visibility through adoption reporting, spend analytics, and implementation trackers.
* Stronger alignment between catalog coverage, supplier strategy, contracts, and procurement channels.

* MBA or equivalent degree in Information Technology, Systems, or Business Analytics.
* 6-9 years of experience as a Senior Business Analyst in enterprise or technology-driven environments.
* Strong understanding of business processes and ability to map them to system capabilities.
* Experience with ERP systems, especially Manufacturing domains (Infor M3, SAP, Oracle, etc.), SQL, APIs, or data analytics tools is an advantage.

* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Working proficiency with Camtasia and Microsoft Clipchamp for recording, editing, captioning, and publishing clear business and product communication videos.
* Practical understanding of generative AI, large language models, prompt design, AI-assisted analysis, and the limitations of AI-generated outputs in a business environment.
* Ability to define AI-focused business requirements, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, process controls, and success measures while maintaining requirement traceability.
* Strong judgment in reviewing AI-generated content for accuracy, completeness, bias, privacy, security, and alignment with business intent.

* Hands-on project experience in Business Analysis, Process Configuration, and Quote-to-Cash or Procure-to-Pay domains.

* Exposure to Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) workflows.
* Experience in data-driven decision-making using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools.

title: Business Intelligent Engineer II, Amazon Shipping
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.
  
  
We have built a highly respected BI and Data Engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.
  
  
As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will develop datasets, dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI tools, and provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic planning within Amazon Shipping. Additionally, you will deliver across planned projects that will improve overall cost and profitability for the business.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Data Management and Integration: Collect, process, and manage large datasets from various sources, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and accessibility.
* Data Analysis: Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can inform business decisions.
* Reporting and Visualization: Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present data insights in an understandable and actionable format.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs, provide data-driven recommendations, and support strategic planning.
* Tool and Technology Utilization: Utilize and stay updated with the latest BI tools and technologies to enhance data analysis and reporting capabilities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

title: Workforce Management Specialist IV
description:
**About The Role**

* As a Workforce Management Specialist IV, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring operational excellence within the Global Delivery team. You will collaborate with global partners, provide actionable insights, and drive process improvements to align with business goals. This position offers an opportunity to work on challenging and impactful projects that influence the operational efficiency of Uber's BPO partners
* You realize the vital role that staffing plays in appropriately cultivating positive experiences with our eater, courier, and merchant partners, allowing for positive support experiences every time, all the time
* You are a big thinker and never view problems that arise as microscopic, but rather take a step back to make decisions that are in the best interest of the Uber and our community
* You are a resourceful go-getter, always willing to take initiative and address something hands-on, you persevere when others give up
* Optimistic leadership: you are passionate about making magic for our Community

**What the Candidate Will Do**

* Managing SLAs and response times ensures our customers are having a happy time using Uber.
* Ensure accuracy in WFM data sources (e.g., efficiency dashboards, inflow vs. forecast reports, data quality checks) to enhance data reliability for customer-impacting decisions.
* Act as a subject-matter expert by managing performance monitoring to ensure SLAs are met, and engage in capacity planning that anticipates customer needs.
* Serve as a point of contact, providing weekly insights and updates to keep stakeholders informed on capacity, productivity, and service effectiveness.
* Assist the development and refinement of forecast models, supporting proactive capacity adjustments
* Oversee weekly inputs and discrepancies for BPO capacity calls and maintain an organized approach to data validation on allocation and capacity sheets.
* Structure performance analyses to highlight root causes of SLA misses or productivity variances and coordinate with sites for course corrections.
* Manage and analyze data for capacity and forecast accuracy, ensuring both strategic planning and execution are aligned with broader objectives.
* Lead weekly deviation calls to address forecast adjustments and plan for any operational changes impacting the organization's performance.
* Engage with SRPs, BI, A&I, and BPs as the primary contact, ensuring a well-aligned and informed network of stakeholders.
* Manage collaborative forecast and capacity review calls with BPOs and calibrate expectations to improve service delivery and organizational cohesion.
* Actively participate in CX syncs to discuss ongoing challenges, including SLAs, roadblocks, and project milestones, promoting clear communication and visibility across teams.
* Present and discuss insights and performance findings in team meetings, highlighting improvement areas and progress toward goals.
* Perform modifications and enhancements on existing reports based on evolving business requirements
* Basic project and stakeholder management
* Work in US CST timezone

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years work experience in Business Analytics, Workforce Planning, Management, or Business Process
* Exceptional written and verbal communication and organisational skills
* Collaborator within your team, as well as externally
* Experience with Google Sheets/Excel and preferably SQL, plenty of experience working with data
* English fluency
* Experience with WFM software (Verint, IEX, Aspect, etc.)
* Work in a high-growth environment
* Work in US CST timezone

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Intermediate stakeholder management skills with a proven ability to align conflicting priorities and lead through influence.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate high-ambiguity environments and stay resilient through constant change.
* Strong systems thinking with a focus on executional excellence and precise, high-stakes detail.
* Exceptional foresight and planning skills, with a track record of identifying operational risks before they impact service levels.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: SAP Upgrade Sr. Analyst
description:
**Overview**
The size and complexity of our SAP landscape with 20+ SAP products & 800+ instances, combined with multiple deadlines for patching / versioning & end of life and deep dependencies across strategic programs—make SAP Upgrades a mission‑critical function.
  
  
Over the next 5+ years, we will have to efficiently run all the large business critical upgrades with 100% efficiency & no disruption to business – factoring in the deeply integrated global landscape.
  
  
In addition to upgrades we also need to plan for SAP Max Attention services from SAP to ensure our current SAP environments have active SAP support for projects as well as sustain.
  
  
The SAP Upgrade Sr. Analyst is a key role in the SAP ecosystem who is responsible for managing the end-to-end financials along with the related Power BI tools to drive process excellence and controls.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Primary
  
  

* 'Track budget, actuals, forecasts, and explain financial variances for upgrades and Max Attention
* Multiyear financial outlook
* Maintain Max Attention and Upgrade dashboards, KPIs, milestones, and executive reporting packs
* Administer tools/workflows supporting Max Attention & Upgrade governance
* Ensure compliance with stage gates and approvals
* Produce analytics and recommendations to improve delivery performance and transparency

Shared
  
  

* Partner with Finance and Infrastructure teams to track budgets, forecasts, actuals, and resource utilization across Max Attention & Upgrade programs
* Partner with Testing, Functional/DSO, and Product Owners to publish KPI dashboards, milestone status, and readiness metrics
* Partner with Delivery Leads and leadership teams to provide analytics, executive reporting, and data-driven recommendations for decisions
* Partner with the tools team to develop Power BI Apps to automate tracking and reporting process

Decision Rights
  
  

* Decide reporting baselines, KPI definitions, and governance measures used across the upgrade portfolio
* Recommend corrective actions when budget variance, milestone slippage, or control gaps are identified
* Decide data quality standards and approval checkpoints for status reporting and executive dashboards.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years in PMO, program controls, financial analysis, or portfolio governance roles.
* Experience supporting large IT or SAP programs with dashboards, KPIs, milestone tracking, and executive reporting
* Strong capability in budget management, forecasting, variance analysis, and resource tracking.
* Detail-oriented with strong communication skills and ability to turn data into actionable insights for leadership

title: Director, Advanced Analytics & Modeling
description:
**Summary**
The Director, AMM, is accountable for the Advanced Analytics & Modeling strategy, organization and portfolio, including strategic directions, capability evolution, capacity allocation, cross-capability orchestration, analytical quality, US delivery, and decision impact.
  
  
The role holds established capability leaders accountable for differentiated roadmaps and outcomes and directly incubates AI & Unstructured Intelligence until sustained demand, maturity, and scale support a different LT model.
  
  
This role DOES NOT own the broader enterprise analytics strategy, enterprise analytics governance, technology architecture, analytics platforms, production engineering, or technical lifecycle management.
  
  
The Director aligns the Advanced Analytics & Modeling Strategy with broader I&A priorities and partners with Analytics Strategy & Governance, and SPT leaders through explicit decision rights and connected portfolio governance.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Director, Advanced Analytics & Modeling**
**Location – Hyderabad Hybrid**
**Major Accountabilities**
**Advanced Analytics & Modeling Strategy & Capability Evolution**

* Define and continuously evolve the Advanced Analytics & Modeling (AAM) strategy, portfolio roadmap, capability maturity agenda, and investment priorities, ensuring alignment with portfolio priorities, launches, evolving customer and patient needs, and the broader I&A capability direction.
* Establish and manage priorities across Precision Health, Key Drivers & Action Planning Analytics, Integrated Promotion Mix Modeling & Resource Optimization, and AI & Unstructured Intelligence, ensuring focus on the highest-value opportunities.
* Guide decisions on where advanced analytics capabilities should be built, incubated, partnered, scaled, automated, or retired based on business value, differentiation, feasibility, reuse potential, and maturity.

**Portfolio Prioritization, Capacity & Delivery**

* Establish transparent intake, prioritization, service levels, and portfolio governance across launch, brand, therapeutic-area, functional, and enterprise demand, ensuring Hyderabad capacity is allocated to the highest-value work with explicit trade-offs when demand exceeds capacity.
* Balance near-term decision support with sustained capability development, reusable methods, and cross-portfolio learning, while assigning one accountable analytical leader for cross-capability engagements to ensure integrated workplans, contributions, recommendations, and outcome measures.

**Capability Portfolio Leadership & Analytical Excellence**

* Establish shared expectations for analytical rigor, fit-for-purpose methods, validation, interpretability, reproducibility, documentation, peer challenge, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI across advanced analytics and modelling work.
* Resolve priorities, dependencies, quality issues, and capability seams spanning predictive analytics, patient opportunity modeling, key drivers, causal measurement, IPMM, optimization, and emerging AI methods, while promoting reuse and consistency and preserving capability-specific technical standards with appropriate adaptation to business context.

**Emerging Capability: AI & Unstructured Intelligence**

* Establish the Advanced Analytics strategy, roadmap, use-case priorities, capability boundaries, and investment thesis for AI & Unstructured Intelligence, with a focus on high-value applications such as call-note and text analytics, NLP, GenAI, unstructured signal detection, evidence synthesis, summarization, and knowledge acceleration.
* Deploy AAM HYD expertise to test, learn, and build reusable analytical approaches while ensuring human oversight, interpretability, and responsible use.

**Business Partnership & Decision Impact**

* Translate strategic priorities into clear business questions and analytical agendas, challenging low-value, duplicative, or poorly framed demand.
* Convert analytical findings into implications, choices, recommendations, learning agendas, and measurable actions, advancing decision support through appropriate predictive, diagnostic, causal, experimental, optimization, and AI-enabled methods.

**Integrated Partnership with SPT**

* Serve as the Advanced Analytics & Modeling (AAM) point of contact in AIDE/HYD to the SPT organization for initiatives requiring governed data, technical environments, reusable capabilities, productization, deployment support, ModelOps, or enterprise scale.
* Ensure AAM owns its strategy, portfolio, use-case framing, analytical requirements, fit-for-purpose methodology, ad hoc model development, validation, interpretation, recommendations, acceptance, and impact measurement, while partnering with the I&A EH leader and SPT to determine which use cases remain I&A-owned analytics versus those transitioning to SPT-owned products, recurring models, engines, or workflows.
* Enable portfolio-level ownership of feasibility, reuse, capacity, investment, dependencies, and lifecycle issues within the AAM remit, escalating broader enterprise issues through appropriate governance.

**Global US-Hyderabad Operating Model**

* Establish HYD as an integrated capability and delivery partner, engaged early in portfolio planning, business context, analytical design, execution, quality review, synthesis, and capability development.
* Partner with Hyderabad leadership to align capability roadmaps, capacity, expertise, decision rights, work ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and talent priorities, matching ownership to capability maturity, technical expertise, proximity needs, and business value rather than location-based handoffs.
* Build HYD capability to independently lead repeatable and increasingly complex analytical work while maintaining shared accountability for quality, interpretation, and decision impact.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Public Health, Business Analytics, or a related field required or Master's degree or doctorate in a relevant quantitative discipline preferred.
* 12+ years of leadership experience in advanced analytics, data science, decision science, commercial analytics, healthcare analytics, or a related quantitative field.
* Proven success defining and executing an Advanced Analytics strategy and capability roadmap across analytical domains.
* Experience leading senior capability owners, flexible expert teams, complex portfolios, and globally distributed analytics organizations.
* Demonstrated experience applying advanced analytics to consequential commercial, patient, healthcare, launch, or enterprise decisions.
* Experience establishing portfolio prioritization, capacity allocation, quality governance, and reusable capability models.
* Strong track record partnering with senior business and technology leaders and translating complex analytics into strategic choices and measurable action.
* Experience leading operating-model transformation, capability centralization or federation, and organizational change.

**Leadership Skills**

* Lead and deploy HYD Associate Directors and high-performing teams across capability priorities, launches, therapeutic areas, and cross-portfolio initiatives, ensuring effective alignment of expertise to business needs.
* Build strong talent and leadership depth by managing hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, performance, succession, career development, engagement, retention, rotations, communities of practice, and T-shaped skill development.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, constructive challenge, innovation, inclusion, continuous improvement, and accountability, while supporting I&A and AIDE leadership on talent priorities, capability planning, organizational operations, and site-level initiatives.

**Success Measurements**

* Priority launch, brand, functional, and portfolio decisions are improved through timely, rigorous, and actionable Advanced Analytics, with Precision Health, Key Drivers, IPMM, and AI & Unstructured Intelligence delivering against clear roadmaps, quality standards, ownership boundaries, validated value, and measurable business outcomes.
* Portfolio priorities, capacity, and trade-offs are transparent, reducing low-value or duplicative work while reusable methods, assets, and quality practices improve consistency, speed, scalability, and cross-therapeutic-area learning.
* HYD, AAM, and SPT operate with clear ownership, effective deployment, timely lifecycle decisions, strong handoffs, growing capability, sustainable utilization, and shared value realization, reinforcing senior stakeholder confidence in analytical rigor, recommendations, role clarity, and decision impact.

**Required Skills**

* Leadership in Advanced Analytics & Modeling strategy, capability portfolio management, roadmap development, and investment prioritization.
* Broad fluency across predictive modelling, patient analytics, driver analytics, causal inference, experimentation, IPMM, ROI, response curves, optimization, NLP, GenAI, and unstructured analytics, with strong judgment on method fit, evidence quality, validation, interpretability, uncertainty, model risk, and responsible AI.
* Strong executive decision framing, business translation, stakeholder influence, conflict resolution, and portfolio trade-off management, with clear understanding of analytical versus technical ownership across analytics, modelling, products, platforms, and lifecycle management.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, or another complex regulated industry, with exposure to product lifecycle, launches, customer and patient analytics, promotional investment, and healthcare delivery.
* Experience incubating emerging AI or unstructured-data capabilities, validating use cases before scale, and establishing integrated operating models with global capability centers and AI, data, product, or platform organizations.

* Expertise in AI-enabled analytics, NLP, GenAI, unstructured-data methods, experimentation, simulation, and optimization, with familiarity in product management, agile delivery, analytical productization, ModelOps, and business-to-technology translation.

**Role:**

**About Carrier**
Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.
  
  
**About The Role**

* May propose changes in design or formulation to improve system and/or process reliability.
* Builds and conducts dry running of basic qualification test set ups.
* sCompiles and analyzes performance reports and process control statistics; investigates and analyzes relevant variables potentially affecting product performance and processes.
* Liaises closely with other project team members in the areas such as stress, manufacturing, sourcing and configuration, with respect to new designs or design changes.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Reliability Modeling & Prediction**

* Perform reliability predictions for electronic assemblies and systems using industry-standard methodologies.
* Calculate:

+ MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
+ Failure Rate (FIT)
+ Product Useful Life
+ Service Life Estimates
+ Reliability Growth Metrics
+ Reliability Block Diagrams (RBD)
+ Mission Reliability

* Conduct reliability analysis using:

+ Telcordia SR-332
+ MIL-HDBK-217F
+ IEC 61709
+ FIDES methodologies

* Perform component-level and assembly-level reliability assessments

**System-Level Reliability Analysis**

* Develop and maintain system-level reliability models for complete products and platforms.
* Create reliability block diagrams — RBDs — for system architecture analysis.
* Evaluate reliability of complete systems considering:

+ PCB assemblies
+ Sensors
+ Power supplies
+ Communication modules
+ Displays
+ Relays/contactors
+ Motors/fans
+ Connectors and harnesses
+ Mechanical/electromechanical interfaces

* Analyze series, parallel, redundant, standby, and fail-safe architectures.
* Calculate system reliability, availability, maintainability, and probability of failure over mission time.
* Assess single-point failures and critical reliability contributors at system level.
* Support architecture trade-off studies to improve system robustness, redundancy, serviceability, and product life.
* Work with hardware, firmware, systems, mechanical, quality, compliance, and field teams to translate reliability risks into design actions

**Product Lifetime & Wear-Out Analysis**

* Estimate product useful life and service life based on operating profiles and field usage conditions.
* Perform lifetime calculations for wear-out-sensitive components such as:

+ Electrolytic capacitors
+ Relays
+ Power semiconductors
+ Fans
+ Connectors
+ Batteries
+ Displays
+ Electromechanical parts

* Apply appropriate models such as Arrhenius, Weibull, Coffin-Manson, thermal acceleration, voltage derating, and duty-cycle-based life models.
* Evaluate environmental impact including temperature, humidity, vibration, cycling, load profile, and power-on hours.
* Recommend design margins, derating guidelines, and component selection improvements

**Field Data Analytics**

* Analyze warranty claims, field returns, service records, and customer failure data.
* Develop reliability dashboards and reliability KPIs.
* Identify dominant failure modes and reliability trends.
* Establish failure-rate distributions and reliability growth plans.
* Generate actionable recommendations to improve product robustness.

**Reliability Testing & Validation**

* Define reliability validation plans for new product development and sustaining programs.
* Support HALT, HASS, accelerated life testing, temperature cycling, humidity testing, vibration testing, power cycling, and environmental stress testing.
* Correlate lab test results with predicted reliability and actual field performance.
* Define sample size, test duration, confidence level, and acceptance criteria for reliability demonstration tests.
* Support design verification and product qualification from a reliability perspective

**Failure Analysis & Root Cause Investigation**

* Support root cause investigations involving:

+ Field failures
+ Manufacturing defects
+ Component failures
+ Early-life failures

* Perform statistical analysis of failures.
* Work with hardware, firmware, component engineering, quality, manufacturing, and suppliers to implement corrective actions.

**Reliability Tools & Data Management**

* Utilize reliability prediction software and databases for analysis and reporting. Expertise in Relex, Reliasoft, Minitab, ITEM tool suite
* Maintain reliability calculation models, assumptions, and documentation.
* Develop automated reliability reporting tools and dashboards.
* Support design reviews with quantitative reliability assessments

Practical to substantial knowledge of Carrier organization, programs or systems with the ability to make enhancements and leverage in daily work
  
  
University Degree or equivalent

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. title: Risk Analytics - Audit Analytics - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior – Audit Analytics**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Senior – Audit Analytics, you will support the delivery of data analytics solutions across Internal Audit, risk and controls engagements. You will work with large and complex enterprise datasets to develop, validate and visualize analytics that help identify risk indicators, control exceptions and process improvement opportunities.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on analytical capabilities and the ability to translate audit and business requirements into scalable analytical solutions using technologies such as SQL, Python, Power BI, ETL tools and modern data platforms including Databricks and Snowflake. You will also have opportunities to contribute to technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation, including automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), and AI/GenAI-enabled analytics.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform data extraction, transformation, profiling and analysis using SQL, Python and ETL tools/techniques.
* Develop and execute audit analytics, exception testing and risk-based analytical procedures across enterprise processes.
* Build interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI to communicate analytical findings, exceptions and risk insights.
* Work with large and complex datasets across modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliations and validation to ensure the completeness and accuracy of analytical outputs.
* Translate audit, risk and business requirements into analytical logic, data requirements and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with Internal Audit, business, technology and data teams to understand processes, identify relevant data sources and deliver analytics.
* Document data logic, transformation steps, assumptions and analytical procedures to support repeatability and auditability.
* Support technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation initiatives, including analytics, automation and Continuous Controls Monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs) within analytics, audit and risk management use cases.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling and analytical logic.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data transformation and working with data from multiple source systems.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards and analytical reporting solutions using Power BI.
* Experience working with data warehousing and modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Strong data analysis, reconciliation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with large and complex datasets.
* Ability to understand business, audit and risk requirements and translate them into structured analytical tests and actionable outputs.
* Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical approaches and findings to business and audit stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application across analytics, audit and risk management.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and manage assigned analytical deliverables.
* Understand common business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls.
* Have an understanding of risks, controls, KRIs and exception-based audit testing.
* Have exposure to enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments.
* Have experience or exposure to Internal Audit transformation initiatives involving analytics, automation or technology-enabled auditing.
* We are looking for a hands-on analytics professional who combines strong technical capabilities with an understanding of risk, controls and Internal Audit. You should be comfortable working with complex enterprise datasets, developing analytical solutions independently and translating technical findings into meaningful risk and business insights.
* You should bring a problem-solving mindset, strong attention to data quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with audit, business, data and technology stakeholders.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr Engineer, Data Analytics Engineering
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The
**Senior Data Analytics Engineer**
is a critical member of the Data Modernization & Integration organization. This exceptional developer will be responsible for leading a high performing team responsible for designing, building, and modernizing the ingestion, integration, and API services that power LPL’s cloud data ecosystem.
  
  
This role drives the transformation of legacy data feeds into scalable, governed, cloud-native pipelines and helps define the engineering standards that support LPL’s federated data product operating model. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong architectural instincts, a passion for automation, and the ability to collaborate across platform, analytics, and AI teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Modernization & Cloud Engineering
  
  

* Architect and lead migration of legacy SQL/SSIS/ETL pipelines into AWS-native ingestion and integration patterns.
* Design and implement scalable batch, streaming, and event-driven pipelines using services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, DynamoDB, and Step Functions.
* Build resilient data movement frameworks with embedded governance (metadata, lineage, security, quality).
* Contribute to decommissioning efforts by rationalizing and replacing legacy pipeline assets.

Integration & API Engineering
  
  

* Develop secure, performant APIs using modern tooling (API Gateway, Lambda, GraphQL, REST).
* Standardize integration patterns for reusable ingestion modules and domain onboarding.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture to align on API standards, patterns, and best practices.

Automation & Platform Enablement
  
  

* Implement infrastructure-as-code using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Develop CI/CD pipelines promoting automation, repeatability, and quality.
* Contribute to shared libraries, frameworks, and templates that accelerate onboarding of new data sources.
* Drive observability improvements through logging, metrics, tracing, and automated alerting.

Cross-Team Collaboration
  
  

* Establish, develop and lead a top performing team of data engineers.
* Collaborate with Lakehouse Engineering, Warehouse Engineering, AI Engineering, and Data Product teams to ensure reliable and timely data availability.
* Work closely with governance and security teams to enforce enterprise data standards.
* Actively develop and drive a culture of engineering excellence, setting the tone through example.

Strategic Influence
  
  

* Shape our team’s technical roadmap and modernization approach.
* Contribute to architectural discussions and design reviews.
* Advocate for scalable, maintainable, cloud-native engineering practices across the organization.

**What are we looking for?**
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates
**pursue greatness**
,
**act with integrity**
, and are
**driven to help our clients succeed**
. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
**win together**
and
**create and share joy**
in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Proven track record of leading and developing high performing, engaged teams.
* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, and/or cloud engineering.
* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer science or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience with:

+ Cloud data lake architectures: AWS S3, Glue, Lake Formation, Snowflake, or similar.
+ Data lake design patterns: raw, curated, consumption zones; medallion architecture.
+ Data versioning and schema evolution: e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg.
+ Data governance and cataloging: including any of the following (preferred experience in multiple tools) Unity Catalog, Collibra, Atlan, AWS Glue Data Catalog.
+ Programming: Python and/or SQL (production code, reusable libraries, tests).
+ Pipeline orchestration: Airflow, Step Functions, dbt, or similar.
+ DevOps for data: Terraform/CloudFormation, CI/CD, monitoring, and runbook creation.

* Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and secure data onboarding/governance.
* Experience with both batch and real-time data processing.

**Core Competencies**

* Systems Thinking — understands interconnected data flows across platforms.
* Builder Mindset — emphasizes automation, reuse, and simplicity.
* Collaboration — works seamlessly across engineering, architecture, analytics, and operations.
* Leadership — mentors others and elevates the overall engineering discipline.
* Adaptability — thrives in modernization efforts and evolving technology ecosystems

**Preferences**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer science or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Experience modernizing legacy data feeds and migrating large-scale ingestion workloads to the cloud.
* Knowledge of API management, GraphQL, and federated access patterns.
* Exposure to data mesh concepts or federated data product architectures.
* Background working in regulated industries (financial services strongly preferred).
* Familiarity with observability tools (Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience designing frameworks or reusable integration components.

title: Senior People Analytics Manager
description:

The
**Senior People Analytics Manager**
is a senior strategic individual contributor role at the core of Barry Callebaut’s HR digital agenda. The role is responsible for the

, sourcing data from SuccessFactors and other HR systems to create a scalable, governed, and future-proof people data foundation.
  
  
In parallel, the role holds
**global accountability for contingent workforce reporting**
, ensuring transparency, consistency, and decision-ready insights across external labour populations, in close partnership with HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, and the business.
  
  
This role operates with a
**global enterprise scope**
, works closely with senior HR and Finance leaders, and plays a critical role in enabling evidence-based workforce decisions, regulatory compliance, and advanced people analytics.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities & Scope**

+ Definition of data models, entities, and core people metrics
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and IT standards

+ Ensure a “single source of truth” for core people metrics

* Enable downstream analytics and reporting:

+ Implement Power BI and future analytics use cases
+ Lay the foundation for advanced analytics and workforce planning capabilities

* Own global reporting for the external workforce, including:

+ External workforce populations (e.g. contingent workers, outsource labour)
+ Alignment of definitions, metrics, and reporting logic across regions

* Design and maintain standardized global dashboards and datasets for contingent labour:

+ In close collaboration with HR, Finance, Procurement, and IT

* Ensure data accuracy, transparency, and comparability, supporting:

+ Workforce cost visibility
+ Risk management and compliance

* Act as the single point of accountability for contingent workforce reporting topics toward senior stakeholders

+ Provide enterprise-wide visibility and governance across contingent workforce populations, enabling workforce cost transparency, workforce planning, compliance, and risk management

* Stakeholder partnership & change enablement
* Partner closely with:

+ Global HR leadership and HRBPs
+ Finance and FP&A
+ IT and Data & Analytics teams
+ Transformation and digital initiatives

* Act as a change agent, supporting HR’s transition toward a more data-driven and digitally enabled operating model.

* Covers all regions, functions, and business units
* Interfaces with multiple HR systems and enterprise data platforms
* High visibility and impact across HR and Finance leadership

* Fluent in English – verbal and written

* Proven experience in:

+ Implementing or significantly contributing to enterprise data platforms (e.g. Data Lake, data hubs, analytics platforms)
+ Working with SuccessFactors and HR data models

* Strong understanding of:

+ HR data structures, processes, and end-to-end data flows
+ Data governance, data quality, and master data management concepts

* Advanced experience with:

+ Power BI and analytical reporting tools
+ Excel and data modelling

* Demonstrated ability to:
* Lead complex initiatives without direct people management

* Move from strategy to hands-on execution

title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Specialist Data Quality & Insights
description:
**Build our future together**
Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for people with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, while redefining our understanding of health.
  
  
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Senior Specialist - Data Quality & Insights to join our Data Management team in Hyderabad. In this hands-on role, you will lead the reconciliation, validation, and quality oversight of external vendor data across multiple clinical data types. You will use Python, SQL, ETL tools, and data-quality reporting solutions to identify and resolve discrepancies, improve vendor data quality, strengthen inspection readiness, and support reliable clinical decision-making across the portfolio.
  
  
**When & where**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Discover your role**

* Perform end-to-end reconciliation of external vendor data, including Central Lab, Imaging, PK/PD, Cytokines, eCOA, and Biomarker data, against Medidata Rave and the Clinical Data Lake.
* Develop and maintain Python- and SQL-based reconciliation scripts, ETL pipelines, and automated data-quality checks for incoming external vendor datasets.
* Investigate, document, and coordinate the resolution of data discrepancies with Data Acquisition teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners, tracking issues through closure and CAPA processes where applicable.
* Execute study-specific data-quality timelines and checkpoints to ensure external data is validated and reconciled in line with protocol schedules and regulatory expectations.
* Implement and enhance Flask/Python-based reporting solutions used to publish data-quality reports and automated QC outputs for clinical and scientific stakeholders.
* Create and maintain vendor quality metrics and KPIs, including error rates, reconciliation timeliness, and protocol deviation trends, and communicate findings during vendor operational meetings.
* Develop data-quality dashboards and vendor scorecards that support inspection readiness, audit traceability, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with GD-IT and Data Acquisition teams on the ingestion, transformation, staging, and mapping of raw vendor data within the Clinical Data Lake.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
* 4-6 years of hands-on experience in clinical data management, external data reconciliation, or clinical data quality within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
* Deep working knowledge of external clinical data types, such as Central Lab, Imaging, PK/PD, Cytokines, eCOA, and Biomarkers, including flow cytometry, genomic, or proteomic datasets.
* Hands-on expertise in Python and SQL for data analysis, automation, reconciliation scripting, ETL pipelines, and data-quality checks. SAS experience is also relevant.
* Experience working with cloud data-lake platforms such as Dremio, Snowflake, or similar technologies.

* Strong knowledge of CDASH standards, protocol schedules of events, protocol amendments, and study-specific data-mapping requirements.
* Experience partnering with global and cross-functional teams, with strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
