title: Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
The
**Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst**
will play an important role in supporting Micron's Structured Data Access Control (sDAC) program and related data governance initiatives. This role analyzes business processes, identifies opportunities for automation and efficiency, develops reporting and dashboard solutions, supports operational workloads, and contributes to projects that strengthen secure and compliant access to enterprise structured data.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong analytical thinking with process improvement, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and project execution skills. Working closely with technical and business teams, they will transform complex governance processes into actionable insights and help drive continuous improvements across access management and governance workflows.
  
  
This position supports both day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives, helping advance governance modernization, workflow automation, and user experience improvements across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Structured Data Access Control (SDAC) process and related governance workflows along with the knowledge of Role Based Access Control (RBAC) and data security management for integration.
* Define, document and improve business processes, requirements, workflows, operating procedures, governance standards, user guidance, training material and communications.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and efficiency improvements.
* Leveraging AI powered tools and other technologies to improve analysis, research, and productivity.
* Serve as a project contributor, feature owner, or workstream lead for governance initiatives. Includes tracking and communicating project status, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to understand business needs, gather requirements, and address process challenges.
* Facilitate partnerships with developers to define business requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in requirements gathering, planning, testing, deployment, change management, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validation activities.
* Collaborate with BISOs, architects, DBAs, developers, governance teams, and business stakeholders.
* Support user adoption efforts and partner with governance and security teams on RBAC-related initiatives.
* Perform deep data analysis to detect patterns and drive to results. Along with developing data-driven recommendations to improve service quality, cycle time, operational effectiveness, and user experience. Monitor service levels and operational health.
* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI, ServiceNow, and governance reporting solutions, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Analyze trends, bottlenecks, Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance, and operational health metrics to provide actionable insights, create executive-ready reporting and present to leadership and stakeholder on governance recommendation.
* Support operational ticket queues, governance workflows, and triage and resolution of access request review along with assisting users and stakeholders with governance-related inquiries.
* Support audit, certification, and compliance activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Business Data Analytics, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of work experience in business analysis, governance, operations, analytics, or process improvement.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, developing reports, dashboards, and metrics using Power BI, ServiceNow and the Microsoft 365 suites.
* Self-motivated, organized, and highly capable of carrying out detailed plans with limited direction.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive with a positive attitude, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams across geographical and organizational cultures and to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting data governance, access management, and IAM governance programs, with familiarity in RBAC concepts.
* Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) or Oracle Database role and direct access permissions.
* Knowledge of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies. PMP, Scrum, Agile, or Business Analysis certifications are a plus.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflow design and automation, Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (SharePoint, Planner, Power Automate), and Power BI data modeling and advanced visualization techniques.

title: Manager, Business Intelligence, Fraud Investigations, Recovery & Enforcement (FIRE)
description: DescriptionAre you a data leader who wants to reinvent business intelligence around AI, and put that reinvention to work protecting Amazon from fraud and financial loss? Do you want to lead a team that is moving beyond static dashboards to production-grade AI agents that investigate, detect, and act autonomously?The Fraud Investigations, Recovery and Enforcement (FIRE) team is looking for a Manager, Business Intelligence to lead a team of Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineering that owns fraud prevention, detection, and investigation analytics for FinOps. This is not a traditional reporting role. We are transforming BI from a passive, dashboard-centric function into an AI-powered fraud analytics engine, embedding AI in every layer of the stack, and shifting our stakeholders from reading static reports to interacting with active, conversational, and autonomous workflows that surface risk, explain it, and act on it.You will set the technical and analytical direction for a team that has already delivered multi-agent investigation platforms, agents that cut per-query handling time by roughly 70%, and a billion-row entity layer that serves as a single source of truth across FIRE's fraud programs. Your mandate is to push this further: make AI the default in reporting, detection, and investigation; convert manual, human-in-the-loop analysis into agentic and self-service workflows; and keep the underlying data platform robust and scalable enough to deploy AI models with confidence.This is a hands-on leadership role. You will coach BIEs and DE toward high-judgment ownership, partner deeply with Data Science, FinTech, and FinAuto, and work directly with FIRE Investigators and Program Managers to translate ambiguous fraud problems into agentic, measurable solutions. The position is based in Hyderabad and reports to FIRE leadership. The ideal candidate is a Think Big, invent-and-simplify leader who is energized by building AI at the frontier of fraud analytics and by growing engineers who operate above their level.Key job responsibilities Lead, hire, develop, and retain a team of 4 Business Intelligence Engineers and 1 Data Engineer; set a high bar, create structured growth paths, and grow engineers who consistently operate above level. Own the BI strategy and roadmap for FinOps fraud prevention, detection, and investigation, spanning reporting, analytics, detection models, data platform, and automation. Embed AI in every layer of business intelligence, from data ingestion and entity resolution to detection, investigation, and reporting, and set the standard for how the team designs, evaluates, and productionizes AI/LLM solutions. Drive the shift from passive, static dashboards to active, conversational, and autonomous workflows, including agentic investigation tools, conversational and self-service data access, and autonomous detection and dispositioning that reduce human effort and time-to-action. Partner with FIRE Investigators and Program Managers to translate fraud and investigation problems into agent architectures and analytical solutions, securing stakeholder alignment across fraud program leadership. Own and evolve FIRE's fraud data platform (for example, entity and risk-intelligence layers) so it is robust, scalable, and reliable enough to serve production AI models and self-service prototyping at billion-row scale. Partner with Data Science, FinTech, and FinAuto to establish and streamline the prototype-to-production lifecycle, reduce deployment overhead, and enable direct collaboration across environments. Define and own the metrics and savings methodology that quantify fraud rates, exposure, loss, recovery, and detection coverage, and automate P0, WBR, and MBR reporting via agents. Establish and enforce best practices in data integrity, model and change management, code quality, testing, and documentation across the team. Prioritize competing requests across fraud programs and investigations, balancing urgent operational needs with durable platform and AI investments. Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, insights, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership, across regions.A day in the lifeYou start by reviewing the health of the fraud data platform and the agents running in production, checking that overnight incremental refreshes landed and that the investigation and reporting agents are performing within expectations. You meet 1:1 with a BIE architecting a new detection agent, coaching them on the agent design, evaluation strategy, and how to secure alignment from Retail Fraud leadership. You then work with a Program Manager and a Data Scientist to scope a conversational, self-service workflow that lets investigators query case data in natural language instead of waiting on a dashboard. In the afternoon, you review a Data Engineer's entity-layer pipeline design to ensure it scales for the next set of fraud entities, align with FinAuto and FinTech on the prototype-to-production path, and present detection-coverage and savings-methodology findings to senior stakeholders. Throughout, you balance shipping today's automation against the platform and AI investments that make FIRE's analytics increasingly autonomous.Basic Qualifications 7+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience 5+ years of delivering results managing a business intelligence or analytics team, including employee development and performance management experience Experience with SQL Experience with ETL Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools Experience with R, Python, Weka, SAS, Matlab or other statistical/machine learning softwarePreferred Qualifications 4+ years of working with very large data warehousing environment experience 10+ years of data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding experience Experience across the domain of risk management & fraud Experience with various statistical techniques (regression analysis, coefficient correlation) Experience with Generative AI architecture patterns, including multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and fine-tuning, and building agentic, conversational, or autonomous workflows.Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Program Specialist
description:
**Description**
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Senior Program Specialist is an individual contributor role. This position is responsible for supporting execution of business operations and administrative management of USP’s Verification Programs. The role drives coordination of projects, tools, and processes that support market development to drive customer engagement, support internal and external communications, and enhance visibility into program activities against key success metrics. Key responsibilities also include preparation and distribution of internal reports, lead and prospect management, client relationship management (CRM), data and reporting optimization, and performance metric tracking. In addition, the position contributes to broader program operations and continuous improvement initiatives that support the growth of USP’s Verification Programs.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Senior Program Specialist Has The Following Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Verification staff and other stakeholders to coordinate and facilitate project activities, including but not limited to:
* Tracking and reporting on marketing and business performance
* Scheduling of project meetings and production of supporting materials
* Business action item and records management
* Develop and organize reports and business management processes to drive customer oversight and excellence using USP tools (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo, Tableau, etc.)
* Manage projects and tools aimed at driving visibility and accountability for program performance related to existing and new customers
* Assist in revenue, pricing and invoice tracking to ensure accuracy and timely reporting
* Track data from multiple sources, provide data entry for various systems to support tracking of customer status such as products, documents, and timelines.
* Develop reports and queries for systems supporting customer pipeline management
* Assist in preparation of reporting documents and presentations by assigned deadlines
* Actively contribute to Verification Program projects and initiatives
* Assist in capturing customer call reports and action items within CRM platform
* Facilitate communications and group interactions through interpersonal and tool-based skills to achieve project goals
* Work with management and coworkers to develop, improve, and standardize project-related processes
* Support cross-departmental and cross-divisional activities, as related to assigned projects
* Recognize and escalate issues that potentially require upper management awareness and input
* Secure services as needed from other departmental, divisional, and organizational groups
* Help with special projects upon request
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Required Skills And Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Minimum of five years of relevant professional experience with a combination of relevant project management skills and/or scientific background.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work across teams in a matrixed environment
* Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and efficiently manage multiple projects
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Advanced computer competence (MS Office, MS Teams, MS Project, Sharepoint, Copilot, etc.)
* Experience with business, sales and marketing platforms (e.g. Tableau) and CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo)
* Demonstrated ability to mobilize stakeholders towards results
* Demonstrated initiative and resourcefulness with good judgement about what can work and when additional support is needed
* High comfort with navigating through ambiguity and change
* Strong time management skills
* Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and team-building skills
* Excellent critical thinking and critical thinking skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent presentation and reporting skills

**Additional Desired Competencies**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or relevant professional experience
* Self-motivated and results-oriented
* Demonstrated ability to mobilize stakeholders towards results
* Demonstrated initiative and resourcefulness with good judgement about what can work and when additional support is needed
* High comfort with navigating through ambiguity and change
* Knowledge of USP products and services
* Experience with certification or audit programs
* Able to work flexible hours when needed in collaboration with global teams

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
None, this is an individual contributor role.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate’s skill set, experience, qualifications, equity, and other job-related reasons.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Project Management
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

title: Quant Modeling Lead (Control Room) - Hyderabad
description:
**Job Description**
**Quant Modeling (AI/ML) Lead - Hyderabad**
**About Control Management**
Control Managers are responsible for having a deep understanding of the business, its underlying processes and the compliance and operational risk and control environment. Subject matter expertise/innovative tools and technology.
  
  
Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment across the firm. With Control Managers appointed for each Line of Business, Function and Region, there is a comprehensive coverage and joint accountability model with the business executive that promotes early operational risk identification and assessment, effective design and evaluation of controls and sustainable solutions to mitigate operational risk.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quant Modeling team is an integral part of the Controls Room within Control Management, focused on building AI and data science solutions that strengthen control monitoring, analytics, and decision support. The team develops, trains, fine-tunes, and evaluates deep learning and NLP models, including transformer-based and domain-specific architectures, while also building agentic AI systems that support multi-step reasoning, workflow orchestration, tool use, and data integration.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
This role is ideal for a hands-on candidate who can build and train NLP/deep learning models, run experiments, fine-tune and evaluate solutions, and design agentic AI systems that apply reasoning, tool use, orchestration, and data integration to practical control management use cases.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Deep learning model training and experimentation: Design and execute hands-on experiments to train and fine-tune deep learning models, including transformer-based models, embedding models, and domain-specific NLP architectures.
* NLP model and custom architecture development: Develop NLP solutions for text classification, information extraction, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation, while experimenting with neural network layers, attention mechanisms, pooling strategies, classification heads, and task-specific modules.
* Model optimization, loss function design, and evaluation: Improve model performance through hyperparameter tuning, custom loss functions, systematic error analysis, and benchmarking using technical and business-aligned metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1, robustness, and latency.
* Agentic AI system design and architecture: Design and implement multi-agent systems that support multi-turn reasoning, tool use, dynamic decision-making, agent decomposition, memory management, and multi-agent coordination for control management problems.
* Agent orchestration, tooling, and data integration: Build orchestration logic for agent routing, state management, workflow coordination, and integration with tools and data sources that agents use to retrieve information, validate data, and take action.
* LLM behavior, evaluation, and monitoring: Shape agent behavior through prompt design and reasoning patterns, and implement evaluation, observability, and monitoring for accuracy, reliability, reasoning traces, tool calls, and decision auditing.
* Reusable agentic AI patterns and governance: Build reusable agent templates, patterns, and documentation that accelerate delivery, while supporting traceability, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, safeguards, and operational procedures.
* Training data strategy for NLP and deep learning: Partner with control managers, domain SMEs, data owners, and technology teams to understand workflows, decision points, and actionable outcomes; source relevant structured and unstructured data; and curate, label, and validate training and evaluation datasets.
* People management aligned to delivery above: Lead and develop a team delivering these systems by setting priorities, coordinating work across model, agent, tool, and orchestration streams, providing technical guidance, and ensuring quality, reliability, documentation, and delivery standards.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 15+ years of experience building production or near-production software, data, ML, or backend systems.
* Strong hands-on Python skills, including debugging, testing, and writing maintainable production code.
* Hands-on experience building, training, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying AI/ML, NLP, or deep learning models.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, transformers, embeddings, and generative AI concepts.
* Hands-on experience with at least one LLM or agentic AI framework.
* Experience building LLM-based or agentic AI systems with tool use, orchestration, state management, routing, and multi-step reasoning.
* Experience integrating APIs, tools, data services, and enterprise systems into AI/ML or software solutions.
* Experience implementing agent memory, context management, and multi-turn conversation patterns
* Strong independent problem-solving skills and ability to work through ambiguity.
* Clear communicator and effective cross-functional collaborator.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Production/enterprise experience building or deploying agentic systems
* Familiarity with production monitoring, logging, error handling, and operational support.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, model governance, and human-in-the-loop review patterns
* Experience with observability and tracing for agent behavior/reasoning
* Experience in risk, controls, compliance, or other highly governed environments

Location – Hyderabad
  
  
Shift – EMEA
  
  
**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

title: IT&D Manager, Smart Execution
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded IT&D Manager to lead the Smart Execution capabilities of the Sales Execution platform globally. The primary role is to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and the technology teams, owning the roadmap of the solution and manage the on-going deployment and adoption within the markets. The ultimate objective is to deliver insights which create value and drive business forward in the space of route-to-market, in-store execution and sales excellence, whilst ensuring synergy, cost effectiveness and appropriate levels of data governance.
  
  
This candidate will need to demonstrate an effective communication and delivery skillset and collaborate confidently with mid-senior levels of the organisation. We are looking for someone who can innovate, with the ability to encourage performance and motivate peers and the wider organisation to embrace advanced data & analytics capabilities.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Capability Management
  
  

* Define and own the feature roadmap for the Smart Execution capabilities, including RTM, Routing, In-store Execution and Order Recommendations
* Gather and translate business requirements from commercial and sales teams into technical user stories and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize backlogs and make decisions aligned to the business value
* Partner with the technology teams, data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and application developers to deliver the capabilities
* Manage the full technology lifecycle — from discovery and design through build, testing, and deployment
* Drive adoption of the Smart Execution capabilities across Sales (Retail Management, Key Account Management), Trade Marketing and Customer Supply, ensuring tools are effectively utilized to achieve business objectives
* Monitor usage and identify opportunities for improvement and enhancement
* Utilize a deep understanding of FMCG categories and external data to inform development and deployment strategies
* Work closely with other teams within Sales Execution Platform for a seamless integration of AI within existing workflows
* Manage vendor relationships, including implementation partners

Stakeholder Engagement:
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders of capabilities managed, building and maintaining strong relationships, and driving adoption
* Manage and communicate Roadmaps, providing details of delivery timelines, training and deployment to regional and market users
* Collaborate with and provide expertise and support to market teams, developing action plans based on analytical insights, refine processes and unlock new capabilities

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  
  

* Partner with Global and Regional commercial teams to develop analytics best practices, maintain and deliver these in the markets in alignment with the IT operating model
* Work with other Global IT&D Managers within the Sales Execution team to ensure alignment and leveraging the synergies between teams
* Ensure alignment of the technical delivery with the Reckitt’s data analytics platform - Trinity data architecture standards, patterns and principles. Align changes where necessary
* Implement solutions aligned to global IT&D enterprise architecture frameworks

The experience we're looking for
  
  
6-8+ years in business analysis, data science consulting or IT Management (with exposure to AI Product Management)
  
  

* Proven experience in designing, deploying and adopting analytical tools within commercial teams
* Experience in working with the Sales functions
* Preferred experience for role:
* FMCG / Consumer Goods experience preferred
* Previous hand-on Data Science experience preferred
* Exposure to Modern Trade and/or Pharmacy/OTC sales channels

The skills for success
  
  

* Technical Skills
* Familiarity with Sales Execution solutions or platforms
* Familiarity with Azure tech stack and Microsoft Power Platforms
* Ability to guide AI model development, managing trade-offs between data availability, model accuracy and business value delivered
* Ability to evaluate model performance and translate model outputs into business insights to drive stakeholder buy-in
* Designing experiments to measure value delivered and inferring/extrapolating results
* Delivering end-to-end ad hoc analyses including scoping, problem translation, solution design and insights generation
* Awareness of impact of solution architecture and solution design choices on infrastructure requirements
* Ability to write or review functional specifications
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and cross-functional team collaboration

Business Acumen
  
  

* Strong grasp of Sales Execution levers: execution compliance, on-shelf availability, MSL, share of shelf etc.
* Ability to translate commercial strategy and processes into design and decisions

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent stakeholder management across senior commercial and IT leadership
* Strong communication — able to speak both “business” and “tech”
* Analytical mindset with comfort around large datasets

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
**Managed Services**
is provided to our R&D customers after they go live with Veeva applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
  
  
Our
**Managed Services Team**
comprises 90+ consultants in Europe, of which 5+ are in the Safety Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are growing our team every year and opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.
  
  
Veeva is looking for Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance consultants to join the Managed Services team and support our Vault Safety solution after implementation.
  
  
**As a Safety Consultant**

This role ensures that ServiceNow enhancements, implementations, and platform changes are well defined, business aligned, user focused, and delivered in line with governance, SIAM operating models, and enterprise standards. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, process owners, platform teams, architects, and delivery partners, the Business Analyst/Technical Analyst/Technical Analyst drives requirement quality, process clarity, adoption readiness, and successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.
  
  
At dsm-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work, benefiting our People, Customers & Communities and driving business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Business Analysis & Requirements Management
* Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product owners, and platform teams to capture and clarify business requirements for ServiceNow initiatives.
* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and backlog items.
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, prioritized, and aligned with platform standards and out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities wherever possible.
* Support demand intake, impact assessment, scope definition, and change prioritization across ServiceNow modules.
* Process Design & ServiceNow Solution Alignment
* Analyze current-state processes and support the design of future-state workflows on the ServiceNow platform.
* Work with architects and functional leads to ensure requirements are translated into practical, scalable, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions.
* Support solution design across modules such as ITSM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, CMDB, ITOM, GRC, Legal Service Delivery, and custom applications as applicable.
* Promote process simplification, standardization, automation, and reuse of platform capabilities.
* Backlog, Delivery & Testing Support
* Maintain and refine the product backlog in collaboration with product owners, scrum teams, and delivery partners.
* Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirement walkthroughs, build clarifications, and functional reviews.
* Define and support test scenarios, UAT planning, defect triage, and business validation to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.
* Track requirement traceability from demand through design, build, testing, deployment, and adoption.
* Governance, Controls & Change Readiness
* Ensure requirements and process designs comply with ServiceNow governance, security, data, audit, and compliance standards.
* Support impact assessments for platform changes, releases, integrations, and process changes.
* Prepare business stakeholders for adoption through process documentation, training inputs, communication support, and transition readiness activities.
* Identify risks, dependencies, open decisions, and requirement gaps early and drive timely resolution.
* Reporting, Insights & Continuous Improvement
* Use ServiceNow data, reports, dashboards, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support continual service improvement initiatives focused on user experience, automation, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Contribute to roadmap inputs by identifying recurring pain points, process bottlenecks, and value opportunities.
* Promote data-driven decisions and measurable business outcomes from ServiceNow delivery.
* Stakeholder & Vendor Collaboration
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders, process owners, platform owners, architects, SIAM teams, and delivery partners.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, demos, and decision discussions with clear documentation and follow-through.
* Coordinate with system integrators and internal teams to clarify scope, resolve requirement questions, and validate delivery outputs.
* Act as a trusted functional advisor to stakeholders on ServiceNow process and requirement topics.
* Technical Architecture Requirements
* Define and maintain scalable ServiceNow technical architecture aligned with enterprise standards, platform governance, security requirements, and long-term product roadmap.
* Assess technical feasibility, solution options, integration patterns, data models, and platform impacts for new demands, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Guide configuration versus customization decisions, promote reuse of out-of-the-box capabilities, and ensure solutions remain upgrade-safe, maintainable, and cost-effective.
* Provide technical oversight across integrations, workflows, automation, APIs, data quality, CMDB dependencies, access controls, and environment management.
* Review solution designs, technical specifications, release plans, and deployment readiness to manage risks, dependencies, performance, resilience, and compliance obligations.

**We bring**

* A supportive environment where you’re empowered to grow and share your ideas.
* An inclusive and multicultural team with respect for everyone
* A dynamic work environment with many challenges that give you the possibility to work autonomously and with a team in finding the right solutions.

**You bring**

* 6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst/Technical Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in enterprise IT platforms.
* Strong experience working with ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, or platform operations.
* Good understanding of ITSM processes such as Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Catalog, and CMDB; exposure to HRSD, CSM, SPM, ITOM, GRC, or Legal Service Delivery is an advantage.
* Proven ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business requirements, and functional specifications.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, UAT, and release support.
* Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to balance business value, user experience, process standardization, governance, and delivery practicality.

title: Risk Manager-II, Controllership
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Transportation Controllership team is an operations finance team that ensures accurate payment and revenue integrity across Amazon's worldwide logistics cost. This is achieved through strengthening internal and external controls by working closely with multiple internal stakeholders such as Operations, Procurement, Technology groups, and external stakeholders such as carriers. The team audits billions in annual transportation cost payables and focuses on ensuring payment accuracy and reporting integrity.
  
  
The Controllership team recently expanded its scope to Revenue Controllership, to evaluate risks across Amazon's revenue-generating businesses, including Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS). Controllership conducts comprehensive controls assessments across key process areas including onboarding, invoice completeness, pricing, rates & margins, claims, and collections.
  
  
We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will execute transactional controls for last mile and revenue-side payments, conduct risk assessments, and drive compliance across assigned control areas. This role will support end-to-end Controllership by identifying control gaps, performing detailed testing, and working with business and technology teams to implement remediation actions. This is an individual contributor role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Execute and monitor transactional controls across assigned payment and revenue streams, ensuring compliance with established policies and procedures.
* Conduct risk assessments and controls testing for revenue-generating businesses, focusing on process areas such as pricing, rates, margins, onboarding, and invoice completeness.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and control documentation for assigned audit areas.
* Perform root-cause analysis on control failures and exceptions, and recommend remediation actions.
* Challenge assumptions of why a process or mechanism failed, ask the questions to get to the root cause of the problem and work for a solve.
* Support the development and enhancement of the revenue controls playbook by documenting findings and best practices.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Procurement, and Technology teams to understand process flows and identify control gaps.
* Prepare and present audit findings, risk reports, and status updates to senior team members and stakeholders.
* Track and report on key risk metrics, escalating issues as appropriate.

Drive process improvements within the Controllership function by leveraging data analysis and lean methodologies.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
* Experience establishing successful partnerships with internal and external teams to execute tactical initiatives or equivalent
* Experience with data and analysis tools including Microsoft Excel and SQL
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (esp. MS Excel, Word) at an advanced level

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment, or experience in accounts receivable or account payable
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience analyzing large datasets and translating them to actionable business insight
* Experience conducting risk assessments or controls testing in a logistics, supply chain, or transportation finance environment
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows.
  
  
Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation—not experimentation without operational accountability.
  
  
**Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator**
We are seeking a
**Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS)**
to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node.js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software.
  
  
****Core Responsibilities****

* Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule.
* Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications.
* App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node.js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS).
* Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs.
* Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance.
* Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces.

**Technical Profile**

* Core Data Engineering Foundations:
* Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms.
* Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting).
* Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts.
* Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge:
* Practical experience with Node.js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers.
* Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS).
* Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO).
* AI & Agentic Engineering:
* Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code.
* Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
* Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

****Qualifications****

* Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth).
* Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node.js/APIs).
* Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node.js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule.
* Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications.
* App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node.js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS).
* Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs.
* Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance.
* Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces.

**Technical Profile**

* Core Data Engineering Foundations:
* Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms.
* Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting).
* Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts.
* Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge:
* Practical experience with Node.js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers.
* Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS).
* Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO).
* AI & Agentic Engineering:
* Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code.
* Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
* Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth).
* Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node.js/APIs).
* Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

title: Senior Data Surveillance Analyst
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Central Monitoring, Data Analysis to join our team. As a Central Monitoring, Data Analysis, you will lead centralized monitoring activities for global and complex clinical trials, ensuring the effective configuration, execution, and maintenance of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) systems. This position plays a critical role in study execution, data accuracy, regulatory compliance, and driving innovation in clinical trial monitoring. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout.
  
  
Responsibilities include overseeing RBQM system configuration and execution, interpreting Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) data, developing advanced data analyses using programming expertise, and leading process improvement initiatives. You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing patient safety, optimizing trial performance, and delivering actionable insights. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Central Monitoring, Data Analysis can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research and data analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as a subject matter expert for the configuration, implementation, and execution of Central Monitoring RBQM systems across studies.
* Maintain Key Risk Indicator and Quality Tolerance Limit libraries within the RBQM platform to ensure standard deployment consistency and alignment with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with functional and cross-functional stakeholders to develop configuration specifications for Central Monitoring in RBQM systems.
* Provide operational expertise, training, and guidance as a point of escalation for Central Monitoring issues related to RBQM systems.
* Conduct central monitoring reviews in support of study central monitors, interpreting and presenting KRI and KPI data with actionable insights.
* Leverage programming expertise in languages such as R, SQL, or SAS to develop custom analyses, automate workflows, and integrate data systems.
* Participate in ongoing improvements in standardizing technologies, systems, processes, and training materials that support Central Monitoring and RBQM.
* Represent Central Monitoring in process improvement initiatives and contribute to innovation in central monitoring capabilities through collaboration with cross-functional teams.

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Technical expertise in database design, system configuration, and report development with experience managing RBQM systems or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or SAS, with the ability to develop scripts for data analysis, automation, and system integration.
* Strong analytical problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, with experience troubleshooting data refreshes and resolving execution errors in analytical systems.
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment.
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, with effective interpersonal skills.
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Comfort working with RBQM platforms, electronic data capture systems, and clinical databases.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in a related field.
* At least 4 years of relevant biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience.
* Minimum 2 years of direct experience with RBQM systems or similar centralized monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data manipulation and reporting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in a related field such as Data Science, Biostatistics, or Clinical Research.
* Experience with CluePoints or similar centralized monitoring and risk-based quality management solutions.
* Experience in site monitoring, data management, or clinical operations.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and interpret business trends and apply them to centralized monitoring practices.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
  
  
We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement Measurement & Analytics Delivery**

* Independently delivered measurement analyses assessing the effectiveness of omnichannel customer engagement across field, CRM, paid media, owned digital, and third-party channels.
* Apply machine learning techniques to identify patterns in customer engagement, channel synergy, sequencing, pacing, and message performance.
* Support the development and operationalization of measurement frameworks, KPI tracking tools, and performance dashboards aligned with the team's strategic priorities.
* Analyze HCP and patient journeys, funnels, channel sequencing, and frequency to identify drivers of engagement and opportunities to optimize campaigns.
* Track and report channel-level and cross-channel campaign KPIs (e.g., reach, open and click rates, engagement depth, conversion, response, cost efficiency, and downstream impact on prescribing or patient behavior).
* Synthesize analytical findings into clear, structured outputs and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders and team leads.

**Experimentation & Test-and-Learn Support**

* Support the design and execution of AI-informed test-and-learn strategies, including A/B tests, lift studies, and incrementality experiments across customer engagement tactics.
* Assist in defining success metrics, measurement windows, and statistical approaches to evaluate new engagement strategies.
* Contribute to the documentation and socialization of experimental learnings to inform ongoing campaign planning across brands.
* Help refine experimentation frameworks to accelerate learning cycles and improve engagement effectiveness.

**Advanced Analytics & Attribution**

* Apply advanced statistical and AI/ML techniques to measure the incremental impact of customer engagement activities.
* Support the use of attribution frameworks such as multi-touch attribution, Markov chain modelling, and causal inference methods (e.g., propensity scoring, matched control).
* Contribute to the integration of outputs from MMx, KDA, and predictive models to support engagement optimization strategies.
* Leverage automation to improve speed, consistency, and repeatability of insights delivery.

**Stakeholder Partnership & Communication**

* Partner with US Commercial stakeholders, Brand, Omnichannel Strategy, Field Analytics, CRM, Digital, Digital Marketing, Campaign Management, Martech/CRM Operations, Media Agency, Web Analytics, and Technology teams to contribute to campaign and channel measurement solution design.
* Clearly communicate measurement methodologies, assumptions, model limitations, and implications for decision-making to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Contribute to stakeholder presentations and working sessions with structured, insight-driven storytelling focused on impact and commercial actions.

**Team Collaboration & Capability Building**

* Collaborate within cross-functional and global teams to ensure consistent, scalable, and governed analytical delivery aligned with AI best practices.
* Mentor junior analysts on advanced measurement methodologies, analytical rigor, and responsible data usage.
* Contribute to the development of reusable analytics frameworks, measurement templates, and best practices that scale across brands.
* Promote high standards of reproducibility and documentation across all team deliverables.

**Technical Execution & Data Stewardship**

* Build and maintain campaign and channel AI-enabled measurement datasets, dashboards, and automated workflows supporting omnichannel engagement analytics.
* Work closely with data engineering, technology, and build teams to troubleshoot data issues and provide measurement-driven feedback to enhance commercial solutions.
* Exposure of digital platforms and data sources (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, marketing automation, CRM, ad platforms, Veeva) to ensure data quality, tagging accuracy, and reliable campaign reporting.
* Ensure analytical outputs are reproducible, well-documented, and aligned with data governance, compliance, and responsible use standards.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex analytics and engagement insights into clear business outcomes, including AI-generated findings.
* Solid project execution and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams in parallel.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail, data quality, and measurement rigor.
* Hands-on expertise in applied statistics, analytics, and advanced measurement concepts relevant to omnichannel performance.
* Familiarity with HCP and patient engagement journeys across digital, field, and media channels.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed, stakeholder-driven environment.
* Curiosity and passion for learning, innovation, and continuous improvement in analytics and measurement.
* Campaign performance analysis and optimization mindset, with the ability to turn performance data into actionable campaign recommendations.
* Understanding of digital marketing metrics and channel mechanics (e.g., email, programmatic, paid social, search, web).
* Stakeholder management with marketing, campaign, and omnichannel teams

**Experience & Qualifications**

* BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred in data science, analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, life sciences, computer science, or engineering.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in advanced analytics, digital analytics, marketing analytics, campaign analytics, decision science, or omnichannel engagement measurement roles, ideally within an AI-driven commercial environment.
* Proven experience delivering end-to-end analytics and measurement projects, from problem framing to insight delivery.
* Experience managing or supporting campaign performance reporting and optimization across multiple digital and field channels.
* Experience with attribution and impact measurement techniques (e.g., multi-touch attribution, causal inference, uplift modeling) is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with business stakeholders and support data-informed decision-making.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industries preferred.
* Familiarity with pharma commercial data (e.g., Veeva CRM, Approved Email, rep-triggered email, HCP engagement data, claims/Rx data) preferred.
* Proficiency in Python or R for analytical modeling and data transformation.
* Experience with cloud-based analytics environments (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent) preferred.

**Technical Skills (Preferred)**

* Predictive and statistical analytics using Python and SQL, including uplift modeling, drivers analysis, propensity modeling, and causal inference methods.
* Familiarity with attribution frameworks such as multi-touch attribution and Markov chain modeling.
* Experience working with performance metrics, campaign KPIs, and analytics outputs.
* Experience working with performance metrics, model diagnostics, and AI-enabled analytics outputs.
* Data visualization and dashboarding tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau, Dash, or similar platforms).
* Experience in collaborative analytics environments (e.g., Databricks, Git-based workflows, SharePoint).
* Familiarity with omnichannel, CRM, digital marketing, and commercial data sources.
* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and campaign reporting.
* Marketing automation and CRM tools such as Veeva CRM, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar.
* Familiarity with ad platform and programmatic reporting (e.g., DV360, LinkedIn, Meta, DSP data).
* Exposure to generative AI tools to support insight summarization and reporting automation is a plus.

title: Data System Analyst
description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Ensuring processes are set up, operate efficiently and reliably, including data quality monitoring, automation development, and KPI reporting. Act as processual liaison between BMT operations and SAP COE, enabling data-driven decision-making and continuous process optimization.
  
  
Data Handover Process Design & Optimization
  
  

* Conduct current-state assessment of LoB billing data flows (interviews, process mapping, gap analysis)
* Design future-state data handover process with clear steps, roles (RACI), validation gates, and submission deadlines
* Develop and pilot to validate approach, select optimal solution (or hybrid) based on data quality, LoB effort reduction, scalability, and cost
* Deploy selected solution for Wave 1 (LoB 1) and refine for Waves 2-3 based on lessons learned

Data Quality Management
  
  

* Define "complete data" checklists by pricing type (fixed-fee, variable, basis points, T&E, complex)
* Design automated data validation rules (completeness, accuracy, consistency checks)
* Monitor data submissions for anomalies and quality issues
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies impacting invoice accuracy
* Coordinate with LoB operations teams on data quality improvements and training needs

Process Documentation & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Document end-to-end billing processes (as-is and to-be)
* Create standard operating procedures (SOPs) for data submission, validation, exception handling
* Develop data submission calendars, templates, and user guides for LoB teams
* Maintain process documentation repository ensuring version control and accessibility
* Support AD Academy with data handover training materials and LoB workshops

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Generate weekly data quality reports for PMO Lead and monthly summaries for Steering Committee
* Perform ad-hoc analysis supporting business questions

Stakeholder Coordination & Change Management
  
  

* Partner with LoB operations teams to co-design data handover workflows respecting their constraints
* Conduct LoB workshops training regional teams on new data submission processes
* Facilitate dry-run billing cycle validating end-to-end data flow
* Escalate chronic data quality issues to LoB Leaders and PMO Lead

* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, macros, Power Query)
* Experience with data quality frameworks, validation rules, and reconciliation processes
* Familiarity with automation tools (UiPath, Power Automate, or similar RPA platforms)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
* Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills (ability to work with LoB operations teams)
* SAP FI/AR knowledge helpful

* Process mapping and optimization (SIPOC, value stream analysis, workflow design)

title: Centralized Monitoring Analyst (Level I & II)
description:

Second Shift (Afternoons)

Office

* Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials

* Exposure to electrical office equipment.
* Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.
  
  
Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

title: AdOps Data & Audience Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an Identity & Audience Solutions Specialist with strong AdTech experience across identity resolution, audience addressability and activation.
  
  
The ideal candidate should understand how first-party audience data and identifiers can be connected across web, mobile app and CTV, resolved into unified audience profiles, enriched with third-party data, and activated through CDPs, ad servers and programmatic platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess user identifiers, identity architecture, audience data flows and activation capabilities across digital properties.
* Design identity resolution approaches for both anonymous and registered users across web, app and CTV.
* Work with identifiers such as hashed email, device IDs, MAIDs, ECID, UID2, publisher/account IDs and CTV IDs.
* Support cross-device and cross-brand identity resolution and creation of unified audience profiles.
* Work with CDP platforms to build audience segments and activate them across advertising and marketing destinations.
* Connect audience segments to platforms such as FreeWheel, GAM, DSPs, SSPs and paid media platforms.
* Analyze identity match rates, audience overlap, addressable reach and activation gaps.
* Support third-party audience enrichment and identity matching using platforms such as Experian or similar data providers.
* Support audience activation for Direct, PMP, Programmatic and CTV advertising use cases.
* Work with Data, Engineering, AdOps and business teams to translate identity and audience requirements into scalable solutions.

**Requirements**

* 5–7+ years of experience in AdTech, identity solutions, audience data or programmatic advertising.
* Strong understanding of identity resolution, identity graphs and audience addressability.
* Experience handling identity across web, mobile applications and CTV/streaming environments.
* Experience with CDP/audience platforms such as Hightouch, Tealium, Segment, mParticle, Adobe RTCDP, Treasure Data or similar.
* Experience with identity solutions such as UID2, LiveRamp, Experian, Neustar or similar.
* Good understanding of FreeWheel, Google Ad Manager, SSPs, DSPs and programmatic advertising workflows.
* Understanding of first-party data, third-party enrichment, anonymous-user identity and audience activation.
* Working knowledge of SQL and data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift.
* Strong problem-solving and client-facing communication skills.
* Experience translating audience/identity capabilities into publisher monetization use cases such as Direct audience targeting, PMP deals, CTV targeting and audience-based advertising products.

**Good To Have**
Experience with Hightouch, Databricks, FreeWheel, Experian, UID2, LiveRamp, Piano, Zephr, Clean rooms, CTV identity or cross-brand identity resolution would be an added advantage.
  
  
**Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance**
Security is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will be strictly required to uphold our Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001 standards. Responsibilities include safeguarding sensitive asset data, completing mandatory security awareness training, reporting potential security incidents or vulnerabilities immediately, and ensuring that daily operations comply with our rigorous data protection protocols.
