title: Quality Specialist - Telugu, AGI Data Services - Quality
description:
**Description**
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.
  
  
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).
  
  
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Advanced-level proficiency or C1+ in Telugu language (Strong verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in speaking, listening, and writing.)
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
* Experience in creating and maintaining process documentation, SOPs, or quality guideline

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline)
* Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops
* Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams

Transaction Reporting Control Group are responsible for ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the Bank’s transaction reporting obligations across multiple global regulatory jurisdictions. The Submission Control function is responsible for monitoring and remediating the internal validation failures and the rejects (NACKs) from the regulators, the team must liaise with MO/FO/Tech teams for the root causes of the exceptions. Submission control also monitors the trades which are not getting reported within the compliance time for OTC/ETD/Securities and raise breaches for all timeliness issues that missed the agreed thresholds. The Enhanced Quality Assurance team perform post process testing to validate the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the transaction reports submissions through performing reconciliations and targeted deep dive sample-based QA testing.

* Support new regulatory initiatives, system changes, and testing activities impacting the Material Terms Reconciliation process.
* This is a very hands-on role, ideal for someone with drive and willingness to learn and adapt, is proactive and has very good knowledge about the reporting regulation and the reporting system architecture

**Responsibilities**

* Document errors as per the guidelines and ensure remediation of the issue. Raise technology requirement JIRAs. Hands-on experience in validating user acceptance test results
* Investigate and identify the root cause for the Transaction Reporting breaks and coordinate with FO/MO/Tech to fix them

title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel.
* Experience with production deployments, AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting.

**Key Skills**

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

**Why Join Trida Labs?**

At Trida Labs, you will work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems.

You will collaborate with customers and engineering teams across solution design, AI implementation, enterprise data integration, evaluation, production troubleshooting, and product improvement—helping turn real customer requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities.

**Equal Opportunity**

Trida Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

title: Business Analyst - CPQ
description:
**About the job**

**Job Title: Business Analyst, CPQ**

**Experience: 7 –9 Years**

**Employment Type:**
Permanent | Full-Time

**Shift & Hours:**
Regular Shift

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview:**

* We run the Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) platform for a global enterprise client on Salesforce Sales Cloud and Conga CPQ, with Conga Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) being adopted alongside it. The platform lives in a large, shared, multi-domain Salesforce org that serves many business units with a high-volume product catalog. Our mandate is to onboard a long pipeline of commercial offerings, each with its own catalog, pricing, rules, approvals and document templates. The application is documented in a structured knowledge base, so new team members learn from feature pages and process journeys rather than from tribal memory.

**The role**

* You own the functional definition of every offering we onboard. You take a product or pricing owner's description of how they sell, translate it into CPQ constructs, write stories a developer or configurator can execute without coming back to you, and prove the result works with the business in UAT. Conga experience is not required to start. Prior delivery on a CPQ platform is, together with the ability to learn a new one quickly from documentation and configuration data.

**What you will do**

* Run offering intake workshops with commercial, pricing, legal and finance owners and capture the as-is selling process, pricing model and approval paths.
* Model each offering into CPQ terms: product hierarchy, bundles and options, attributes, price lists and price list items, pricing and constraint rules, approval rules, quote and agreement templates.
* Write user stories with testable acceptance criteria, including data readiness, migration and rollback notes.
* Analyze existing configuration and data (price lists, rules, templates, field usage) to find reuse before anything new is created.
* Prepare UAT scenarios and test data, run UAT sessions, triage defects and separate configuration gaps from real bugs.
* Keep the feature documentation of every touched area current as part of each story's definition of done.
* Work daily with the technical lead, CPQ configurators, data engineer and QA, and represent the business view in design reviews.

**Must have:**

* 7+ years as a business analyst or functional consultant on enterprise applications, 3+ of them on any CPQ platform: Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Industries (Vlocity) CPQ, Oracle CPQ, SAP CPQ, PROS, Zilliant, DealHub, Zuora or Apttus/Conga.
* Working knowledge of quote-to-cash: catalog structure, bundles, attribute-based configuration, list and tiered pricing, discounting, approval matrices, contract generation.
* Proven ability to read configuration data and write precise, unambiguous requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Comfortable with data: advanced Excel, and SOQL or SQL for your own analysis.
* Agile delivery tooling (Jira, Azure DevOps or similar) and documentation tooling (Confluence or similar); strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder management in English.
* Salesforce platform literacy at Administrator level: objects, fields, record types, flows, permission sets.

**Good to have:**

* Conga CPQ or Conga RLM exposure.
* Document generation tools in the Salesforce ecosystem (Conga Composer, DocuSign Gen, Nintex or similar).
* Configuration data migration between orgs (Prodly, Data Loader, scripted loads or similar).
* Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification.
* Pricing experience in services, subscription or project-based businesses.
* If your CPQ experience is on another platform.

title: Sr Data Analyst
description:
‒ Review property, availability, tenancy and comp data as it moves through the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers, and flag quality issues before they reach downstream users.
  
  
‒ Build data validation checks, including AI-assisted checks such as anomaly detection, that catch bad data automatically rather than after the fact.
  
  
‒ Standardize CRE data fields, such as property type, rent type, rate type and lease structure, so the same term means the same thing across every source system.
  
  
‒ Define and track data quality metrics, including completeness, consistency, accuracy, timeliness and duplication rate, and report them to stakeholders on a regular cadence.
  
  
‒ Investigate discrepancies between internal systems, external data feeds and source documents, and trace root causes back to the pipeline stage that introduced them.
  
  
‒ Analyze property, availability, tenancy and comp data to surface patterns: vacancy trends, rent growth, tenant turnover, lease expirations and comparable sales activity.
  
  
‒ Translate findings into business insights for brokers, researchers and leadership: build dashboards, write clear summaries and answer ad hoc questions.
  
  
‒ Partner with data engineers and AI engineers on upstream fixes, so quality issues get solved at the source, not patched downstream.
  
  
‒ Document data lineage, transformation logic and quality rules, so the team can audit and reproduce every number.
  
  
‒ Recommend AI and machine learning approaches to automate data validation work: anomaly detection, deduplication, document classification and similar.
  
  
**What You Bring**
‒ 6+ years of experience as a data analyst, ideally in commercial real estate, financial services or another data-heavy industry.
  
  
‒ Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
  
  
‒ Experience with a Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) or similar layered data architecture.
  
  
‒ A track record of building and improving data quality and validation frameworks, not just running one-off checks.
  
  
‒ Experience applying AI or machine learning to data quality work: anomaly detection, entity resolution, document extraction or similar.
  
  
‒ Comfort working with property, availability, tenancy and comparable sales (comps) data, or the ability to learn the domain quickly.
  
  
‒ Strong business acumen: you connect data findings to what they mean for brokers, asset managers and clients, not just what the numbers say on their own.
  
  
‒ Proficiency with a business intelligence (BI) tool such as Power BI or Tableau, and Python for analysis and automation.
  
  
‒ Clear, confident communication. You explain data problems and insights to non-technical stakeholders without losing precision.
  
  
**Nice to Have**
‒ Exposure to CRE data platforms or sources, such as CoStar, RealNex, Yardi or MRI.
  
  
‒ Experience with a data catalog or data governance tool.

Amazon’s Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team is seeking an experienced program manager to lead program(s) focused on transporter safety in the Amazon Geospatial domain. An ideal candidate for this role has solid program management skills and is eager to develop them further. S/he has the ability to implement and maintain processes and mechanisms to effectively support program execution. S/he should be comfortable with data analysis, assisting in process improvements, and helping to standardize procedures under guidance. The candidate should be able to identify issues within current systems and contribute to resolving them.
  
  
This job requires good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment while also managing tasks independently. The successful candidate will be capable of addressing logistical challenges, show initiative in problem-solving, and demonstrate a strong commitment to completing projects and delivering results.
  
  
The ideal Program Manager will be detail-oriented, organized, and able to juggle multiple priorities effectively. S/he should be proficient in using project management tools and be ready to learn and adapt to new methodologies and technologies in the world of geospatial data.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Own the Program, define and achieve KPIs; Drive performance improvement initiatives.
* Develop and monitor program metrics to identify potential issues in last mile deliveries.
* Identify patterns of defects that will help us build initiatives to reduce defects at scale.
* Ability to pull data and perform deep-dives and root-cause analysis as needed.
* Lead initiatives to identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to reduce defects and improve the delivery experience for Amazon customers.
* Very good communication, both verbal and written to regularly provide business updates during weekly/monthly/quarterly reviews.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company

Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. **JOB PURPOSE:**

The Director, Analytics & Automation is a senior business transformation leadership role responsible for advancing CIBC’s Infrastructure and Operations Transformation mandate through business-led process optimization, low-code/no-code automation, strategic analytics, and scalable reporting. This role is not limited to process engineering, analytics, or tool delivery; it requires a strategist who understands banking operations, can diagnose complex business problems, and can partner deeply with business leaders to redesign processes and deliver measurable, tangible outcomes. The role provides thought leadership, leads a technical analytics and automation team and co-owns business outcomes with partners. The successful candidate will combine strategic leadership with strong hands on technical credibility, enabling them to guide solution design, coach technical teams, challenge implementation decisions and remain close to delivery.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Lead complex business transformation and automation initiatives, while directing a multidisciplinary technical team through design, build, implementation and sustainment phases.
* Partner with executive stakeholders, business leaders, technology partners, and centers of excellence to identify root-cause business problems, redesign complex processes, and deliver flexible, innovative solutions that may include AI-assisted, low-code/no-code, data, workflow, or operating model changes

* Identify opportunities to improve maintenance efficiency, enabling technical teams to focus on higher value build and transformation activity.
* Provide hands on technical leadership across low-code/no-code automation, analytics, and reporting solutions, guiding architecture, design decisions and delivery quality across platforms including Microsoft Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Databricks, Alteryx, Python, SQL, Azure DevOps, VBA, Selenium, SharePoint Online, and other fit-for-purpose platforms as business needs evolve
* Provide strategic business and technical expertise on complex banking process issues, including business case development, financial impact assessment, risk and control considerations, implementation approach, and sustainment requirements
* Co-own target business outcomes with business partners, monitor benefit realization after implementation, and recommend enhancements where strategic objectives, adoption, controls, or measurable value are not being achieved
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing technical team of analytics, reporting, and automation professionals, setting clear priorities, expectations, and performance standards.
* Own prioritization and delivery of the analytics and automation portfolio, balancing business value, capacity, risk, complexity, and strategic alignment
* Ensure delivered solutions include appropriate governance, documentation, controls, sustainment, and benefit tracking
* Drive adoption and change management with business partners to ensure solutions are embedded, scalable, and delivering measurable outcomes

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Establish and maintain trusted relationships with Infrastructure leadership, Operations teams, and business stakeholders to understand banking processes in depth, identify material pain points, influence decision-making, and advance transformation priorities through practical, scalable, business-led solutions.
* Collaborate with Centers of Excellence to design, build, and implement scalable automation solutions
* Engage regularly with executive leaders to provide insights, recommendations, and decision support on strategic and operational priorities
* Work with Technology, Data, and BI teams to enable access to multiple data sources and support solution integration
* Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, and Control partners to ensure adherence to governance, policy, and enterprise standards
* Represent the business area in executive forums and enterprise committees, advocating for priorities and influencing organizational direction

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As a people manager, this role is responsible for ensuring employees within its span of control comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a people manager, this role has the authority to assign work within its span of control, select candidates for hire, assess individual performance, make compensation decisions, and take disciplinary action up to and including termination, in accordance with applicable policies

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Leads a team focused on Analytics & Automation initiatives in support of CIBC’s Infrastructure and Operations Transformation mandate. Accountable for delivery of complex, high-impact analytics, reporting, dashboarding, and automation solutions, while providing strategic advice, decision support, and thought leadership to senior and executive stakeholders

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* 12+ years of relevant experience in analytics, automation, business intelligence, strategic program delivery, or operations transformation
* Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical teams and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives in a large enterprise environment.
* Deep experience in financial services, banking, infrastructure, or operations transformation, with a strong understanding of end-to-end banking processes and how to improve them through process redesign, automation, data, and controls optimization
* Relevant certifications in analytics, automation, project delivery, or business intelligence tools are considered an asset

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Deep expertise in low-code/no-code automation, workflow orchestration, and business application development using tools such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Databricks, Alteryx, VBA, Selenium, Python, SQL, Azure DevOps, SharePoint Online, and related enterprise automation platforms
* Strong business process optimization capability, with the ability to assess complex operating models, identify root causes and constraints, and translate opportunities into practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes
* Strategic and business-driven mindset, with the judgement to look beyond preferred tools and recommend the right mix of process, data, automation, governance, change, and operating model solutions
* Advanced analytical capability with the ability to interpret complex information, identify trends, and translate insights into practical business recommendations
* Proven project delivery capability in leading critical and complex initiatives involving products, processes, programs, or services
* Highly collaborative approach with demonstrated ability to work side-by-side with business partners, challenge constructively, align stakeholders, and share accountability for outcomes from design through adoption
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly convey insights and recommendations to service leaders and executives
* Excellent relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills, especially with executive-level partners across the organization
* Strong leadership capability with experience leading technical teams, empowering subject matter experts, and driving high-performing team outcomes.
* Sound judgement, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail in managing strategic and operational priorities
* Proficiency in English (written and verbal).

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Primarily office-based with flexibility for hybrid work arrangements
* Requires regular collaboration with senior leaders, business partners, and cross-functional teams across functions and time zones
* Fast-paced environment with frequent senior stakeholder interaction, complex problem-solving, and evolving business priorities

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst**

**Role Overview**

Serve as the bridge between the customer’s business teams and the engineering organization on a
**privacy-first programmatic Digital Out-of-Home (pDOOH) platform**
for a major MENA telecommunications operator. You will elicit, document, and validate requirements across the DOOH Control Plane and Monetization & Data Plane — spanning CMS integration, SSP auction logic, demand-side flows, billing reconciliation, and partner-facing reporting.

This is a hands-on BA role — you will run workshops, author BRDs and FRDs, map process flows, and support user acceptance testing through to release sign-off.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Requirements elicitation:**
  Run discovery workshops with the customer’s operations, sales, finance, and IT stakeholders; capture business needs across both platform planes.
* **Documentation:**
  Author BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and use cases that engineering can build from without ambiguity.
* **Process modeling:**
  Produce as-is and to-be process maps in BPMN or swim-lane format for venue onboarding, deal management, approval workflows, billing reconciliation, and Proof of Play flows.
* **Integration analysis:**
  Map data flows and field-level requirements for integrations with customer CMS, SSO/LDAP, BCRM, EDW, and external DSP partners (DV360, The Trade Desk, Hivestack, Criteo, MediaMath, Xandr).
* **Gap analysis:**
  Compare current state versus target state across adjacent systems; surface configuration-versus-customization decisions for engineering.
* **Configuration design:**
  Define rate card structures, deal type rules, RBAC matrices, inventory packaging logic, and slot governance policies for platform configuration.
* **UAT support:**
  Design test scenarios with the customer, coordinate user acceptance testing, and manage defect triage through sign-off.
* **Stakeholder liaison:**
  Translate between business vocabulary and engineering language; clarify ambiguity in PRDs and architectural decisions through the delivery cycle.

**Required Experience**

* **6+ years**
  as a Business Analyst in B2B SaaS or enterprise platforms.
* **AdTech depth:**
  Hands-on with at least one of SSP, DSP, ad server, attribution, or DOOH/RMN platform. AdTech BA experience strongly preferred.
* **Documentation craft:**
  Proven BRD, FRD, user story, and acceptance criteria authorship for systems shipped at enterprise scale.
* **Process modeling:**
  BPMN, swim-lane process maps, and sequence diagrams.
* **Integration & data analysis:**
  Hands-on field-level data mapping, API contract review, and integration specs.
* **Technical fluency:**
  Comfortable with OpenRTB, REST API specs, latency/throughput SLAs — able to challenge engineering trade-offs constructively.
* **UAT facilitation:**
  Structured test scenario design and defect triage in enterprise B2B contexts.

title: Power BI Lead / Business Objects Lead – AI-Enabled BI & Analytics
description:
**Job Title: Power BI Lead / Business Objects Lead**
**Experience:**
8 - 12 Years
  
  
**Job Function:**
Business Intelligence, Data Analytics & Reporting
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Job Summary**
Blumetra Solutions is looking for an experienced
**Power BI Lead / Business Objects Lead**
to lead the design, development, migration, optimization, and delivery of enterprise BI and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Power BI and/or SAP BusinessObjects (BO), data modelling, SQL, dashboard development, reporting architecture, and performance optimization.
  
  
The role requires a strong understanding of business intelligence architecture, semantic models, data integration, and enterprise reporting. Candidates should also have practical experience leveraging AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent solutions to accelerate BI development, automate reporting activities, improve data analysis, and enhance development productivity.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineering teams, and customers to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and insightful analytics solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* BI Development & Architecture
* Lead the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of enterprise BI solutions using Power BI and/or SAP BusinessObjects.
* Design interactive dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical visualizations aligned with business requirements.
* Develop and maintain reusable reporting components, semantic models, datasets, and standardized BI frameworks.
* Define BI architecture, development standards, naming conventions, security practices, and deployment approaches.
* Evaluate existing reporting solutions and recommend improvements in usability, scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Power BI Expertise
* Develop and optimize Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M), data modelling, and advanced visualization techniques.
* Implement efficient data models, relationships, measures, calculated columns, and time-intelligence calculations.
* Configure row-level security (RLS), workspaces, apps, gateways, refresh schedules, and deployment pipelines as applicable.
* Optimize report rendering, DAX expressions, data refresh performance, and model size.
* Work with DirectQuery, Import, and composite models based on business and performance requirements.
* Business Objects Expertise
* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise reports using SAP BusinessObjects tools, where applicable.
* Work with Web Intelligence (WebI), Information Design Tool (IDT), Universe design, and related BO reporting components.
* Develop and optimize universes, semantic layers, queries, prompts, and complex reporting logic.
* Troubleshoot reporting issues, query performance, data inconsistencies, and refresh failures.
* Support BO report modernization, migration, rationalization, and integration with modern BI platforms where required.
* SQL, Data Modelling & Integration
* Write and optimize complex SQL queries, joins, subqueries, aggregations, and analytical queries.
* Work with relational databases, data warehouses, and cloud data platforms to build reliable reporting solutions.
* Validate source data, transformations, business rules, and report-level calculations.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to integrate BI solutions with ETL/ELT pipelines and enterprise data platforms.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, reconciliation, and traceability across reports and dashboards.
* AI-Powered BI & Analytics
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent tools to accelerate report development, DAX and SQL authoring, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Explore AI-powered capabilities for natural-language analytics, conversational reporting, automated insights, and report summarization.
* Develop AI-assisted utilities to automate repetitive BI development, testing, documentation, and validation activities.
* Evaluate opportunities to integrate Power BI or enterprise reporting solutions with approved AI services and governed enterprise data sources.
* Apply appropriate validation, access controls, and data privacy practices when using AI-generated code, insights, or business outputs.
* Stay updated on emerging AI capabilities in business intelligence, augmented analytics, and self-service reporting.
* Performance, Quality & Governance
* Establish BI development standards, code review practices, testing procedures, and release management processes.
* Optimize dashboards, semantic models, SQL queries, and reporting workloads for performance and scalability.
* Ensure data security, role-based access, governance, and compliance with organizational standards.
* Drive report validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), defect resolution, and production readiness.
* Maintain technical documentation, data definitions, report specifications, and deployment procedures.
* Leadership & Stakeholder Management
* Lead and mentor BI developers and reporting teams, providing technical guidance and quality oversight.
* Engage with customers, business users, product owners, and data engineering teams to gather requirements and define solutions.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable BI architectures and actionable analytics.
* Manage delivery timelines, technical dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work within Agile/Scrum delivery models and use Jira or similar project management tools.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, BI development, reporting, and analytics.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Power BI or SAP BusinessObjects.
* For Power BI-focused candidates: proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M), semantic modelling, and dashboard optimization.
* For Business Objects-focused candidates: experience with Web Intelligence (WebI), Universe design, IDT, and enterprise reporting.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and data warehouses.
* Experience with data modelling, semantic layers, data integration, and ETL/ELT concepts.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent AI platforms.
* Understanding of AI-enabled analytics, automated insights, natural-language reporting, or opportunities to integrate AI into BI workflows.
* Experience with BI performance tuning, troubleshooting, report testing, and production support.
* Strong understanding of data security, access controls, reporting governance, and quality standards.
* Experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring developers, and coordinating with business stakeholders.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as Jira.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or cloud-based analytics platforms.
* Exposure to Snowflake, Databricks, or other modern cloud data warehouses.
* Experience with Power BI Service administration, deployment pipelines, and enterprise-scale semantic models.
* Experience migrating legacy BusinessObjects reports to Power BI or other modern BI platforms.
* Knowledge of Python or scripting for BI automation and data analysis.
* Exposure to generative AI, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or AI-powered business analytics.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
A technically strong BI professional with proven leadership capabilities, deep expertise in enterprise reporting, and a forward-looking approach to AI-enabled analytics. The candidate should be able to design scalable BI solutions, improve reporting performance, guide development teams, and translate business needs into actionable insights while maintaining data quality, security, and governance.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
**Purpose of role**

* The Data Analyst is a key member of the Kilimanjaro Transformation Pprogramme, responsible for the accuracy, consistency and integrity of Keyloop’s product and pricing data, with a primary focus on legacy SKU mapping and catalogue validation
* The Data Analyst works closely with Pricing, Product Management and, Finance and Billing to ensure that legacy SKUs are accurately mapped to the Product Index architecture and that catalogue and CPQ data reflects the agreed pricing logic

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the mapping of legacy SKUs to the Product Index architecture, documenting the mapping rationale, dependencies and exceptions for each SKU
* Investigate the commercial history of legacy SKUs (including contractual, pricing and billing context) and work with Pricing and Product Management to resolve ambiguities and agree the target mapping
* Validate product catalogue and pricing data on CPQ against the Product Index and the agreed pricing rules; identify, log and drive the resolution of discrepancies
* Design and run repeatable validation checks (e.g. mapping coverage, completeness, duplicates, price and unit consistency) to give confidence in data quality
* Extract, cleanse and reconcile data from legacy systems, the data warehouse and Salesforce, ensuring a clear audit trail from source to target
* Work with Billing and Finance to ensure that mapped SKUs remain consistent with contract and invoice data
* Support data migration and validation activities as required by the programme
* Maintain clear documentation (mapping rules, data definitions and decision log) and report progress, risks and open issues to the Pricing team and programme stakeholders

**Key Skills**

* Proven experience in data analysis, data mapping and validation of large, complex datasets (ideally product, catalogue or pricing data)
* Proficient in Excel, including advanced lookups, pivot tables, data cleansing and reconciliation
* Comfortable with Salesforce or similar - including database manipulation, extraction and validation
* Strong attention to detail, with a structured approach to investigating legacy data and resolving ambiguity
* Strong written and verbal communication, with good stakeholder management across Pricing, Product, Finance and Billing
* Able to work independently and deliver to programme deadlines in a fixed-term environment

**Desired, but not essential:**

* Experience with Salesforce CPQ - including product catalogue architecture, pricing rules and data migration/validation
* Experience working on a large CRM, ERP or data migration programme
* Experience with B2B Software as a Service (SaaS) products and pricing
* Comfortable with Power BI
* Experience working in an international environment

**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
  
  
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
  
  
**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

title: P&BP CoE Assistant Manager
description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About The Finance Planning & Reporting CoE**
Driving efficiency and standardization across our renowned consumer brands that enhance everyday lives—from nourishing meals to trusted household essentials—is the pivotal force of the Finance Planning & Reporting Center of Excellence (CoE). Fuelled by a culture of collaboration and innovation, the CoE is integral to our organization, championing financial excellence and strategic insight across our global landscape. We are a dynamic, agile team, relentlessly focused on enhancing our financial processes, harnessing advanced analytics, and delivering unparalleled value to every facet of our business.
  
  
We transcend traditional finance roles; we are a strategic partner where diverse talents converge to tackle intricate financial challenges, foster sustainable growth, and empower our mission to create a healthier, more sustainable world for all. By ensuring a clear line of sight between strategic goals and day-to-day financial activities, we enable efficient performance management and better business results through the collaboration of our people, processes, and systems.
  
  
Our CoE transforms finance from a traditional back-office function into a strategic powerhouse that drives business value, as talented individuals come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Assistant Manager - Planning & Reporting CoE, you will report into a Finance Manager and be part of a team of analysts supporting a portfolio of markets. In this role, you will play a key part in executing financial planning and reporting activities across these markets. You will support the creation of standardized reports, development of initial forecasts/budgets, and analysis of financial performance to enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to multiple markets while contributing to the centralization and improvement of Reckitt’s FP&A processes. If you are passionate about finance, data analysis, and continuous improvement, this role will allow you to grow and make a real impact on our global business.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain standard reporting packs for various stakeholders, ensuring that key performance metrics are accurately captured and delivered on time to support informed decision-making.
* Manage the publication of dashboards and reports, enhancing financial visibility and ensuring timely delivery of insights that reflect current performance and trends.
* Conduct ad hoc analyses to support business decisions and strategic initiatives, providing clear explanations of variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) and highlighting key drivers behind the numbers.
* Automate forecasting processes and support planning cycle activities, coordinating data collection from various markets, validating submissions, and aligning assumptions with global guidelines to create a cohesive financial outlook.
* Provide scenario templates and centrally modelled assumptions for planning, ensuring consistency in reporting and analytics practices across teams to maintain data integrity.
* Collaborate closely with market finance teams and other CoE members to ensure a single source of truth in our financial systems, acting as a liaison to help local teams understand CoE processes and troubleshoot any data or reporting issues.
* Participate in finance transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline and improve existing FP&A processes, contributing to the standardization of report templates and the automation of manual tasks to enhance efficiency.
* Assist with ad-hoc analysis and projects as needed, such as deep-dives into specific expenses or trends, scenario modelling for strategic projects, or preparing financial decks for senior leadership meetings, turning data into actionable insights.
* Adapt and excel in a dynamic environment, demonstrating agility and teamwork while managing last-minute changes or requests, especially during key reporting periods, and maintaining a high standard of quality in all deliverables.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in finance, reporting, or analytics, with a preference for CPG industry experience.
* Strong analytical skills with a focus on data interpretation and presentation.
* Familiarity with financial planning and analysis processes.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and financial modelling.

The skills for success
  
  

* Financial Analysis & Reporting
* Strategic Planning
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Data Visualization Skills
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

Seeking a highly analytical finance professional to drive FP&A, business performance and strategic financial analytics. The role will own financial planning, profitability analysis, management MIS, forecasting and performance evaluation, while providing insights through peer benchmarking, financial ratio analysis and capital-markets / IPO-related analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* FP&A & Financial Planning – Own the Company’s financial model, annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, long-range planning and scenario analysis.
* Profitability Analysis – Conduct detailed profitability analysis at product, branch, geography and business-unit levels; identify opportunities for pricing, cost optimisation and revenue enhancement.
* Performance Management – Track actual performance against budget, prior period and business plan; analyse key drivers and recommend corrective actions.
* **Business & Financial Analytics – Analyse P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow performance and interpret key lending/NBFC ratios including NIM, yield, spread, ROA, ROE, cost-to-income, leverage, capital adequacy, liquidity and asset-quality metrics.**
* **Peer Benchmarking – Benchmark business, financial and operating metrics against relevant NBFC/HFC peers; identify performance gaps, trends and best practices.**
* Management MIS & Decision Support – Develop concise management dashboards and performance packs, with clear commentary on business drivers, risks and opportunities.
* Capital Markets / IPO Exposure – Support IPO readiness and capital-market initiatives through financial and operating metric analysis, peer benchmarking, valuation-related analysis, investor presentations and management/investor information requirements.
* Strategic Analytics – Evaluate product economics, pricing, branch expansion, cost structures, capital allocation and other strategic business decisions.
* ALM & Balance Sheet Analytics – Support forecasting of funding, liquidity, AUM, disbursements and Dynamic ALM, and assess their impact on profitability and capital.
* Cost Control & Efficiency – Monitor operating costs against budgets, identify efficiency opportunities and support business teams in delivering financial targets.
* **BI & Automation – Leverage Excel, BI and data-analysis tools to automate recurring MIS, improve reporting quality and enable drill-down analysis.**

**Educational Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field.
* CA / CFA / CMA / MBA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* **4–8 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, financial planning, financial analysis or related roles, preferably in NBFC / HFC / banking / financial services.**
* **Strong experience in financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis and management reporting.**
* Exposure to peer benchmarking, financial ratio analysis and interpretation of lending / financial-services metrics.
* Exposure to IPO, capital markets, investor reporting or transaction-related financial analysis will be an advantage.
* **Familiarity with NBFC regulations, lending products, ALM and industry-specific financial metrics preferred.**

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and financial modelling skills with advanced Excel proficiency.
* Ability to interpret financial statements, business metrics and key financial ratios and translate them into actionable insights.
* **Strong understanding of NBFC / lending business economics and profitability drivers.**
* Ability to benchmark peers and understand business performance in the context of industry trends.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to senior management.
* **Working knowledge of BI / data visualisation tools and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or equivalent.**

Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust & Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.
  
  
As an Engineering Analyst on the YouTube Trust and Safety team, you will be directly responsible for ensuring that we effectively identify and remove disruptive content and users as quickly as possible, in an environment where hundreds of hours of new content is uploaded every minute, globally. You will be passionate about technologies and have experience with analyzing large scale data and scaled systems of review. You will thrive in a fast, dynamic, demanding environment where no two days are ever the same. You will be a key contributor to the strategy for reducing network badness on YouTube. You will be an independent, critical thinker with sound metrics judgment who has a passion for coaching others, solving technological tests and setting scalable standards. You will balance the short-term requirements we face while demonstrating the ability to see the big picture and make quantitatively based long-term recommendations accordingly. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

* Perform fraud and spam investigations using various data sources, identify product vulnerabilities and drive anti-abuse experiments to prevent abuse. **Position Summary**
**Specialist – Center for Energy & Industrials – Research & Insights - Industrial Products & Construction (IP&C)**
**Overview of the team and job profile:**
Deloitte’s ER&I research center is one of the industry research groups within the Research & Insights (R&I) organization. The Center's goals are to:
  
  

* Assess opportunities and challenges facing companies in the Industrial Products & Construction (IP&C) sector, including aerospace, & defense, industrial products manufacturing, and engineering & construction.
* Provide practical insights - whether they are strategic, technical, operational.
* Bring together a range of stakeholders to address issues impacting the performance, resilience, and evolution of the IP&C sector.
* Draw on leading practices from industry professionals across disciplines such as strategy, operations, supply chain, advanced manufacturing, sustainability, digital transformation, risk, finance, regulation, and human capital to identify innovative approaches to critical challenges.

Learn more about the ER&I research center and peek into Deloitte Insights for examples of the end-products of our work.
  
  
The candidate will contribute to the center’s research and thought leadership initiatives in the IP&C sector, with a particular focus on topics such as digital transformation, workforce, supply chain resilience, sustainability, industrial technology, aerospace & defense modernization, capital projects, data center construction, and other evolving industry issues. These include white papers, in-depth research reports, client presentations, account-specific collaterals, case studies, articles, and industry outlooks. These deliverables integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources such as Deloitte subject matter experts, primary surveys, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentary, and news articles.

* Work with the US and India-based ER&I team to work on projects that align with the research agenda.
* Conduct research, focusing on primary and secondary data, data analysis, and insight development for IP&C sector (manufacturing, engineering & construction, and aerospace & defense) research projects.
* Work with project leads to support projects in the IP&C industry across all key phases.

**Responsibilities include:**
ü Data analysis: Create data analysis plans, perform deep dives and cross-tabs, validate hypotheses, extract insights, and synthesize findings into client-ready briefing decks.
  
  
ü Insight development: Work with stakeholders and research leads to identify storylines and insights; visualize survey results using data tables and charts for use in XL, PPT, Tableau, or Power BI outputs.
  
  
ü Presentation support: Present results and summarize insights and recommendations in client-ready decks to support senior colleagues and leaders in internal and external meetings.
  
  
ü Research support: Support research proposals and projects being developed by IP&C project leads.
  
  
ü Whitespace research: Work with IP&C project leads and industry SMEs to conduct whitespace research.
  
  
ü Stakeholder management: Work with project leads to understand, refine, and manage client expectations and priorities.

* Solid analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Measurement & Insights
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement Measurement & Intelligence**

* Develop measurement frameworks to assess effectiveness of omnichannel engagement across field, CRM, paid media, owned digital, and third-party channels.
* Analyze customer interaction data to identify patterns in engagement, channel synergy, sequencing, pacing, and message performance.
* Translate analytical insights into clear recommendations on channel mix, content sequencing, and engagement frequency.
* Identify engagement best practices and build playbooks that inform future campaign planning across brands.

**Experimentation & Optimization**

* Design and execute test-and-learn strategies including A/B tests, lift studies, and incrementality experiments across customer engagement tactics.
* Define success metrics, measurement windows, and statistical approaches to evaluate new engagement strategies.
* Partner with marketing, CRM, and field teams to embed analytical learnings into ongoing campaign execution.
* Continuously refine experimentation frameworks to accelerate learning cycles and improve engagement effectiveness.

**Advanced Analytics & Attribution**

* Apply advanced analytics techniques to measure the incremental impact of customer engagement activities.
* Utilize attribution frameworks such as multi-touch attribution, Markov chain modeling, and causal inference methods.
* Integrate outputs from MMx, KDA, and predictive models to inform engagement optimization strategies.
* Leverage machine learning techniques to identify high-value customer segments, channel saturation signals, and content effectiveness patterns.

**Capability Building & Technical Mentorship**

* Mentor junior analysts on advanced measurement methodologies, causal inference, and analytical best practices.
* Conduct code reviews and promote high standards for analytical rigor and reproducibility.
* Contribute to development of reusable analytics frameworks and measurement templates that scale across brands.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in customer engagement and omnichannel measurement frameworks.
* Deep understanding of HCP and patient engagement journeys across digital, field, and media channels.
* Strong analytical background in attribution modeling, causal inference, and incrementality measurement.
* Hands-on programming expertise in Python or R for analytics and data transformation.
* Experience translating analytical outputs into clear business insights and optimization recommendations.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills in cross-functional commercial environments.
* Ability to mentor technical team members and elevate analytical capabilities across the organization.

**Required**
**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in data science, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics or data science, with a strong focus on omnichannel engagement measurement across CRM, paid media, field, owned digital, and third-party ecosystems.
* Deep understanding of HCP and patient omnichannel journeys, including the ability to assess promotion sequencing, pacing, channel synergy, interaction effects, and message level performance.
* Strong expertise in attribution and impact measurement, including Markov chain, multi touch attribution, media mix modeling, and causal inference methods (e.g., propensity scoring, matched control, synthetic control).
* Experience with test and learn frameworks for omnichannel tactics and translating findings into actionable insights.
* Proven ability to translate analytical findings into business actions, partnering with media, CRM, and activation teams to drive measurable outcomes.
* Proficiency with Python or R for analytical modeling and data transformation.
* Experience with cloud-based analytics environments (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent).

**Preferred**

* Experience applying machine learning techniques, including embedding based clustering, identifying high value channel and journey patterns, content effectiveness, message fatigue, and under or over saturated channels.
* Practical experience leveraging large language models (LLMs) as an insight and enablement layer on top of core analytics, including prompt design for classification, summarization, explanation of analytical results, and insight generation.
* Ability to validate AI generated insights with analytical rigor and business logic, ensuring explainability, trust, and compliance.
* Proficiency in SQL and machine learning modeling in Python (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit learn, statsmodels, causal libraries).

title: Technical Specialist- ML Data
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
  
  
As a Technical Specialist, you will serve as the HYD based operational backbone of the Labeling Policy Program. You will play a key role in accelerating Behavior ML velocity by translating complex machine learning data requirements into consistent, high-quality, and scaleable labeling policies. You will drive rapid policy iteration, create critical golden datasets to enable fast labeling queue setup. This is an execution-focused role for a technical, detail-oriented specialist who thrives on driving clarity, alignment, and operational excellence in labeling workflows.
  
  
**You Will**

* Translate requirements to policies: Collaborate ML model owners / engineers to understand their specific data goals, translate their ambiguous machine learning requirements into precise labeling instructions, and publish clear, actionable labeling policies (with support from the US based counterparts and vendor partners).
* Drive queue readiness & golden datasets: Speed up the initial labeling queue setup process by executing rapid policy iterations and hand-crafting golden datasets (small-scale baseline datasets) to establish quality baselines before launching full-scale operations.
* Direct vendor teams: Provide technical guidance and operational direction to vendor labeling experts to enable rapid policy setup and ensure that the active labeling queues under your purview run smoothly and meet safety and performance objectives.
* Address edge cases & regional nuances: Provide critical, detailed inputs on long-tail edge cases and coordinate with regional country specialists to ensure country-specific driving rules and local nuances are accurately captured and validated, ahead of Waymo's deployment in these new countries.
* Enable quality and process improvements: Monitor labeling pipelines, conduct targeted technical analyses to identify data quality trends, and build/maintain automated data analysis tools to proactively identify improvements in the broader labeling workflow.
* Facilitate cross-functional knowledge sharing: Act as the primary technical interface between requesters and operations, ensuring on-ground dissipation of policies, managing policy amendments, and resolving complex escalations from requestors or vendor teams.

**You Have**

* 6+ years of experience in data analysis, operations, or program management with a focus on machine learning data annotation, taxonomy design, or human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Operational project management: Demonstrated ability to work independently on operational workflows and successfully project manage small sub-working groups or vendor squads.
* Core ML data lifecycle understanding: Practical knowledge of dataset curation, labeling pipelines, data quality control metrics, and baseline model evaluation concepts.
* Analytical aptitude: Experience conducting technical data analyses using pre-established tools (or building simple automation scripts) to diagnose pipeline issues, track vendor quality, and generate actionable insights.
* Adaptable & detail-oriented: Comfort working within a dynamic environment, translating vague technical needs into clear documentation, and maintaining a high standard of attention to detail.

**We Prefer**

* Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, SQL) or basic automation techniques to parse high volumes of critical data.
* Demonstrated ability to extract, manipulate, and apply machine learning techniques to high volumes of critical, product-related data.
* Demonstrated ability in working with a variety of engineering stakeholders to gather requirements, explain models, and iterate to make improvements.
* Prior experience working across multiple geographic locations and managing vendor-hosted operations.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.
