In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of clinical trial data and real-world data (RWD) systems, translating business needs into system requirements, oversee initiatives with full autonomy and lead analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions to ensure efficient acquisition and management of clinical trial data.
  
  
**Description Of The Area**
This team is responsible for delivering software systems for the data acquisition and processing of Roche clinical trial data, serving as the source of truth across Roche Pharma. Foundational systems in this area include Roche’s electronic data capture (EDC) - Medidata Rave, non-CRF systems, and clinical data warehouses.
  
  
These systems are critical to drug development, powering clinical data review, safety reporting, operational insights for clinical teams, and support early development activities in the REDs. They provide data to the Analytical Data Science’s ecosystems to standardize and analyze data for regulatory submissions. In addition, standardized clinical data from these systems are essential to integrate with Roche’s specialized data modality platforms including omics, clinical imaging, and digital health technologies.
  
  
A key focus in this area will be to leverage emerging AI technologies to optimize clinical data acquisition and data management. This includes enriching metadata and building AI-ready datasets to enable autonomous agentic and human-in-the loop AI systems which are transforming the drug development process.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Business Analysis Leadership & Delivery: Lead business analysis for initiatives or workstreams with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale. Defines and leads analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, translating complex data requirements into process maps, epics, features, and users stories
* Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, defining the problem space and driving comprehensive root cause analysis that may span organizational boundaries. Proactively prevents scope creep, manages the complexity of various scopes of change, and is ultimately accountable for business analysis deliverables ensuring alignment across functions and dependent systems
* Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across both IT and business organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management
* Impact & Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects and programs by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps
* Complexity: Works typically on multiple systems across the sub-function, effectively managing highly ambiguous and evolving requirements. Demonstrates an end-to-end viewpoint to analyze problems, considering how data flows across systems
* Business Domain & Technical Expertise: Uses in-depth knowledge of clinical data business processes and technical expertise in data integration and engineering to inform business strategies

**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience**

* Experience: 7+ years as a Business Analyst/Consultant, with at least 4 years in the Life Sciences or Pharma Industry
* Experience with Clinical Data Systems, Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems or Non-CRF data systems, clinical data warehouses or data lakes
* Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices
* Strong communication skills to manage stakeholders and facilitate discussions between business and IT users globally
* Familiar with Agile product delivery, backlog management, and delivering GxP validated systems

**Technical Skills**

* Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice
* Mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, with the ability to conduct comprehensive root cause analysis and advanced value and risk assessments
* Experience with databases, SQL, scripting languages such as python, APIs, and data analytics tools
* Strong willingness to learn and develop practical experience in AI agentic workflows

**Additional Qualifications**

* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, acting as a role model in teamwork and driving good collaboration across Informatics and business structures
* Flexibility: Ability to adapt to shifting priorities and commit to collaboration with team members globally

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The
**Service Improvement Analyst – Digital Workplace Services**
is responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and driving service improvement opportunities across the Digital Workplace Services portfolio. This role focuses on enhancing the end-user experience, improving service performance, optimizing operational processes, and increasing adoption of modern workplace technologies.
  
  
Leveraging
**ITIL, Lean Six Sigma (LSS), Continual Service Improvement (CSI), and Digital Employee Experience (DEX)**
principles, the analyst partners with service owners, engineering teams, operations teams, vendors, and clients to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and measure outcomes. The role requires a strong combination of analytical skills, customer focus, business acumen, and technical understanding of modern workplace services such as Microsoft 365, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, service desk operations, and end-user computing services.
  
  
The Service Improvement Analyst will lead improvement initiatives across multiple clients and business functions while ensuring service delivery aligns with business objectives, user expectations, and operational excellence standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Improvement & Digital Workplace Optimization
  
  

* Lead the development and execution of service improvement initiatives across Digital Workplace Services in partnership with Service Excellence Leads, Service Owners, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Analyze service performance, user experience data, operational metrics, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive continual improvement programs focused on enhancing employee productivity, service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Establish improvement roadmaps aligned with Digital Workplace Services strategy and business objectives.
* Support the adoption and optimization of workplace technologies including Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, endpoint services, mobility solutions, and digital employee experience tools.
* Utilize Digital Employee Experience (DEX) insights, service analytics, and user sentiment data to prioritize and implement service improvements.

Process Excellence & Operational Effectiveness
  
  

* Develop a thorough understanding of existing Digital Workplace processes, workflows, and service delivery models to identify optimization opportunities.
* Create and maintain operational process documentation including: Process maps and flowcharts Standard operating procedures (SOPs) Capacity and utilization studies Time and motion studies Standard work documentation Cycle-time and workflow analysis
* Lead process redesign initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, standardization, and service quality.
* Coordinate and track improvement activities resulting from Kaizen workshops, problem-solving sessions, and operational reviews.
* Implement Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, and Continuous Improvement methodologies to drive measurable outcomes.

Analytics, Reporting & Insights
  
  

* Define, monitor, and report on key Digital Workplace Services KPIs and SLAs, including: Service Desk performance End-user experience metrics Incident and request trends Availability and reliability metrics Adoption and utilization metrics Customer satisfaction (CSAT) Employee experience measures
* Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Conduct root cause analysis and trend analysis to proactively address recurring service issues.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making to recommend service enhancements and operational improvements.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-functional service improvement initiatives involving Operations, Engineering, Service Management, Product Teams, Vendors, and Client stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and point of contact for service improvement programs and transformation efforts.
* Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and continuous improvement sessions with business and technical teams.
* Deliver Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, Continual Improvement, and service management training and awareness sessions.
* Mentor Yellow and Green Belt practitioners and support the organization's continuous improvement culture.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize and implement approved improvements that increase service value, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

Governance & Best Practices
  
  

* Promote and enforce ITIL and continual improvement best practices across Digital Workplace Services.
* Support service governance activities, operational reviews, and improvement boards.
* Ensure improvement initiatives are measured, documented, and sustained through appropriate governance and change management practices.
* Drive the identification, adoption, and continuous improvement of scalable end-to-end service delivery processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Service Improvement, Process Improvement, Business Analysis, Service Management, or a related role.
* 2+ years of experience applying Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence methodologies.
* Experience supporting or improving Digital Workplace Services environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven track record of identifying improvement opportunities and delivering measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience documenting and optimizing business and operational processes.
* Experience working cross-functionally within complex organizational environments.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with global and remote teams.
* Excellent reporting, dashboard creation, and performance measurement experience.
* Strong verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Teams, and Visio.
* Strong understanding of service management principles, KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher-level ITIL certification.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms such as Nexthink, Lakeside, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Endpoint Management, Intune, Windows Services, Collaboration Platforms, and Modern Workplace technologies.
* Experience with Power BI, ServiceNow, and service analytics platforms.

title: IT ERP Product Analyst III
description:

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Position Summary**
The IT ERP Product Analyst III is responsible to design and deliver solutions to fulfill requirements of Regal’s supply chain business. The individual should possess comprehensive techno-functional competencies in Supply Chain (INV, BOM, WIP, Costing, and PO) modules of Oracle EBS and working knowledge of Advanced Supply Chain Planning (ASCP), Demantra and Inventory Optimization (IO) modules of Oracle VCP. The person is responsible to deliver on-time and first-time-right for complex projects and kaizen events, to resolve production incidents within SLAs, to conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence or problems, to monitor and improve system performance and reliability on continuous basis and to coach team members as necessary. Gathers and analyzes requirements, designs, develops and tests enhancements, extensions and integrations (RICEW / CEMLI) for existing Oracle EBS Supply Chain / VCP modules. Maintains technical documentation (BR100s, MD50s/70s, CV40s/70s, etc). Assists in defining, reviewing and maintaining standards. Liaises and coordinates with business and IT stakeholders including offshore team members. Participates in formulating and defining scope of Oracle EBS / VCP projects and own delivery of several components.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Gather and analyze business requirements; design, develop, test and implement technical solutions to fulfill requirements of supply chain, manufacturing, and planning areas; and provide post implementation maintenance and support
* Document system specifications (SSDs - high level) (MD50s), detailed design (DDDs) (MD70s), Unit Test Plan, Deployment Notes (MD120s), etc. using Oracle AIM (Application Implementation Methodology).
* Support System Functional testing, End-To-End Integration testing, Regression testing, and User Acceptance testing within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate among onsite and offshore members of Oracle EBS Supply Chain / VCP technical developers to design, build, unit test and support solutions that are on-time, first-time-right and within budget.
* Ensure compliance to Release management, Change management and configuration management processes.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, and Extensions (including workflows) to enhance existing Oracle EBS / VCP solutions and integrate it with other applications.
* Respond, analyze and resolve production incidents within SLAs, perform routine maintenance tasks, and monitor / enhance performance of scheduled programs to ensure business continuity.
* Automate and maintain Integration of Oracle EBS / VCP modules with other internal and external systems.
* Participate in following activities:
* Analyze and plan Oracle EBS / VCP upgrades (i.e. Family Packs)
* Create and resolve service requests in collaboration with ‘My Oracle Support’
* Provide production support as per Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Continuously improve system performance and reliability by identifying opportunities for root cause analysis and automation
* Facilitate in establishing standards and Best Practices for software design, development and Unit Test and lead team to leverage these standards and best practices to deliver high quality and cost effective solutions.
* Use systematic techniques and process modeling tools for effective system specifications and design - like Use-case scenarios, Activity Diagrams, Data-flow Diagramming etc.

**Required Education / Experience / Skills**

* Educations:
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent related experience
* Experience
* 10+ years of experience building and supporting solutions based on Oracle EBS Supply Chain / VCP R12 (Advanced Supply Chain Planning, Demantra, and Inventory Optimization) in global environment – with at least 2or 3 full lifecycle implementations or 3+ years of monitoring, maintaining, enhancing, integrating and upgrading
* Awareness or Green Belt certification in Lean Six Sigma or APICS (CPIM, CIRM) certification preferred
* Technical Skills:
* Highly skilled in Oracle E-Business Suite's APIs, Open Interfaces structure, EBS / VCP data models, building RICEW (Report, Interface, Conversion, Extension, Workflow) or CEMLI (Configuration, Extension, Modification, Localization, and Integration) objects, Forms, Form Personalization, XML Publisher, OA Framework, SQL, PL/SQL (Stored procedures, packages and triggers), Bulk processing, ETL operations, REF cursors, collections, etc.
* Comprehensive knowledge in collection methods, plan parameters, Demantra and Inventory Optimization architecture
* Ability to analyze and resolve supply-demand exceptions and issues as per SLAs
* Experience with SQL\*Plus, SQL\*Loader, Data Loader, Export/Import, TKPROF, Oracle scheduler, Advanced Queues, Object management
* Proficient in tools like TOAD, PL/SQL Developer, Data Modeling tools, Version Control tools.
* UNIX shell scripting experience (desired)
* Conversant with Oracle AIM (Application Implementation Methodology)
* Professional Certification(s) like Supply Chain industry or Oracle E-Business Suite R12 (strongly desired)
* Working experience in Oracle EBS R12 Supply Chain (Discrete Manufacturing) modules (strong desired)

**Travel:**
25% of time – mostly during project milestones, kaizen or similar events
  
  
**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
  
  
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
  
  
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

Reporting to the Global Supply Planning Lead, this role is responsible for delivering integrated business intelligence, performance reporting, digital solutions, and advanced analytics that enable business execution and data-driven decision making across the end-to-end supply chain.
  
  
The Manager works collaboratively across Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, and Site Supply Chain organizations to connect operational, planning, and financial insights into a cohesive view of business performance.
  
  
Leading a team of Business Performance & Analytics Analysts, the Manager ensures the delivery of standardized, accurate, and timely analytics, enterprise dashboards, KPI scorecards, and executive reporting that provide consistent visibility across the Global Planning Network. Through strong cross-functional partnerships, the role promotes alignment across planning and site supply chain functions, enabling informed decision-making, proactive performance management, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The Manager also develops team capability, fosters collaboration across global and site organizations, and drives process standardization, automation, and adoption of modern analytics solutions that improve business performance and operational effectiveness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Collaboration & Business Integration**

* Serve as the primary integrator of business performance at AIN across the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organizations, ensuring a unified view of end-to-end supply chain performance.
* Foster strong partnerships across Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Digital Technology, and Site Supply Chain teams to align performance measures, priorities, and business objectives.
* Establish common KPI definitions, reporting standards, and governance processes that create consistency and transparency across global planning and site operations.
* Connect operational, planning, and financial insights into a cohesive business performance narrative that enables informed executive decision-making.
* Facilitate cross-functional performance reviews that encourage collaboration, identify interdependencies, resolve performance gaps, and drive aligned improvement initiatives across the global network.
* Promote a "One Supply Chain" mindset by ensuring analytics and performance reporting support enterprise outcomes rather than functional optimization.

**Business Performance & Analytics**

* Lead the Business Performance & Analytics team supporting the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organizations.
* Define the analytics strategy, operating model, priorities, and roadmap aligned with Global Planning objectives.
* Establish governance for GSC Planning KPI reporting, performance management, and business analytics.
* Ensure timely delivery of recurring and ad hoc reporting.
* Collaborate with Global Planning on translating business strategy into meaningful performance metrics and executive dashboards.
* Present business insights and recommendations to Planning and Site Supply Chain leadership to support strategic decision-making.

**Planning Network Analytics**

* Provide strategic analytics leadership across Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning and Integrated Business Planning processes.
* Partner with planning leaders to identify trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities that improve planning performance and supply reliability.

**Site Supply Chain Analytics**

* Lead analytics supporting manufacturing and site supply chain operations.
* Ensure consistent reporting and performance visibility across manufacturing sites while driving standardization of metrics and reporting processes.

**Digital Analytics & Business Intelligence**
Lead the design and continuous improvement of enterprise analytics capabilities including:
  
  

* Executive dashboards
* KPI scorecards
* Self-service reporting
* Data visualization
* Predictive analytics
* AI-enabled decision support

Collaborate with AIN GSC Digital team in the development and support of reporting platforms including Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, and other enterprise analytics tools.
  
  
Partner with Digital Technology and SAP teams to prioritize enhancements, improve reporting architecture, and increase automation across supply chain processes.
  
  
**Financial Performance & Value Delivery**

* Partner with Finance to improve visibility of supply chain financial performance including:
* Budget tracking
* Cost center performance
* Logistics costs
* Inventory carrying costs
* Scrap performance
* Forecast accuracy
* Operational cost drivers

Develop analytics that enable proactive financial decision-making and quantify business value delivered through supply chain improvements.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Digital Transformation**
Lead initiatives that simplify processes, automate reporting, improve data quality, and standardize analytics across the organization.
  
  
Champion:
  
  

* Automation
* AI-enabled analytics
* Predictive modelling
* Data governance
* Process standardization
* Digital transformation

Drive continuous improvement projects that improve operational efficiency, reporting effectiveness, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead and develop the Business Performance & Analytics Analyst team.
* Prioritize and allocate work across the team to meet business commitments.
* Build collaborative relationships with planning and site supply chain leaders.
* Ensure consistent KPI definitions, reporting standards, and data quality across supported functions.
* Facilitate cross-functional performance reviews and support governance forums.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, and analytics capability within the team.
* Coach and develop team members while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture.

**Basic Qualifications**
8-13 years of experience in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or related business functions
  
  
OR
  
  
Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience consistent with Amgen qualification requirements.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading or supervising business analytics, business intelligence, supply chain, planning, or operations teams in a complex global organization.
* Strong knowledge of end-to-end supply chain planning processes, including Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning, Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, and Site Supply Chain operations.

* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and master data management principles.

title: Analyst Project Analytics - Finance
description:
**About Signant Health**

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

**About The Role**

To provide financial support to the project management functions within Operations. Assist with reviewing overall performance, including scope, revenue, cost and other related matters. Act as a liaison between Operations and Finance to ensure accurate and timely reporting of all activity and to proactively identify potential issues and action plans.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Monitor financial performance metrics including profitability, change orders, and delivery timelines for revenue recognition.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, variances between actual and budgeted results, and opportunities for improvement.
* Review projects regularly to assess historical and future trends in revenue, costs, and expenses, developing actionable recommendations.
* Support the Finance team in accurate monthly revenue recognition and financial statement preparation.
* Partner with delivery teams to establish effective feedback loops between operations, accounting, and FP&A.
* Collaborate across departments to gather information for accurate financial projections and reporting.
* Participate in developing and implementing project finance policies and procedures.
* Communicate project’s financial information effectively to various stakeholders.
* Identify and recommend process improvements to enhance financial tracking and reporting efficiency.
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail in all financial activities.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**

**Essential:**

* A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field is typically required.
* 5-6 years of relevant experience and specifically in financial planning, budgeting, and analysis is highly desirable.
* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a global environment and support teams geographically dispersed across US, Europe and Asia.
* Advanced Excel and other business intelligence tools knowledge.
* Familiarity with concepts, practices, and procedures of financial planning & analysis.
* Understanding business operations, financial statements, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Ability to collect, analyze, and interpret financial data to identify trends and insights.

**Preferred:**

* Qualified (CIMA, ACCA, ACA, CPA, CMA or equivalent).
* Previous systems experience with Salesforce, NetSuite and / or data analytics software (e.g. OneStream), and using BI tools (Power BI, Tableau etc.).

**Why Signant Health?**

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

What we offer

title: Associate Director - Brand Strategy Analytics Oncology
description:
****Job Description****
**Associate Director — Brand Strategy Analytics, Oncology, Digital Human Health**
****Job Description****
This role sits within the Brand Strategy vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH) - the patient-centric capability that owns the analytics arc from patient journey through brand performance for the Oncology portfolio across both inline and pipeline assets. The team operates as an embedded partner to the commercial organization, providing strategic thought partnership to marketing and cross-functional stakeholders. It shapes demand by translating business priorities into actionable analytics needs, quarterbacks delivery across DHH capabilities, and drives activation of products and insights to enable decision-making and business impact.
  
  
The Associate Director will be responsible for developing and delivering strategic data insights and analytics that address Oncology BU teams' key business questions and inform launch-related and inline commercial decisions across the Oncology portfolio (covering Women's Cancer, Hematology, Lung, GU, GI, and the Oncology precision medicine and Early Assets are few). The team member will partner closely with Global and Regional market teams, , Sales, Enterprise Strategy, Clinical Development, and BD to inform executive decision-making and increase commercial rigor through every phase of asset development, launch and inline.
  
  
The Associate Director will work alongside other DHH capability functions - Market Research, Forecasting, Data Science, Data Strategy & Solutions, Payer Insights & Analytics, Data Visualisation, Commercial AI, IT - to proactively orchestrate the planning and delivery of complex insights and analytics assessments.
  
  
The role partners closely with BU engagement leads to proactively shape and inform portfolio-level brand strategy, while advancing capabilities through systematization, automation, and AI. The AD is accountable for positioning the India Hub as a strategic analytics partner, embedding productivity, scalability, and value-driven outcomes across engagements.
  
  
****Role Overview****
The Associate Director will lead a team of Senior Managers, Managers, Associate Managers covering Oncology TA / asset and capability domains (Brand Performance Synthesis, Secondary Analytics, Patient Insights, Analytics Tool Activation). The candidate must be able to lead direct teams and orchestrate cross-functional insights pods spanning DHH and the broader Human Health organisation. The individual will demonstrate consistently strong leadership, the ability to work objectively in ambiguity, strong partnership skills, a culture of continuous learning.
  
  
The preferred candidate will have an entrepreneurial spirit, a consultative and strategic mindset, strong Oncology TAs, fluency in technology (AI, GenAI, Agentic), and a demonstrated record of producing actionable insights from analytics. The individual should have a strong understanding of the US and exUS Oncology data landscape - claims, EMR, real-world data, biomarker data, Rx, market research data, and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into advanced, scalable analytical solutions.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Oncology portfolio analytics - inline & pipeline Lead the development and synthesis of commercial data and insight solutions, portfolio analytics, business cases, performance measurements and market evaluations to support decision-making for the Global and US Oncology teams.
* Brand strategy translation to analytics plan Translate business needs and priorities into analytical plans that answer brand-team and BD questions with actionable insights. Effectively communicate advanced analytics to commercial stakeholders to inform decisions across the value chain - pipeline prioritization, product performance, launch readiness.
* Team leadership and cross-functional orchestration Lead and mentor 15+ team members, providing guidance on best practices in data analytics, modeling and data visualization. Manage team workload proactively and ensure optimal resource utilization. Lead cross-functional insights pods in addition to direct teams.
* Stakeholder collaboration Drive proactive, transparent engagement with BU leads, cross-functional partners to co-create solutions, align on organizational priorities, and set clear expectations. Provide internal and business stakeholders with forward-looking visibility into key programs to inform milestones, prioritization, risk mitigation, and aligned decision-making.
* Prioritization and value tracking Understand the full book of work underway and planned for each disease area or business unit. Work with BU leads to prioritise against team’s capacity. For prioritised work, engage cross-functional teams to articulate the value and impact of each piece.
* Patient journey and RWD analytics Build and oversee patient journey analytics, patient-flow modeling, simulation-based modeling, and other patient-modeling techniques on commercial and real-world datasets.
* Precision medicine and biomarker analytics Embed analytics support for precision medicine and companion-diagnostic priorities across the Oncology pipeline and inline portfolio, partnering with Precision Medicine Marketing, Outcomes Research and Medical Affairs.
* Communication and transparency Drive proactive, transparent engagement with cross-functional partners to co-create solutions, align on organizational priorities, and set clear expectations. Provide internal and business stakeholders with forward-looking visibility into key programs to inform milestones, prioritization, risk mitigation, and aligned decision-making.
* Leverage advanced statistical methods and ML/AI modeling with strong validation practices; deliver regression and time-series models, Predictive modelling (propensity, patient finding, churn) to generate actionable insights.
* Innovation and GenAI experimentation Contribute to and lead innovation experiments - idea generation, activation of reusable use cases -including responsible application of GenAI and agentic AI to enhance Oncology analytic capability. Identify tangible, measurable criteria to make meaningful improvements to business processes and strategies.
* Articulate the "so what" Derive actionable business insights from disparate data sources, develop a clear data story, and communicate it effectively to stakeholders.

****Education Requirements****
Masters (or equivalent) in Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, Decision Science, Marketing, Engineering, Management or an equivalent commercial discipline. Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PharmD, PhD) is preferred.
  
  
****Required Experience And Skills****

* 8+ years in pharma/biotech across commercial analytics, strategy with deep Oncology therapies commercialization experience, and delivery of complex analytical initiatives.
* 4+ years leading high-performing teams; proven ability to coach talent, build inclusive culture, and lead cross-functional pods in a matrixed setup.
* Strong consultative mindset with demonstrated ability to translate brand and commercial strategies into actionable analytics and insight plans.
* Executive presence with ability to influence senior leaders, align US & Global stakeholders, and communicate clear, data-driven narratives.
* Extensive experience working with real-world datasets (claims, Rx, CRM, promotional and sales data), leveraging SQL, Python, and AI-driven tools; familiarity with modern data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS/GCP
* Experience driving AI/GenAI and automation adoption, with strong understanding of experimentation, scalability, and responsible use in a regulated environment.
* Self-motivated, proactive mindset, and ability to work independently.

**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**
****Required Skills****
Brand Strategy, Business Analysis, Business Processes, Clinical Development, Commercial Analytics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Decision-Making Strategies, Demand Management, Digital Healthcare, Hematology, Innovation, Market Research, Outcomes Research, Predictive Modeling, Requirements Management, Sourcing and Procurement, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Planning, Team Leadership

title: Manager - Digital Marketing Analytics
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Manager - Digital Marketing Analytics**
**Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad or Chennai**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai to drive analytics & technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The
**Manager - Digital Marketing Analytics**
will lead and provide strategic direction to a team of analytics professionals, serving as a thought partner to stakeholders across Roche affiliates and global teams. This role goes beyond managing workstreams and reviewing dashboards. It requires someone who can bring a perspective shaped by deep experience in digital marketing and the technologies that power it. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative partner who can articulate the value of our analytics capabilities and build strong relationships with new and existing partners across the Roche network.
  
  
All Roche employees are expected to actively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and adhere to all applicable laws, regulations, policies, and procedures governing our business.

* Translate complex analytics concepts into business language that resonates with non-technical stakeholders and leadership

* Build a culture of intellectual curiosity, encouraging the team to move beyond reporting and into insight generation, experimentation, and strategic recommendation
* Partner with business partners to define key metrics and outcomes for technology aligned with business objectives
* Develop capability presentations and case studies that demonstrate the impact of our work to strengthen partnerships across the network
* Lead important initiatives for the growth and development of the GATE team

* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, Business, or related disciplines) and 8 to 12 years of experience in digital marketing analytics, martech, or consulting, with progressive leadership responsibility
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing technology and analytics, with exposure to life sciences or healthcare being a strong advantage
* Demonstrated expertise with Adobe Analytics and/or Adobe CJA; familiarity with the broader Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem
* Proficient in attribution modeling, website performance optimization, A/B testing, conversion management, traffic analysis, and various reporting tools
* Familiarity with digital marketing channels, including SEO, SEM, social media, and email marketing
* Proficiency in tools such as Omnibug, Adobe Cloud Debugger, Adobe Launch, and Google Tag Manager
* Experience managing or leading analytics teams (3+ direct reports or equivalent)
* Proven ability to engage with senior stakeholders, present insights persuasively, and influence decisions. A track record of being a trusted advisor, not just a report generator
* Comfortable leading collaborative conversations and building partnerships with new teams and stakeholders
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance considerations relevant to pharmaceutical/life sciences digital marketing
* Demonstrated coaching and mentoring skills, providing timely and actionable feedback to the team
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Effective team player with the ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple analytics projects concurrently

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Senior Manager, Analytics Products and Technology - Obesity
description:
Senior Manager, Analytics Products & Technology
  
  
**Obesity Intelligence & Analytics | Amgen India**
**Reports to:**
Director, Technology, Operations & Data Enablement
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
This is an India-based global role supporting Amgen's global obesity business. The Senior Manager, Analytics Products & Technology will own the development and evolution of business-facing products that enable leaders to move from insight to action with clarity and speed.
  
  
It is a product leadership role at its core - requiring strong judgment, technical fluency, and a deep understanding of how leaders make decisions. The focus is on creating products that simplify complexity, accelerate decisions, and meaningfully improve how the organization operates.
  
  
This leader's mandate is to build products that serve as critical enablers of how the business plans, prioritizes, and executes. This leader will shape their direction, ensure they evolve with the needs of the organization, and drive adoption in a way that makes them indispensable to everyday work.
  
  
The role also plays a key part in advancing AI-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation across the organization. As new opportunities emerge, this leader will help bring them to life in a way that is practical, scalable, and grounded in real business impact - ensuring that innovation translates into meaningful change, not experimentation for its own sake.
  
  
Success is measured by products that become part of how the business runs—trusted, widely adopted, and consistently making work faster, simpler, and more effective.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Product Strategy, Roadmap & Technology Prioritization
* Own the product roadmap for Gateway, SKU Solver, and related decision-support capabilities, ensuring each product solves a real business problem and earns a place in everyday work.
* Shape user journeys, requirements, backlogs, release plans, value measures, and success criteria that connect product work to business decisions.
* Prioritize with discipline, balancing user value, technical feasibility, adoption potential, speed, risk, and long-term maintainability.
* Bring structure to ambiguity so teams understand what is being built, why it matters, and how it will change the way the organization plans, prioritizes, or executes.
* Product Discovery, Design & User Experience
* Work closely with leaders, analytics teams, and end users to understand how decisions are made today and where products can remove friction.
* Turn complex workflows into simple product concepts, intuitive experiences, and practical solution designs that help users move from insight to action.
* Challenge requests that add complexity without value, and redirect teams toward solutions that are useful, scalable, and easy to adopt.
* Partner with design, engineering, data, analytics, and business teams to test assumptions early and refine solutions before significant build effort is committed.
* Keep the user experience central. The best product is not the one with the most features; it is the one people trust and use.
* Tool Delivery, Build Execution & Release Management
* Lead delivery of business-facing tools, product enhancements, dashboards, workflow applications, and reusable capabilities from concept through release.
* Ensure solutions are secure, reliable, supportable, documented, and aligned with enterprise technology standards before they scale.
* Manage delivery trade-offs clearly, keeping momentum without sacrificing quality, usability, maintainability, or stakeholder trust.
* Build the muscle for repeatable delivery so new products and enhancements move faster over time without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* AI-Enabled Solutions & Intelligent Automation
* Serve as the first-line product lead for practical AI-enabled tools and intelligent automation opportunities until a dedicated AI capability is established.
* Help teams frame the business problem, define the desired outcome, identify required inputs, and determine whether AI or automation is the right solution.
* Coordinate with data science, technology, privacy, security, legal, compliance, and business partners to prototype and deploy custom solutions responsibly.
* Apply appropriate guardrails for documentation, validation, human oversight, user training, responsible use, and ongoing support.
* Focus on useful AI. The goal is not experimentation for its own sake; it is work that becomes faster, simpler, higher quality, or more scalable.
* Adoption, Value Realization & Product Operations
* Own product adoption plans, usage metrics, feedback loops, training support, release communications, and value realization tracking.
* Listen to users after launch. Understand where tools create leverage, where they create friction, and where process or behavior change is needed.
* Use evidence to sharpen priorities, retire low-value features, improve existing capabilities, and scale what proves useful.
* Measure success by adoption, trust, and decision impact, not by the number of features shipped.
* Cross-Functional Leadership, Vendor Management & Capability Building
* Lead an India-based product and technology pod that can manage tools from idea through build, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Work across analytics, data enablement, commercial, medical, operations, technology, and external partners to keep product delivery connected to real business needs.
* Manage vendor and partner work with clear expectations for scope, quality, timelines, documentation, knowledge transfer, supportability, and ownership.
* Coach team members to combine product judgment, technical curiosity, business context, disciplined execution, and accountability for outcomes.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Doctorate degree and 4+ years of relevant experience; OR
* Master's degree and 8+ years of relevant experience; OR
* Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Data Science, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience owning and evolving business-facing products, analytics platforms, workflow applications, or decision-support capabilities from strategy through adoption and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated success building and scaling products that materially improved business decision-making, operational efficiency, user adoption, or organizational effectiveness.
* Experience evaluating, prototyping, or deploying AI-enabled capabilities, intelligent automation, or decision-support solutions in an enterprise environment.
* Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and business leaders to deliver complex products in a global environment.
* Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous business problems, make sound product trade-offs, and align diverse stakeholders around clear product decisions.
* Experience driving product adoption, change management, and value realization through user engagement, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product strategies, priorities, and business recommendations for senior leaders.

**Description**
**Job Description:**
**Senior Analyst, Observational Health Data Analytics, Epidemiology - Hyderabad**
Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.
  
  
Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
  
  
Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine
  
  
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a
**Senior Analyst, Observational Health Data Analytics**
(OHDA) to join our Global Epidemiology team. This role is based in Hyderabad, India and requires regular in-office presence.
  
  
As a Senior Analyst on the OHDA team, you will help generate real-world evidence from large-scale healthcare data to support important scientific and business questions across Johnson & Johnson. This is a hands-on analytics role for someone who enjoys applying epidemiologic and data science methods to observational research. The types of analysis typically performed fall into three major categories: characterization, population-level estimation, and patient-level prediction.
  
  
OHDA collaborates with the broader international research community to establish and promote best practices in the appropriate use of observational data by conducting methodological research, developing standardized analytics tools, and demonstrating successful applications to important clinical questions.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Collaborate with colleagues across OHDA and Global Epidemiology to support observational research and evidence-generation priorities.
* Support the design and delivery of observational analyses for clinical characterization, population-level effect estimation, and patient-level prediction.
* Contribute to study design documents, including protocols and analysis plans, in partnership with scientists and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Execute analyses using standardized tools and statistical programming against internal and external observational healthcare data sources.
* Help evaluate and improve methods, processes, and scientific best practices that support reliable real-world evidence generation.
* Contribute to the development of software and analytical tools that enable scalable, reproducible observational research.
* Support the evaluation and characterization of observational data for fitness-for-use in addressing clinical and epidemiologic questions.
* Provide technical and scientific support for the data and analytics environment used by epidemiologists and product teams.

**Qualifications**

* Education:

+ An MD or PhD with at least 2+ years of epidemiology programming or related research experience is required. OR
+ A Master’s degree in Epidemiology, Health Services Research, Health Outcomes Research, Biostatistics, Public Health, Informatics, Computer Science, or a related discipline with at least 4+ years of epidemiology or related research experience in healthcare is required.

* Required experience and skills:

+ At least 2 years of experience in statistical programming using R and/or database programming using SQL.
+ At least 1 year of experience programming against large healthcare datasets, such as claims or electronic health records.
+ At least 1 year of relevant experience in the healthcare industry, including pharmaceutical, payer, provider, health system, CRO, or related research settings.
+ Experience managing and analyzing administrative claims data and/or electronic health or medical record data.
+ Experience analyzing and interpreting quantitative data.
+ Experience contributing to epidemiology study documents, including protocols and study reports.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills.
+ Fluency in English.
+ Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and internationally, as needed.

* Preferred qualifications:

+ Experience supporting epidemiology or real-world evidence research.
+ Experience with OHDSI and/or the OMOP Common Data Model.
+ Knowledge of medical terminologies such as ICD, NDC, SNOMED, MedDRA, LOINC, and CPT.
+ Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as R Shiny and ggplot2.
+ Experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, diagnostics, or related healthcare research environments.
+ A track record of scientific communication, including publications, posters, presentations, or technical reports.
+ Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics or intelligent automation concepts relevant to data science and research workflows.

 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
   

  

 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
   

  

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
   

  

**Tide Facts**
* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026

* Support to build analytics roadmap for customer strategy, acquisition efficiency, customer lifetime value enhancement and budget optimization.
* Collaborate with Analytical engineering and Martech to create a holistic view of the members by ensuring seamless integration of various data sources from 3rd party platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.
* Advising and Support performance marketing stakeholders to provide an accurate view of the member attribution by various channels

title: Associate Field effectiveness
description:
At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, the Associate, Field Effectiveness will provide hands\-on analytical and operational support that helps improve the productivity and effectiveness of the sales force. The role sits at the intersection of data analytics, commercial operations, and field strategy, with a focus on accurate execution, actionable insights, and reliable field enablement.
   

  

 This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and works closely with field leadership, analytics, reporting, incentive compensation, data\-management, and cross\-system partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Field Data Analysis and Insights
   

  

* Analyze data from Veeva CRM, distribution partners, claims, patient services, and other approved commercial sources.
* Assess reach, frequency, HCP engagement, call\-plan adherence, account performance, and targeting effectiveness for field sales teams.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc analyses that translate complex datasets into clear observations and practical actions for business partners.


 Operational Execution and Field Enablement
   

  

* Support territory alignments, roster updates, targeting cycles, and call\-plan execution in accordance with agreed timelines and controls.
* Coordinate operational delivery of field tools and outputs, including Veeva CRM, Next Best Action dashboards, digital companion tools, alerts, and call\-plan refreshes.
* Respond to routine field or stakeholder questions, investigate issues, document findings, and escalate risks or dependencies promptly.


 Sales Force Size, Structure, and Deployment
   

  

* Assist with analyses of field\-force size, structure, coverage, deployment, territory design, and workload balance.
* Support evaluations of customer and account potential, targeting logic, call frequency, capacity, and affordable coverage scenarios.
* Prepare data, scenarios, and quality checks required for alignment updates driven by market dynamics and business priorities.


 Field Force Effectiveness
   

  

* Support call planning, coverage optimization, targeting, valuation, and execution audits across applicable brands and field forces.
* Conduct periodic analyses of workload balance, reach and frequency, engagement quality, and performance trends under the guidance of senior team members.
* Develop clear summaries, charts, and supporting documentation for leadership reviews and cross\-functional discussions.


 Compliance, Quality, and Process Optimization
   

  

* Execute defined quality\-control checks and ensure analytics, reports, and field outputs follow approved business rules and applicable engagement\-compliance requirements.
* Document data sources, assumptions, methodologies, process steps, and validation evidence to support audit readiness, repeatability, and knowledge transfer.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate recurring work and support implementation of approved improvements.


 Project Support and Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Track deliverables, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items using tools such as Jira and ServiceNow; maintain clear ownership and timely status updates.
* Maintain project documentation, including timelines, decision logs, issue trackers, validation files, and closure summaries.
* Collaborate effectively with Field Reporting, Incentive Compensation, iDNA/data teams, analytics, cross\-system operations, and field stakeholders to deliver agreed priorities.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 1 \- 3 years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, commercial analytics, and/or field effectiveness.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the bio/pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Hands\-on ability to write SQL queries and perform data analysis, data visualization, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Experience with sales\-planning or operations platforms used for targeting, alignment, roster management, and call planning.
* Familiarity with CRM systems such as Veeva and with commercial data such as sales, activity, claims, and customer/account data.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify data\-quality issues and explain findings clearly.
* Effective written and verbal communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way.
   

  

 In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity and Accommodation
   

  

 As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed, and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

title: E-commerce, Marketplace Growth & Listings Manager
description:
**E\-commerce, Marketplace Growth \& Listings Manager
 
 ﻿**




 📍 Hyderabad \| Full\-time
 



  





**A Note from the Founders** 




 Most marketplace roles eventually become coordination roles.
 



 Listings get uploaded, campaigns go live, sales happen — but very few people truly think about how catalogue quality, platform visibility, and operational execution directly impact long\-term revenue growth.
 



 At SkinBae, we are building this differently.
 



 We are looking for someone who naturally thinks about:
 


* how brands scale across marketplaces
* how listings influence conversion and discoverability
* how marketplace growth and operations connect together
* how systems can be built to reduce errors and improve efficiency at scale



 This role is not just about managing listings or operations. It is about building scalable marketplace growth engines across multiple Korean beauty brands.
 



 If you enjoy ownership, growth strategy, optimization, and execution, you’ll enjoy being here.
 



  





**About SkinBae** 




 SkinBae is building a curated Korean skincare platform in India. We work closely with global Korean beauty brands and focus on education\-led storytelling, strong visual identity, and long\-term brand building across D2C, marketplaces, and offline retail.
 



 As we continue scaling across marketplaces, we are looking for people who can combine growth thinking with operational excellence and execute at a high level across multiple brands and channels.

 At The Hackett Group®, we offer opportunities to learn, connect, and collaborate with professionals worldwide, helping them achieve new performance and competitive advantages. You will work closely with advisors in the Applied Intelligence practice and colleagues across the research organization.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced procurement research professional to play a pivotal role in the development of high‑impact thought leadership, benchmarking insights, and client‑facing research deliverables. This role sits within The Hackett Group’s global research team and works in close partnership with senior procurement advisors and practice leaders.
 



 Success in this role requires exceptional PowerPoint capability, strong analytical skills, and proven research experience. Candidates must be able to operate independently, move quickly, and translate research insights into clear, compelling, executive‑ready deliverables with minimal guidance.
 



**Critical Success Factors for This Role** 




**PowerPoint Mastery – Mandatory** 




 PowerPoint is not a supporting skill in this role; it is
 *core* 
 . The successful candidate must:
 


* Walk in the door with advanced PowerPoint skills, including slide storytelling, visual structuring of complex ideas, charting, tables, and executive‑level layouts

description:

A groundbreaking leader in consumer privacy, data ethics, and foundational identity, LiveRamp is setting the new standard for building a connected customer view with unmatched clarity and context while protecting precious brand and consumer trust. LiveRamp offers complete flexibility to collaborate wherever data lives to support the widest range of data collaboration use cases—within organizations, between brands, and across its premier global network of top\-quality partners.**

******You Will:******

* Lead the full integration lifecycle—requirements, design, configuration, development, unit testing, system/UAT support, cutover, and hypercare—for Workday feature releases, bi\-annual updates, and project\-based enhancements.
* Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes for Workday integrations (including error handling, retries, and data reconciliation), and drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes for production issues.
* Maintain and optimize data flows between Workday and other enterprise applications (e.g., identity and access management, ATS, compensation, benefits, and data warehouse platforms), ensuring data quality, timeliness, and consistency.
* Establish and enforce Workday integration development best practices, including code review standards, naming conventions, configuration management, and re\-usable integration patterns.
* Create and maintain high\-quality technical documentation (design specs, interface contracts, configuration guides, dependency maps) and provide knowledge transfer to peers, admins, and support teams.
* Proactively identify opportunities to streamline business processes through Workday automation, calculated fields, condition rules, and integration\-driven workflows, and build business cases for proposed improvements.
* Track and evaluate new Workday integration features and product roadmap changes, assess potential impact to LiveRamp’s ecosystem, and lead experiments or POCs to validate value and feasibility.
* Define and track key success metrics (e.g., integration uptime, incident volume/MTTR, data defect rate, batch processing times, and audit findings) and regularly report progress to stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR, FINs, and business stakeholders on Workday data structures, integration constraints, and downstream impacts to reporting, controls, and compliance.
* Apply AI\-assisted development and troubleshooting tools (e.g., code copilots, log analyzers) to speed up integration design, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high quality.
* Analyze integration telemetry with AI/ML techniques to identify recurring failure patterns, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for smarter alerting and auto\-remediation.


******Your Team Will:******
* Partner with People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Security, and other Business Applications teams to build and maintain the core HR technology foundation that powers the full LiveRamp employee lifecycle—from hire to retire. The team owns the Workday platform roadmap for integrations and is responsible for ensuring data flows are accurate, compliant, and resilient across our global systems landscape.
* You will join a small, highly\-collaborative group of Workday and SaaS application experts who:
* Lead key cross\-functional initiatives such as new country/entity rollouts, M\&A onboarding, org restructuring, and global HR process standardization, ensuring Workday integrations are ready to support business change.
* Provide level 2/3 application and integration support, working closely with our internal help desk and operations teams to triage issues, resolve incidents, and continuously improve the stability and usability of our FIN \& HR technology stack.
* Maintain strong partnerships with vendors and implementation partners, coordinating technical work, managing release impacts, and ensuring external integrations adhere to LiveRamp’s security and privacy requirements.
* Continuously refine our operating model, development standards, and delivery practices (Agile/iterative) so the team can ship high\-quality changes quickly while protecting a mission\-critical production environment.
* Introduce and standardize AI\-enabled practices (log summarization, impact analysis, test generation) that make it easier for the broader team to operate and evolve complex integrations.
* Partner with security, data, and platform teams to safely adopt AI capabilities that improve observability, resilience, and developer productivity in the Workday integrations space.


******About You:******
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and supporting Workday integrations in a production environment, using tools such as EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and Workday Web Services/REST APIs.
* Demonstrated experience owning end\-to\-end integration flows across at least two domains (e.g., HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Security, or Financials), including requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
* You are deeply curious about how systems, data, and business processes fit together, and you naturally dig into payloads, mappings, and logs rather than treating integrations as black boxes.
* You are hungry to learn and a true lifelong learner—you actively seek out new Workday integration features, patterns, and best practices, and you enjoy sharing what you learn with others.
* You are a go\-getter who takes ownership of integrations end\-to\-end, follows through on commitments, and is comfortable driving work forward without needing constant direction.
* You are an experimenter who prototypes, tests, and iterates; you’re comfortable trying new integration patterns or tooling, measuring outcomes, and quickly adjusting based on what you learn.
* You are systems\-minded and enjoy thinking in terms of interfaces, dependencies, and edge cases; you naturally anticipate downstream impacts before changing mappings or schedules in production.
* You are detail\-oriented and disciplined, especially around documentation, testing, monitoring, and change control, and you understand that small integration changes can have big, cross\-system consequences.
* You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to translate between business language and technical behavior so stakeholders understand both the “why” and the “how” of data flows and changes.
* You are calm under pressure and comfortable troubleshooting ambiguous or complex integration issues, methodically working through hypotheses until you find and fix the root cause.
* You are service\-oriented, finding energy in helping HR, Finance, and business partners be successful through reliable integrations, high\-quality data, and thoughtful support.
* Curious about AI and automation and comfortable learning new tools (e.g., copilots, log analyzers, or analytics platforms) to boost your impact even if you haven’t used them formally before.
* Confident in asking questions, running small AI\-assisted experiments (such as log summarization, test generation, or code suggestions), and using data/AI\-generated insights to challenge the status quo and propose better, safer ways of working.


******Preferred Skills:******
* Workday Pro or Workday Integration/HCM/Financials certification(s), or equivalent advanced hands\-on experience with Workday integration tools (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, REST/SOAP APIs) across both HCM and Financials domains.
* Experience integrating Workday with identity and access platforms (e.g., Okta / Azure AD), ATS/HR tools, payroll/benefits providers, and finance/data platforms (e.g., ERP, billing/collections, Snowflake or similar data warehouse) in a SaaS environment.
* Familiarity with other SaaS applications commonly integrated with Workday at LiveRamp, including ticketing/ITSM, HR service delivery, performance/engagement, learning, and finance\-adjacent tools (e.g., sourcing, CLM, or billing systems), and how they exchange data with Workday HCM and FINS.
* Experience with modern integration and automation tooling, ideally including an iPaaS/middleware platform such as Workato or SnapLogic, plus basic scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or Shell) to support data pipelines, file transformations, and operational tasks.
* Exposure to both HR lifecycle processes (hire\-to\-retire, org changes, compensation cycles, security/role lifecycle) and finance processes (Source to Pay, Contract to Cash, GL/close), and how these translate into Workday configuration and integrations.
* Prior participation in Workday bi\-annual releases and major projects, including impact analysis on HR and FINS integrations, regression testing of critical interfaces, and rollout of new capabilities with appropriate monitoring.
* Familiarity with SOX, GDPR, and other privacy/security frameworks that impact HR and finance data, and experience designing integration\-level controls, logging, and audit evidence to support compliance across both domains.
* Experience using AI copilots or automation tools in a development or integration context (e.g., generating code snippets, test cases, or documentation) or a strong desire to ramp quickly.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms that leverage AI/ML to detect anomalies or predict incidents across integrations and data flows.

 CET time zone

description:

**About The Role**
 The Process Intelligence Specialist is responsible for delivering data‑driven insights into how business processes actually run, using process mining, modelling, and advanced analytics. The role focuses on hands‑on analysis, converting complex process data into clear, actionable insights that help teams improve service, cost, speed, adherence, and automation readiness. This role works closely with process leads, business operations, data analytics, transformation teams, IT, and analytics functions and plays a key role in embedding process intelligence into day‑to‑day decision‑making.
   

  

 Your responsibilities

* Support process standardization efforts while clearly highlighting justified local or channel‑specific variants
* Contribute to scenario and impact modelling (e.g. what\-if models for promotions, capacity constraints, demand shocks)
* Set\-up \& Analysis of end‑to‑end process mining use cases on end\-to\-end processes e.g., O2C, S2P, R2R, Hire\-to\-Retire, Plan\-to Fulfil
* Discover actual execution flows, variants, bottlenecks, rework, and deviations from standard processes
* Support audit, SOX, and regulatory requirements with data‑based evidence

* Translate analytical findings into clear, business‑oriented insights
* Create dashboards, views, and visuals that answer, “what happened, why, and where to act.”

 5\-7 years in process analytics, process improvement, or operational analytics
   

  

 Hands‑on experience with process intelligence tools
   

  

 Exposure to FMCG, consumer goods, or other high‑volume operational environments preferred
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in business, Data Analytics or related field
   

  

 Certifications in Lean Six Sigma, Agile working, Process Mining, Analytics are a plus

 Process Mining, Celonis, Process data analysis, Business process transformation, Six Sigma, Finance Process transformaiton, Lean, Process Intelligence, Process Modelling
