 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.
   

  

 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Director, GCC Commercial Lead to join our Global Capability Center (GCC) in Hyderabad. This role is a foundational member of Regeneron's first GCC and will drive the expansion and scaling of commercial capabilities across Insights \& Analytics, Commercial Operations, and Market Access. The successful candidate will establish best practices, build high\-performing teams, and enable a data\-driven, customer\-centric commercial model while working closely with U.S.\-based commercial leadership.

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

* Lead and scale the India\-based GCC commercial organization, driving innovation, best practices, and collaboration across teams.
* Serve as a member of the GCC leadership team and contribute to the overall success of the Global Capability Center.
* Build, develop, and mentor high\-performing teams through hiring, capability development, and leadership coaching.
* Oversee leaders responsible for Insights \& Analytics, Commercial Operations, and Market Access functions.
* Collaborate with global commercial leadership to define and implement the commercial capability roadmap aligned with enterprise strategy and business priorities.

* Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and influence strategic business decisions.
* Drive integration of analytics, insights, and operations to support data\-driven decision\-making and commercial excellence.

* Oversee delivery of analytics, reporting, campaign execution, and operational support across multiple global markets, including the U.S., EU5, and Japan.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, legal, and internal quality standards across all commercial activities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, scalability, and quality of commercial capabilities.

* Deep familiarity with commercial data domains including patient, HCP, claims, prescription, payer, CRM, and market datasets.
* Experience using advanced analytics, customer segmentation, performance analytics, and forecasting to support business decisions.

* Understanding of digital, CRM, and omnichannel engagement ecosystems, including campaign measurement and customer engagement strategies.
* Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
* Familiarity with commercial operations processes including campaign execution, incentive compensation, territory alignment, and program delivery.
* Understanding of data integration, architecture concepts, multi\-source data environments, ETL processes, and analytics enablement.
* Knowledge of regulatory, compliance, and review processes impacting commercial content and engagement.
* Experience building and scaling global capability models, operating frameworks, and service delivery structures.
* Proven leadership experience managing large, cross\-functional teams.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate business priorities into execution.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience working with senior leadership teams.
* Strong communication and influencing skills across all organizational levels.
* Ability to thrive in high\-growth, evolving environments and lead organizational transformation.
* Strong problem\-solving and continuous improvement attitude.
* Comfortable working across global time zones and collaborating with U.S.\-based leadership.
* 10\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial functions, including significant leadership experience across Insights \& Analytics, Commercial Operations, Market Access, or related domains.
* Demonstrated success in building and scaling high\-performing teams.

title: Associate, Marketing Performance Analytics-Budget & Operations-Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Associate, Budget \& Operations Associate**
 The Budget \& Operations Associate will support the US\-based Manager and India\-based Specialist in delivering accurate, timely, and efficient budget and operational activities for the marketing organization. The role will focus primarily on recurring budget tracking, reporting, data validation, reconciliations, invoice support, and follow\-up activities.
   

  

 The Associate will develop a working understanding of the marketing organization’s needs and priorities and will execute assigned activities using established processes, templates, and tools.
   

  

 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and organized candidate with a foundation in business operations, budget management, financial reporting, and data analysis. The successful candidate should be comfortable working with data, preparing clear reports, managing recurring tasks, and learning new tools and processes.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
* Develop an understanding of the marketing organization’s business needs and priorities and gather information required for assigned activities
* Support budget management activities, including tracking, updating, monitoring spend, performing basic variance checks, and following up on outstanding items
* Obtain, organize, and maintain expense information and supporting documentation for review by your leader
* Prepare accurate recurring reports related to budget, capacity, utilization, and forecasts using established templates and reporting processes
* Perform routine data validation, reconciliations, and quality checks across budget, hours, expense, and operational data
* Identify discrepancies, resolve straightforward data issues, and escalate complex or unusual items for further review
* Support fiscal year operating plan activities by gathering inputs, updating tracking files, documenting changes, and monitoring follow\-up actions
* Assist with the development, maintenance, and quality assurance of reports and dashboards
* Support staffing capacity and utilization reporting and basic forecasting activities
* Prepare basic analyses and summaries that highlight trends, variances, and items requiring management attention
* Maintain dashboards and tracking tools used for recurring reporting and operational monitoring
* Complete assigned follow\-up activities with Finance and other designated contacts
* Identify opportunities to improve recurring processes and implement agreed\-upon enhancements
* Maintain organized documentation and ensure assigned deliverables are completed accurately and on time


 Partner with Finance to:
   

  

* Coordinate routine Finance requests and follow\-ups based on directions from the Manager or Specialist
* Develop a working understanding of Deloitte’s financial environment and its impact on operations
* Support year\-end close and accrual activities by gathering information, preparing schedules, and tracking completion
* Prepare supporting information for costs requiring journal entries and coordinate submission activities with Finance under established procedures
* Support cost allocation and cost management activities using defined processes and guidelines
* Escalate questions, exceptions, and items requiring judgment to the Manager or Specialist


**Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of experience supporting budget management, financial operations, reporting, data analysis, or project coordination
* Experience working with budgets, expenses, invoices, or financial data; marketing organization or advertising agency experience is a plus
* Willingness to learn and use AI\-enabled tools to support budget management, improve reporting efficiency, and streamline financial tracking
* Working knowledge of data analysis, reporting, and data quality practices
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office tools; familiarity with PowerPoint, Power BI, and Tableau is preferred
* Experience managing or submitting invoices for processing, or the ability to quickly learn the firm’s invoice submission tools
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize routine information and flag questions or exceptions
* Exposure to capacity and utilization reporting or a willingness to learn these processes
* Ability to work effectively with the US\-based Manager, India\-based Specialist, Finance, and other designated stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and follow\-through
* Ability to manage recurring activities, follow established processes, and prioritize assigned work
* Ability to support internal projects and contribute to project deliverables; prior project leadership experience is not required
* Ability to investigate and resolve routine issues and appropriately escalate more complex problems
* Collaborative, dependable, and comfortable working across time zones


 Education and Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
* 2\+ years of relevant business finance operations, reporting, data analysis, or business support experience
* Marketing organization or advertising agency experience is a plus

 Hyderabad \- Shift: 2:00 pm to 11:00 pm OR 11:00 am \- 4:00 pm \& 7:00 pm \- 11:00 pm
   

  

**The team**
**About Deloitte’s Brand Marketing \& Communications**

Join a team that blends creativity, business acumen, strategic thinking, and Deloitte’s strong brand equity to deliver impactful marketing solutions. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

The ISO Underwriting unit of Verisk Insurance Solutions is hiring a QA Business Analyst as part of the team developing and supporting ISO’s Electronic Rating Content (ERC) product. * Ability to retain in depth knowledge of Verisk Rating and ERC Rating offerings
* Developing and implementing testing strategies, plans, and procedures for insurance manual updates for supported lines within ERC
* Identifying and reporting defects and issues to the development team and tracking them through to resolution.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that help deliver quality features with efficiency.
* Knowledge of API technology and API requests

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

**THE ROLE**
 We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team. The People Analytics team empowers the People tribe to elevate our Wisers' experience by leveraging data and insights.
   

  

 As a Senior Data Analyst in People Analytics you will build People Analytics products at scale as well as conducting research projects to drive tangible business impact.

**About the role** 




 The Senior Analyst, Marketing Analytics is a data specialist on Global Digital Marketing Analytics team, responsible for building and maintaining trustworthy, well\-structured datasets and dashboards behind the team's marketing reporting. The focus is reliable data — correctly sourced, assembled, and validated — and reports the team can trust.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who works with data fluently and independently: able to take a reporting goal, determine what data it requires, and shape it into a sound dataset and a clear dashboard. It suits someone who takes ownership of quality — checking for completeness, confirming data is merged correctly, validating against source systems, and catching problems before they reach a report.
 



  





 It is also a role for someone who wants to work smarter, more efficiently. We expect this person to bring AI into how they workday to day — using it to speed up data preparation, validation, and dashboard development — and to continuously look for opportunities to automate repetitive work, so the team’s reporting runs faster and more reliably.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




**Data Sourcing \& Preparation** 



* Determine the data required for reporting purposes, identifying the right sources and the appropriate fields to meet them.
* Build and prototype datasets structured for clean, efficient consumption in the reporting platform.
* Combine data across multiple sources, ensuring it is merged and transformed correctly for the intended use.



**Quality \& Validation** 



* Validate data for completeness and accuracy throughout the workflow and against source systems.
* Own data quality as a standard, building checks into the process and serving as the quality backstop the team relies on.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies, recognizing when results do not hold up and tracing them to their source.



**Reporting \& Dashboards** 



* Build, prototype, and maintain dashboards and BI products in the team’s reporting platform.
* Keep BI products accurate, current, and reliable over time, refining outputs as needs evolve.
* Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, dashboards, and data processes, keeping it clear and current.
* Handle ad\-hoc data pulls and requests, turning them around with accuracy and appropriate context.
* Coordinate with the broader BI and insights teams so datasets and dashboards support how reporting and interpretation are used.



**AI \& Automation** 



* Bring AI into day\-to\-day data preparation, validation, and dashboard work to improve speed and reliability.
* Identify and automate repetitive data and reporting tasks, reducing manual effort and the risk of error.
* Experiment with new AI tools and approaches, adopting them where they raise the quality or efficiency of the team’s work.



**What you’ll need** 



* 3–5 years of experience working hands\-on with data analysis and reporting; experience in marketing analytics or digital analytics.
* Strong data preparation and transformation skills, with the ability to source, combine, and shape data from multiple systems into clean, reliable datasets. Proficiency in SQL for querying, combining, and transforming data; Python a plus.
* Strong, hands\-on skills building dashboards and BI products in Power BI; Data Studio (Looker) experience a plus.
* Comfort using and experimenting with AI tools, and an interest in applying them to automate and improve data and reporting work.
* Experience with the digital marketing stack(e.g., Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Customer Data Platform).
* Strong attention to detail and a sense of ownership over the accuracy of what the team produces.
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, business, or related field.

 The EU Marketing \& Prime organization is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer. This role combines large\-scale analytics with statistical and data\-science work — causal inference, experimentation, and predictive modeling. If your background is in data science, applied statistics, or quantitative analytics, this is that work under Amazon's internal job title.
   

  

 The PRIMAS team provides a comprehensive understanding of customer segments, affinities and lifetime value. We use the latest data science tools and advanced analytical techniques to study customer purchase and engagement behaviors and generate actionable insights on where, when and how we provide products and programs to our customers to meet their needs and to delight them. We help to increase customer engagement, sales and marketing efficiency. Our systems are built entirely in\-house and on automated large\-scale analytics systems. You will generate insights, design/deliver/measure experiments and strategies across marketing channels (SEM/SEO, Affiliates, Display, Social, Mobile, Email, Onsite, etc.), engagement products and customer segments. You will improve our understanding of customer behavior and engagement, design and conduct rigorous experiments on the effectiveness and efficiency of different marketing actions, and build the causal and conversion models that value and target our marketing. You will work on the forefront of consumer analytics, tackling some of the hardest problems in the industry alongside some of the best scientists, statisticians, and software engineers in the field.

* Working on complex, loosely defined analytics problems and defining the team's Business Intelligence (BI) strategy — delivering independently and influencing the organization's BI architecture.

* Building and evaluating causal and treatment\-effect models that produce conversion and valuation signals consumed by downstream bidding and budgeting systems.
* Designing and running experiments and quasi\-experiments (A/B, geo, holdout) to measure marketing incrementality, and developing measurement frameworks that quantify the true, platform\-independent contribution of marketing over time.

title: Process Improvement Specialist, Seller Insights, EU FBA Support Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon seeks a results\-oriented, analytical Process Improvement Specialist to join the EU FBA Support Operations team. This role sits within our Seller Experience \& Insights pillar, focused on reducing escalation volume through rigorous root cause analysis, process improvement design, and cross\-functional coordination. You will own the analytical backbone of our escalation reduction program — investigating why escalations occur, designing the fixes, and measuring their impact.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-depth role. You will deep\-dive into escalation data, map operational processes, identify systemic failure points, write structured root cause analyses, and drive process improvements through to implementation and measured impact. You will work closely with operations teams, product managers, and policy owners to ensure fixes are implemented — not just recommended.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Own root cause analysis (RCA) for escalation themes: investigate patterns across ticket data, map failure points in operational processes, and produce structured RCA write\-ups with clear findings, root causes, and recommended fixes.
   

  

 Build and maintain the escalation reduction roadmap: prioritize systemic issues by seller impact and volume, track progress against reduction targets, and report status weekly.
   

  

 Coordinate with cross\-functional teams (product, policy, operations, WW Support Ops) to drive implementation of fixes — ensuring issues have owners, deadlines, and closure criteria
   

  

 Design SLA frameworks and operational standards for escalation resolution, working with the operations team to define quality and timeliness benchmarks.
   

  

 Partner with the Voice of Seller specialist to connect escalation RCA findings with broader seller experience trends — turning reactive investigations into proactive prevention
   

  

 Produce dashboards and reporting that make escalation health, reduction progress, and process performance visible to the team and leadership
   

  

 Conduct regular Gemba walks and frontline observation sessions with escalation investigators to gather process insights directly — ensuring RCA findings are grounded in operational reality, not just data patterns
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You start by reviewing escalation data for patterns and emerging failure modes. You identify a cluster, map the root cause, then validate it through a Gemba session with the operations team. You draft a structured RCA with a recommended fix and align with the product team who owns the system. You work on coaching of analytical methodology and update the escalation reduction dashboard. By Friday, the fix you proposed weeks ago shows up in the metrics — fewer escalations, better seller outcomes.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Today, more than 60% of worldwide purchases from Amazon are made from third\-party selling partners, mostly from small\- and medium\-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery, returns, and customer service to Amazon.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with Excel and large\-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL or Tableau

description:
Senior Scientist, Data Analytics and Pharmacometric Modeling
   

  

 Join Amgen’s Clinical Pharmacology, Modeling and Simulation (CPMS) team as a Senior Scientist and help shape the future of drug development through data science, predictive analytics, pharmacometrics, and quantitative systems pharmacology. In this role, you will apply innovative modeling and simulation approaches to support critical decisions across clinical development programs and therapeutic areas.
   

  

 You will work in a collaborative, science\-driven environment alongside CPMS colleagues, therapeutic area teams, external partners, and cross\-functional R\&D stakeholders. This is an opportunity to contribute to model\-informed drug development, influence study design and dose selection, and help bring meaningful therapies to patients.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a quantitative scientist who enjoys working with complex biological and clinical datasets, translating analyses into actionable insights, and communicating results clearly to multidisciplinary teams. You will have the opportunity to use established pharmacometric methods as well as emerging machine learning and AI\-enabled tools to solve high\-impact development questions. The typical job responsibilities may include :
   

  

* Develop and implement modeling, simulation, and analytics strategies that support clinical drug development programs across Amgen’s portfolio.
* Use pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, patient\-level, and disease data to inform dose selection, dosing regimens, study designs, and development decisions.
* Analyze in vitro and preclinical PK/PD data to support first\-in\-human dose selection and contribute to IND submissions and supporting documentation.
* Build and apply pharmacometric, PK/PD, quantitative systems pharmacology, and predictive analytics models to address key program questions.
* Partner with clinical pharmacologists, statisticians, translational scientists, clinical teams, and other stakeholders to integrate quantitative insights into program strategy.
* Explore and recommend innovative data science, machine learning, and AI\-enabled approaches that can improve decision\-making and increase development efficiency.
* Communicate modeling results and recommendations clearly through study reports, regulatory documents, presentations, publications, and cross\-functional discussions.
* Contribute to the external scientific community through publications, presentations, and professional engagement.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Doctorate degree and 4 years of relevant experience; or
* Master’s degree and 8 years of relevant experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of relevant experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced training in statistical or data sciences, computer science, pharmaceutical sciences, engineering, clinical pharmacology, pharmacometrics, or a related quantitative discipline; PhD, MD, PharmD, or equivalent experience preferred.
* Experience in life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, consulting, or postdoctoral research, with a strong interest in applying quantitative methods to drug development.
* Hands\-on experience developing, scripting, and executing data analytics algorithms, statistical models, or pharmacometric models.
* Experience with tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, NONMEM, SAS, S\-Plus, or related modeling and analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with machine learning, AI\-enabled methods, or advanced analytics applied to life science datasets is a plus.
* Experience with PK/PD modeling, population\-based analyses, clinical trial simulations, or model\-informed drug development is highly valued.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain quantitative analyses and recommendations to scientific, clinical, and cross\-functional audiences.
* A collaborative mindset, scientific curiosity, and the ability to influence and contribute within multidisciplinary teams.
* A record of scientific contribution through publications, presentations, regulatory support, or external engagement is desirable.

**About ThoughtFocus** 




 ThoughtFocus is a global IT services and solutions company with deep capabilities across Data \& Analytics, Cloud, Modern Engineering, and Financial Services technology. Headquartered in the US with delivery centers in India, we partner with leading enterprises to build scalable, future\-ready technology solutions. Our teams are built on a culture of ownership, expertise, and long\-term client partnerships — and talent is at the heart of how we grow. \-
 **https://thoughtfocus.com/** 




  





 Job Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced Senior BI Analyst with strong expertise in Power BI, MySQL, MSSQL, and a deep understanding of Finance and FP\&A processes. The ideal candidate will partner closely with Finance and leadership teams to deliver high\-impact dashboards, insights, and financial analytics to support strategic decision\-making.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop, enhance, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for Finance and FP\&A teams.
* Build and optimize data models using DAX, Power Query, and BI best practices.
* Extract, transform, and manage data from MySQL and MS SQL Server databases.
* Write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and transformations for financial reporting.
* Support FP\&A activities including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, headcount analysis, and profitability reporting.
* Translate business requirements from Finance into scalable BI solutions and analytical data models.
* Ensure high levels of data accuracy, validation, and governance across financial datasets.
* Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and FP\&A teams to understand business processes, KPIs, and reporting needs.
* Provide actionable insights to Finance leadership through clear visualizations and data storytelling.
* Identify gaps or inefficiencies in financial reporting processes and recommend BI\-driven improvements.
* Automate recurring financial reports and manual data processes to drive efficiency and accuracy.
* Document BI models, datasets, logic, and workflows for transparency and future reference.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to align on data structures, business rules, and KPI definitions.



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 


* 8\+ years of experience as a BI Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role.
* Strong expertise in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling).
* Advanced SQL skills in MySQL and MS SQL Server databases.
* Solid understanding of Finance and FP\&A concepts, including budgeting, forecasting, margin analysis, variance analysis, and financial KPIs.
* Strong business understanding with ability to translate financial needs into BI solutions.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to partner with CFO, FP\&A, and Finance teams effectively.



 Experience in a fast\-paced environment with end\-to\-end BI ownership.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a Data Analyst to collect, process, and analyze data to help drive informed business decisions. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience with data tools, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources
* Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies
* Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations for stakeholders
* Write efficient SQL queries to extract and manipulate data

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field

* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset)

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field.

description:
**We're looking for a** 
****Data Analyst****
**This role is** 
**Office Based, Pune Office**
**Data Analyst – Enterprise Data Management**

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Data Analyst** 
 to join our Enterprise Data Management team , with a core focus on Data Quality, Data Governance, and Master Data Management (MDM). In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing, profiling, and enhancing data within critical enterprise applications, including Salesforce, Oracle ERP, and Marketo. A key part of your responsibilities involves establishing and maintaining data quality standards, supporting data governance initiatives, and assisting with ongoing MDM processes to ensure data consistency and integrity across the organization. You will collaborate extensively with Data Stewards, business stakeholders, and IT teams to proactively identify, investigate, and resolve data issues.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in data analysis and data management within enterprise environments, with hands\-on skills in scripting/querying data (SQL, Python), integrating data from various source systems (including Snowflake), and direct involvement in data quality and data governance projects. Experience with data quality or integration tools, such as Syncari and Validity, is highly desirable, and familiarity with Tableau for data visualization is a plus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze and interpret data sets from multiple enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Oracle ERP, Marketo, and others.
* Write and optimize complex scripts and queries in SQL, Python, and relevant languages across Snowflake and source applications.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance Tableau dashboards to effectively visualize key business metrics and data trends.
* Collaborate closely with both IT teams and business stakeholders to gather requirements, validate data, and resolve data quality issues.
* Work with Data Stewards to address and resolve data governance issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
* Support ongoing data governance and data quality initiatives by establishing processes, standards, and best practices.
* Document all data processes, methodologies, and insights clearly and effectively for a variety of audiences.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement within the data management lifecycle.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 5–7 years of experience as a Data Analyst in an enterprise environment.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, data extraction, and scripting languages (with a preference for Python).
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise applications like Salesforce, Oracle ERP, and Marketo.
* Deep working knowledge of cloud data platforms, especially Snowflake.
* Demonstrated history of working successfully in a data governance framework, including experience collaborating with Data Stewards and business users to resolve data issues.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written), with a proven ability to work closely with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts and practices.
* Experience with data integration or data quality tools such as Syncari and Validity is highly desirable.
* Experience with data visualization tools, particularly Tableau.

title: Assistant Vice President MI and Reporting
description:
**Job title:** 
**Assistant Vice President MI and Reporting**
**AVP MI: \-**
* Lead the Management Information (MI) and Analytics function for the operations portfolio by delivering accurate, timely, and insightful reporting that supports strategic decision\-making, operational performance, risk management, and regulatory oversight. Drive data governance, automation, and visualization to enable a data\-driven culture across the organization.


**Role Context**
* Sits within the Account Solution Process / Operations (or relevant COO function), partnering closely with Product, Change, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and frontline operational teams.
* Owns MI outcomes across the end\-to\-end process (e.g., account opening/maintenance/servicing, workflow queues, exceptions, controls, and customer outcomes), ensuring consistent definitions and a “single version of the truth”.
* Operates in a regulated environment with high expectations on data quality, conduct, operational resilience, and control reporting.
* Supports strategic priorities such as simplification, digitization, service improvement, capacity optimization, and risk reduction through insight\-led decisioning.
* Create and design – Regional Governance packs and ensure clear actions updated summarized post every meeting is documented.


**Key Responsibilities**
**In this role, you will:**
* Own the end\-to\-end MI strategy and reporting framework for the operations portfolio.
* Develop and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and KPIs to provide actionable insights to senior management.
* Design, automate, and optimize recurring management reports to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Analyze operational performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and provide data\-driven recommendations to stakeholders.
* Partner with Operations, Product, Finance, Risk, Technology, and Data teams to define reporting requirements and deliver meaningful insights.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of operational data through robust governance and quality controls.
* Lead root cause analysis using data to identify drivers of operational incidents, service issues, and process inefficiencies.
* Develop forecasting models, capacity planning reports, productivity metrics, and performance analytics to support business planning.
* Drive continuous improvement and automation of MI processes using visualization and reporting tools.
* Support governance forums, business reviews, audit requests, regulatory reporting, and executive presentations with high\-quality analysis.
* Establish standardized definitions, KPI frameworks, and reporting methodologies across markets.
* Mentor and develop analysts while fostering a culture of data literacy and continuous improvement.


**AVP MI: \-**
**Governance and Committee Memberships** 
 (membership of ExCos, Risk Management Meeting)
   

  

* Timely preparation of all relevant presentations with MI for all Account Solution Process governance forums (e.g., Process/Operations governance, Service Management reviews, Performance \& Capacity reviews).
* Focus on OKR’s and Customer Sentiment scores to ensure the SOP is clearly designed and completed to focus on Customer Centricity.
* Connecto Journeys and adoption across 39 markets is to be assessed and share the MI to Ops head to increase adoption.
* PAD solution exceptions to be consolidated and update for management visibility
* Provides MI packs and insight for risk and control forums (e.g., Operational Risk, Issues \& Actions, Control monitoring reviews) as required.
* Engages with Change/Delivery governance (e.g., project/initiative steering, RAID reviews) to track benefits, outcomes, and operational readiness.
* Works with Data Governance stakeholders to align on data standards, lineage, access controls, and metric definitions.
* (Final committee names and cadence to be confirmed locally.)


**AVP MI: \-**
**Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 
 (e.g., for Business, Customers and Stakeholders; internal control environment, etc.)
   

  

**MI strategy, design, and delivery**
* Define and maintain the MI framework for the Account Solution Process: KPI/KRI library, metric definitions, thresholds, and reporting cadence (daily/weekly/monthly/QBR).
* Produce high\-quality MI packs and dashboards (performance, productivity, quality, risk, customer outcomes), ensuring clarity, narrative, and decision\-ready insights.
* Build and maintain automated reporting where possible, reducing manual effort and improving timeliness and control.
* Performance management and insight
* Analyze trends, drivers, and root causes (e.g., volumes, turnaround times, backlog ageing, rework, exceptions, SLA breaches).
* Provide forward\-looking insights (capacity, demand forecasting, seasonality) and scenario views to support planning and prioritization.
* Track benefits realization for change initiatives and identify opportunities for simplification and continuous improvement.


**Stakeholder management**
* Partner with senior operations leaders and process owners to shape priorities, interpret MI, and agree actions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to cross\-functional stakeholders (Risk, Compliance, Finance, Technology, Change) by providing consistent, well\-governed data and analysis.
* Present insights confidently in governance forums, highlighting key risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.


**Data quality, controls, and governance**
* Ensure MI is accurate, complete, and reconciled where required; implement controls for data sourcing, transformation, and reporting sign\-off.
* Maintain documentation (data dictionaries, metric definitions, lineage, assumptions) and ensure appropriate access management and confidentiality handling.
* Identify and escalate data issues, control gaps, and reporting risks, drive remediation with data owners and technology teams.


**Customer and conduct focus**
* Ensure MI supports customer outcomes (e.g., service levels, complaints drivers, error rates, rework) and helps prevent avoidable harm.
* Embed conduct and fair outcomes considerations into reporting and insight, ensuring issues are surfaced early and addressed.


**To Be Successful You Will**
**AVP MI: \-**
**Functional Knowledge**
* Strong MI and analytics capability: KPI/KRI design, performance management, trend analysis, root cause analysis, and storytelling with data.
* Advanced reporting skills (e.g., Excel, Power BI/Tableau; SQL desirable; understanding of data models and ETL concepts beneficial).
* Understanding of operations/process management concepts (SLAs, queue management, capacity planning, Lean/continuous improvement).
* Knowledge of risk and control expectations in a regulated financial services environment (operational risk, issues/actions tracking, audit readiness).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including producing executive\-ready packs and presenting to senior forums.
* High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and ability to work at pace across multiple priorities


**Skills \& Experience**
* 5\-6 years of experience in Management Information, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or Banking Operations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate data into business insights.
* Experience designing executive dashboards and performance reporting.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, and other visualization or reporting tools.
* Experience working with large datasets and multiple source systems.
* Strong understanding of operational KPIs, service metrics, productivity, quality, and risk indicators.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Experience in data governance, reporting automation, and process improvement.
* Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma or Business Intelligence methodologies is an advantage.


**Success Measures**
* Timely and accurate delivery of MI and executive reporting.
* Improved data quality and governance across the portfolio.
* Enhanced executive decision\-making through actionable insights.
* Standardized KPI framework across products and markets.
* High stakeholder satisfaction with MI reporting and analytics.
* Delivery of analytics that drive measurable operational improvements and productivity gains.

description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW** 





 The Junior Analyst will play a critical support role within Graystone Capital’s financial analyst team, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timely availability of financial data. This entry level role is ideal for candidates who are detail\-oriented, numerically proficient, and eager to build a career in corporate finance and investment analysis.
 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Data Entry \& Accuracy** 



* Accurately enter financial data from source documents into spreadsheets and internal systems
* Prepare, review, and complete internal documentation, including one\-pager checklists and supporting forms, to facilitate due diligence, compliance verification, and internal approval processes.
* Verify and cross check entered data for completeness, consistency, and correctness before submission
* Maintain data integrity across all files and flag discrepancies to the reporting manager immediately
* Ensure zero error data standards through structured double\-checking routines



**Financial Spreading** 



* Spread financial statements (Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) from client documents into standardized excel templates
* Perform working capital and ratio calculations including liquidity ratios, leverage ratios, and profitability metrics as directed
* Assist in maintaining and updating financial models and analytical templates used by the senior team



**Data Collation \& Reporting** 



* Collect and consolidate financial data from multiple sources including client submissions, third\-party databases, and internal files
* Organize collated data into structured formats ready for analysis by senior analysts
* Draft bank\-specific credit proposal templates by analysing financial, operational, and business information to support comprehensive credit assessment, risk evaluation, and lending recommendations.
* Prepare \& populate summary sheets, trackers, and dashboards for ongoing deals and client portfolios
* Support preparation of transaction teasers, information memoranda, internal MIS and credit notes on a regular basis



**Documentation Management** 



* Maintain well organized and up to date documentation system for all client financial data and deal documents
* Assist in compiling document checklists and ensuring all required financial information is on track
* Coordinate with senior team members to track and follow up on data requirements from clients
* Coordinate and correspond with lenders on documentation support



**Quality Control \& Compliance** 



* Adhere to internal data quality standards and review protocols at all times
* Maintain confidentiality of all client’s financial information in line with company policies
* Ensure all work is completed within agreed timelines and flagged proactively if delays are anticipated



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 



* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (M. Com / MBA Finance or equivalent)
* 1–2 years of experience in financial data handling, accounting, credit or a related role
* Working knowledge of MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, basic formulas), MS Word
* Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
* Financial data entry and spreading
* Basic understanding of accounting concepts
* Basic knowledge of credit and trade finance products
* Understanding of financial statements — P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow



  





**How to Apply** 

 : Interested candidates may share their resume at: hr.in@graystonefs.com, Subject Line: Application – Junior Analyst

 At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation.  Develop SAP Analytics Cloud stories, models, dashboards, planning views, data connections, and reports to support project and business analytics.

 Lead KPI definition workshops with quality, manufacturing, planning and finance stakeholders; convert vaguely stated reporting wishes into agreed formulas, sources, granularity, refresh frequency and ownership.Map reporting requirements against standard analytical Fiori apps and embedded analytics first, documenting explicitly what standard already meets so only the genuine remainder is built.Design the analytics architecture across SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere and SAC — live connections to S/4HANA CDS models, acquisition patterns and the feed from SAP Digital Manufacturing.Build SAC models, stories and analytic applications for manufacturing KPIs (OEE and its factors, machine comparison, downtime drivers, WIP, yield), quality KPIs (first pass yield, rejection rate, defect Pareto, control charts, supplier quality), lot and inventory KPIs (lot lifecycle, held lots, aged and expired stock), and planning and cost KPIs.Build the composite business\-specific KPIs — cost of poor quality as a share of sales, scrap ratios, on\-time delivery, manufacturing cost and gross margin, safety — joining quality, production, finance and sales data; deliver the actual\-costing management reporting layer.Set the visual and interaction standard for the dashboard estate — consistent color semantics, accessible contrast, chart\-type selection, drill paths and shop\-floor display formats — so it reads as one system; design SAC roles, teams and row\-level data access aligned to S/4HANA authorizations.Support the formal decision on the legacy visualization tool with a clear recommendation and migration path; establish KPI governance, and train client KPI owners and report authors to extend the estate themselves

title: Business Analyst/Product Owner-Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**About the Role**
 Deloitte is looking for a hands\-on product manager – Senior Consultant to own a product end\-to\-end within Deloitte Consulting Products. Based in US\-India (USI Office), you'll own the day\-to\-day of a product built for the US market—running discovery, shaping the roadmap, and working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with engineering and design to ship value clients actually use.
   

  

 This is a builder's role at its core. You're the strongest product craftsperson on your product: closest to the user, closest to the backlog, and accountable for the outcomes it delivers. You'll work with US\-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders to stay grounded in the market you're building for.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Own Your Product**
* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for your product, turning priorities into a clear plan of what to build next
* Make the day\-to\-day prioritization and trade\-off calls, sequencing work by value, effort, and readiness
* Define and track the metrics that show it's working: adoption, engagement, retention, impact
* Know when something isn't working—flag it early and make the case to change course or stop


**Discover \& Validate**
* Run discovery to understand your users and the problems worth solving, partnering with US product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders
* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and rapid validation before building at scale
* Use both generative and evaluative research to answer “are we building the right thing?” and “are we building it right?”


**Ship as One Team**
* Take features and products from concept through define, shape, build, and scale
* Own the product backlog: write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and keep it groomed and prioritized
* Work as one team with engineering and UX—sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving
* Own launch, adoption, and iteration; instrument the product and act on what the data shows
* Work in an AI\-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery to move faster without cutting corners


**Clients \& Go\-to\-Market**
* Stay close to clients—join demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations, and turn what you hear into the roadmap
* Support go\-to\-market with product marketing, sales, and account teams: positioning, demos, and enablement
* Stay fluent in the US market realities that shape your product: data privacy, SaaS vs. on\-prem


**Work Across the Network**
* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align your product with delivery capacity and real client needs, and be the go\-to for questions on your product


**Reporting Relationships**
 Reports to a Manager of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering and UX, partners with US\-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and collaborates with GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 6\+ years in product management or product ownership, including owning a product end\-to\-end
* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, with measurable outcomes
* Strong hands\-on product craft: backlog, user stories and acceptance criteria, and working day to day with engineering and design in an agile setup
* Fluent in discovery and validation—user research, hypotheses, prototypes—not just delivery
* Comfortable client\-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders
* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US\-market direction and its nuances


**Preferred**
* Seasoned as a Product Owner in an agile / Scrum environment
* Zero\-to\-one product or feature launch experience
* Products, professional services, consulting, or enterprise\-technology background
* Experience mentoring junior product owners


**Core Competencies**
* Owns outcomes, not just outputs
* Problem\-obsessed and customer\-centric
* Strong product craft and delivery discipline
* Bias to action—ships, learns, iterates
* Clear communicator with engineering, design, and stakeholders
* Data\-driven, with sound judgment


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

description:
**Job title** 
 : Controls Automation \& Analytics Specialist
   

  

* Location: Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and
 **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by
 **making self\-care as simple as it should be** 
 . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our
 **100 loved brands** 
 , our
 **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** 
 and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

**B Corp certified in multiple markets** 
 , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 The Controls Automation \& Analytics Specialist enables efficient, high\-quality, and scalable
 **internal control testing** 
 through data analytics, automation and agentic AI. The role prepares and validates large transactional datasets, develops repeatable automated tests to identify exceptions, and supports the testing team with data\-driven insights and monitoring outputs.
   

  

 The position sits within the Internal Control Testing and Automation organization and reports to the Director, Internal Control Testing and Automation.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
**Data, Analytics \& Automated Testing Delivery**
* Define data requirements with testers and process stakeholders. Obtain and prepare extracts from source systems (ERP, sub\-ledgers, workflow tools).
* Perform data quality and reconciliation checks (completeness, accuracy, duplicates, cut\-off, mapping) and document results.
* Build and maintain automated tests (SQL/Python/R) to detect exceptions (e.g., duplicate payments, abnormal journals, master data anomalies).
* Develop dashboards and exception reporting (Power BI/Tableau) to support periodic and continuous monitoring.
* Operationalize automated tests: scheduling, run\-books, exception triage workflow, and handoff to testers/control owners.


**Agentic AI Enablement for Testing**
* Design and maintain agentic AI workflows to support testing activities such as evidence intake/classification, completeness checks, automated follow\-ups, exception clustering, and drafting testing narratives for reviewer completion.
* Define human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and ensure reviewer approval before conclusions are finalized.
* Maintain prompt libraries, agent configurations, and reusable components aligned with testing standards.


**Governance, Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure audit\-ready governance for automation and agentic solutions: documented logic/assumptions, data lineage, versioning/change logs, reproducibility, logging, access controls, and periodic re\-validation.
* Collaborate with IC Testing Analysts/Senior Analysts and process teams to translate testing objectives into analytics/agentic use\-cases and support root cause analysis and remediation follow\-up.
* Identify opportunities to expand automation/agentic coverage and reduce manual effort. Contribute to the testing automation roadmap and standardization initiatives.


**About You**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Professional certifications (CFA, CPA, ACCA, CIA, CISA, or AI/analytics certifications) are a plus.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or related field.
* Relevant certifications are a plus (data/analytics, CISA, etc.).


**Experience**
* 2–4 years in data analytics, IT audit, forensic analytics, finance analytics, automation, or similar.
* Proven experience working with large transactional datasets in ERP/finance contexts.
* Hands\-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytics language (Python or R).
* Experience with BI/visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau) and strong Excel skills.
* Experience building automated analytics, exception monitoring, or controls monitoring solutions.
* Exposure to LLM/agentic workflows in a controlled business context (prompt design, evaluation, logging) is a plus.


**Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to translate findings into actionable testing insights.
* Strong documentation discipline and audit trail mindset.
* Ability to implement human\-in\-the\-loop safeguards and quality checks for agentic outputs.
* Effective communication skills
* Ability to work across time zones.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with GRC tools (AuditBoard or similar).
* Exposure to internal controls and end\-to\-end processes (RTR, P2P, O2C).
* Familiarity with RPA and basic model risk concepts (validation, monitoring, access controls, data privacy).


**Why us?**
 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:**

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst to join our CapAssure team, supporting the complete lifecycle of our SaaS application—from data analysis and system configuration to quality assurance and production support.
   

  

 You will analyze and maintain critical data assets, gather and interpret database information, and track client requests and deliverables for the Product organization. This role requires hands\-on technical expertise: staging SQL queries, applying database changes, and validating data and configuration updates across QA, UAT, and Production environments.
   

  

 Your responsibilities include performing functional, report, and regression testing to ensure application quality, while serving as a key resource for business users requiring complex data analyses and unique dataset extractions. You'll apply these same capabilities to new client onboarding and ongoing configuration maintenance.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 The ideal candidate demonstrates strong RDBMS knowledge, advanced SQL proficiency, and analytical thinking with the ability to confidently navigate complex data. You should be detail\-oriented with excellent problem\-solving skills, well\-organized, and comfortable managing shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
   

  

 Experience with the full Software Development Lifecycle and enterprise\-class system testing is highly valued. Through this role, you'll develop deep expertise in complex private equity fund waterfalls and carried interest plans.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 As a Technical Business Analyst, you will bridge the gap between our Product organization, Client Services, and Development teams. Your primary responsibilities include:
   

  

**Data Analysis \& Management**
* Perform comprehensive analysis of complex financial data from private equity clients across multiple sources (General Ledger systems, Excel, proprietary/legacy platforms)
* Map and transform client data to CapAssure data formats and database structures
* Execute advanced data analysis using SQL, Excel, and Python to support business requirements and ad\-hoc requests
* Extract, validate, and present actionable insights to Product and Client Service teams


**System Configuration \& Database Management**
* Develop and maintain SQL scripts for system configuration updates based on client requirements
* Stage and validate database changes that drive system behavior, calculations, and workflows
* Manage configuration changes through development, QA, UAT, and Production environments
* Ensure data integrity and quality through rigorous validation techniques
* Work with modern data platforms including SQL Server and Databricks


**Quality Assurance \& Testing**
* Design comprehensive test scenarios and plans for new features, functionality changes, and reporting enhancements
* Execute functional, regression, and end\-to\-end acceptance testing
* Create test data and develop test cases for accounting and financial workflows
* Document test results in JIRA and Azure DevOps, compare against expected outcomes, and track defects through resolution
* Validate that configuration changes produce intended impacts on data processing and system behavior


**Client Support \& Onboarding**
* Support new client onboarding and ongoing configuration maintenance
* Investigate and document client\-reported issues and system defects
* Provide end\-user support for data analysis, reporting, and system change requests
* Collaborate with development teams on client\-driven enhancements


**SDLC \& Project Management**
* Contribute throughout the full Software Development Lifecycle from requirements analysis to production deployment
* Track and manage client requests and deliverables through the Product pipeline using JIRA and Azure DevOps
* Maintain documentation for system configurations, processes, and testing procedures
* Work with shifting priorities and meet tight deadlines in a fast\-paced environment


**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent additional experience)
* 5\-7 years of progressive experience in a business/systems analyst, data analyst, or related technical role
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with relational database management systems (RDBMS)


**Technical Skills**
* Database \& SQL Expertise: Advanced proficiency in SQL coding, data normalization, and query optimization; strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, T\-SQL, SSMS, SSRS, and SSIS
* Data Management: Proven ability to handle large datasets using queries, imports, integration tools, and ETL processes
* Testing \& Project Management Tools: Experience with JIRA and Azure DevOps for issue tracking, test management, and workflow automation
* Microsoft Office Mastery: Expert\-level Excel skills (pivot tables, advanced formulas, filtering, VBA, Power Query); proficiency in Word, PowerPoint, and Visio
* Testing \& QA: Strong foundation in functional testing, quality assurance methodologies, and quality control fundamentals; experience with TestRail or similar testing platforms is a plus
* SaaS Experience: Familiarity with Software as a Service delivery models and cloud\-based applications


**Core Competencies**
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities in heterogeneous data environments
* Exceptional attention to detail with ability to work independently
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
* Ability to effectively communicate with diverse audiences:
+ Non\-technical business users and clients
+ Technical development personnel
+ Project management and senior leadership

* Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities
* Adaptability to hybrid work environment with effective collaboration across distributed teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Databricks and modern data lakehouse architectures
* Python programming skills for data analysis and automation
* Knowledge of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
* Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
* Understanding of APIs and integration methodologies
* Fund administration experience and knowledge of accounting principles
* Familiarity with private equity fund structures, waterfalls, and carried interest plans
* Experience with data warehousing concepts and architecture
* Awareness of emerging technology trends and innovation opportunities


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

**Equity In Every Sense Of The Word**
 We are in the business of equity, in every sense of the word. For us, this means taking action to ensure every colleague has equal opportunity, valuing every voice and experience across our organisation, maintaining an inclusive culture where you can bring your whole self to work, and making Alter Domus a workplace where everyone feels they belong.
   

  

 We celebrate our differences, and understand that our success relies on diverse perspectives and experiences, working towards shared goals and a common purpose. title: Sr. Analytics Engineer(Attribution, BigQuery & Server-Side Measurement)
description:
Sr. Analytics Engineer(Attribution, BigQuery \& Server\-Side Measurement)
 



  





 Technology GA4 \+ Server\-Side GTM \+ BigQuery
 



  





 Workplace Type Work from Home
 



  





 Shift Timings 4 PM\- 1 AM IST
 



  





 Required Experience (Years) 5 to 8
 



  





 Job Description
 



**About the Role** 




 You will be the
 **primary owner of attribution data accuracy, BigQuery analytics layer, and server\-side GTM implementation** 
 . Day to day, that means maintaining the measurement infrastructure that paid media, eCommerce, and executive reporting all depend on — and being the person who is accountable when numbers don’t reconcile.
 



 You’ll work closely with the Head of Analytics, the Digital Product team, and paid media channel owners. You’ll have a clear mandate: make the attribution data trustworthy, keep it that way, and build the processes so it stays that way when things change — and things always change.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**1\. BigQuery Attribution Pipeline** 



* **Own the GA4 ? BigQuery data model** 
 end\-to\-end: schema, session logic, event definitions, and the revenue attribution layer that reporting draws from
* Define and enforce channel grouping rules in BigQuery — resolving the current discrepancies between GA4 default channel groups and what reports are actually showing
* Maintain the reconciliation process between GA4 session/revenue data and BigQuery exports — establish a documented, repeatable QA cadence so divergences are caught proactively, not reactively
* Write and maintain the SQL transformations that feed Looker Studio dashboards and executive reporting — including eCommerce revenue, session attribution, and conversion rate by channel
* Own the BigQuery dataset structure, access controls, and documentation so that all team members can query with confidence
* Build and maintain attribution accuracy monitoring: automated checks that flag when GA4\-to\-BQ variance exceeds defined thresholds



  





**2\. Server\-Side GTM Ownership** 



* **Take immediate ownership of the three open sGTM migration tickets** 
 : container URL update, post\-migration tracking validation, and Meta/third\-party ad pixel validation via server GTM
* Own the server\-side GTM container configuration — tags, clients, triggers, and variable mappings — as the single accountable engineer
* Validate that all paid media vendor pixels (Meta CAPI, Google Ads, Pinterest Tag) are firing correctly through the server container and that conversion data matches platform\-reported figures
* Manage consent mode v2 implementation: ensure that cookie\-rejected sessions are handled correctly in the server\-side pipeline and that their impact on channel attribution is understood and documented
* Define and document the event passthrough architecture: which events fire client\-side, which are handled server\-side, and why
* Own the ongoing server container QA process — after any significant release or GTM change, run a structured validation before signing off



  





**3\. Attribution Accuracy \& Ongoing Maintenance** 



* Maintain and evolve the attribution model as the business adds channels, changes checkout flows, or modifies tracking architecture
* Investigate and resolve the
 **non\-consent session impact on direct traffic** 
 — currently open (CTE\-54704\) — and document the expected behavior going forward
* Own the channel grouping logic across all reporting surfaces: GA4 property, BigQuery, and Looker Studio — ensuring consistent definitions everywhere
* Audit attribution data quarterly: identify channels that are over\- or under\-attributed, document findings, and implement corrections
* Be the internal expert on GA4 attribution settings: attribution windows, cross\-channel data\-driven attribution, and how they interact with the BigQuery export
* Establish a formal change\-management process for attribution — any modification to GTM tags, channel grouping, or BQ schema that affects attribution data must be documented, reviewed, and communicated before it goes live



  





**4\. Reporting \& Dashboard Support** 



* Build and maintain the core eCommerce and digital marketing dashboards in Looker Studio that draw from the BigQuery attribution layer you own
* Ensure dashboard metric definitions are aligned with the attribution model — no dashboard should define revenue or channel differently from the source\-of\-truth BQ model
* Support Power BI reporting for stakeholders who require offline\-capable reports
* Own the Google Sheets ? SharePoint migration for reporting infrastructure as part of the ongoing Google sunset initiative



  





**5\. GTM Web Implementation (Shared Scope)** 



* Implement and validate GA4 event tracking via GTM for new Digital Product features — PLP filters, PDP interactions, cart events, and checkout flows
* Review and approve data layer specifications from Engineering before implementation begins
* Conduct post\-release GTM validation as standard practice — this is non\-negotiable before a ticket is closed



 Must\-Have Skills
 



 BigQuery, Server\-Side GTM\- Google tag manager, GA4 Attribution (Google Analytics 4\), Property Management

title: Senior Analyst I - Trial Analytics, Insights & Planning (TAIP)
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Analyst role in Bristol Myers Squibb’s Trial Analytics, Insights, and Planning (TAIP) unit is an excellent opportunity for professionals with approximately 3–6 years of experience in consulting, life sciences analytics, or clinical trial operations to step into an internal consulting environment that directly accelerates drug development.
   

  

 Senior Analysts join one of two tracks based on their background and preference:
   

  

* The Analytical track focuses on forecasting, data modelling, dashboards, and site performance analytics.
* The Scientific track focuses on protocol logic, patient population sizing, eligibility criteria, and feasibility planning.


 Regardless of track, you will gain exposure to both domains and are expected to develop strong, well\-rounded expertise in scientific and analytical areas over time.
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst, you will be embedded in a specific clinical trial team and work under the guidance of more senior team members to deliver core analytics workstreams that support smarter, faster trial execution. This includes taking ownership of trial forecasting models, feasibility analyses, and protocol analytics — always with the goal of helping bring therapies to patients more effectively.
   

  

 You are not expected to be a therapeutic area or protocol expert on day one, but you will be expected to build domain knowledge over time, apply structured thinking to complex trial problems, and deliver high\-quality, consistent outputs. You’ll also be part of a global, cross\-functional team, working closely with peers across time zones to deliver with speed and precision.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own key trial\-level analytics workstreams (e.g., enrollment forecasting, feasibility analysis, protocol input)
* Translate structured study requirements into analytical deliverables in collaboration with more senior TAIP colleagues
* Work within a specific clinical trial context, gaining exposure to operational strategy, protocol logic, and real\-world trial planning challenges
* Build therapeutic area knowledge over time, contributing to more targeted and scientifically grounded analyses
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and clarity in data models, dashboards, and insights shared with the study team
* Collaborate across geographies, coordinating with other analysts and team members globally
* Contribute to cost\-related analyses, such as country mix optimization and study design trade\-offs
* Support study optimization by analyzing site and patient burden, competitor activity, and external data sources
* Coordinate with field\-based colleagues to integrate local insights into feasibility and planning analytics
* Utilize trial analytics platforms and tools to generate, structure, and communicate data\-driven insights
* Support analytics that may inform clinical supply forecasting or site\-level supply considerations
* Applies critical thinking to analyze complex data, challenge assumptions, and generate strategic, evidence\-based recommendations


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education: Preferred advanced degree (e.g., MSc, MPH, PharmD, PhD, MBA) in a relevant field
* Experience:
+ 3–6\+ years of experience in consulting, healthcare analytics, life sciences strategy, or clinical trial planning and delivery is required
+ Proven ability to manage and deliver complex analytical projects in fast\-paced environments

* Skills:
+ Excellent communication and structured problem\-solving skills
+ Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills required
+ Interest in developing deeper expertise in therapeutic areas and clinical trial analytics


**Why Join This Team?**
* Grow in a Learning Environment: Build your scientific, analytical, and strategic expertise over time
* Be Part of an Internal Consulting Model: Operate in a pod\-based team inspired by top\-tier strategy firms
* Progress Through a Clear Career Path: Advance through a structured path modeled on strategic consulting, with transparent expectations, \~2–3 years per role, and rapid progression based on ownership and impact
* Pathway to Strategic Leadership at BMS: Career development is actively encouraged and expected, with opportunities to move into broader strategy and leadership roles within BMS in a short timeframe
* Accelerate Therapies to Patients: Help drive clinical decisions that bring treatments to patients faster


 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site\-essential, site\-by\-design, field\-based and remote\-by\-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways\-of\-working.
   

  

**Supporting People With Disabilities**
 BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit careers.bms.com/eeo\-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.
   

  

**Candidate Rights**
 BMS will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.
   

  

 For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https://careers.bms.com/california\-residents/
   

  

**Data Protection**
 We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https://careers.bms.com/fraud\-protection.
   

  

 Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.
   

  

 If this posting is missing required information required by local law or incorrect, contact BMS at TAEnablement@bms.com with the Job Title and Requisition number. Do not send application\-related inquiries to this email. To check your application status, please login to your Candidate Home Account.
